We fine-tune the Q-former projector and LoRA adapters of a speech LLM at five audio compression factors and six random seeds, holding the encoder, base decoder, data and decoding fixed, and evaluate every run on Common Voice and Fair-Speech. At 460 h of clean LibriSpeech, the seed moves fairness metrics more than compression does on most demographic axes. A balanced 3x3 decomposition attributes 85.3% of the variation in Fair-Speech ethnicity normalized gap to the seed against 8.3% to compression (p = 0.009), though compression explains more on age and gender. Held-out LibriSpeech word error rate spreads by 0.04 points across those seeds while Common Voice spreads by 8.57, so these are not failed runs, and the effect survives controlling for accuracy and dropout. Scaling and diversifying the adaptation set to 960 h damps the effect but does not remove it. On Fair-Speech ethnicity, two single-run systems must differ by more than 0.30 in normalized gap to exceed seed variability.

</details>


### [237] [When Clipping Reverses Correction: Failure Dynamics of Pointwise Forward-KL On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38995)
*Di Huang,Hao Li,Yixin Chen,Fuhai Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现，在On-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）中，对前向KL目标进行逐点裁剪（pointwise clipping）会导致模型产生更多持续性的重复输出。理论证明和实验均表明，裁剪机制不仅未能有效引导学生接近教师模型，反而可能将概率推向远离教师的方向，特别是在重复序列内部。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管后续研究广泛采用了原始OPS研究中提出的“逐点裁剪”技术以稳定训练，但其对训练过程的具体影响尚未被直接考察。特别是需要验证裁剪是否真的有助于防止风格化token主导训练信号，以及它是否会导致特定的生成缺陷（如重复）。

Method: 1. 控制变量实验：在仅改变是否应用裁剪条件的匹配训练运行中进行对比。
2. 理论分析：证明裁剪后的目标函数在数学上可能导致学生模型的token概率偏离教师模型。
3. 概率分布分析：比较裁剪与非裁剪学生在重复序列内部相对于教师模型的概率分配差异。

Result: 1. 实验观察：应用裁剪的训练运行产生的持续性重复显著多于未裁剪的运行。
2. 理论发现：裁剪目标无法保证将学生拉向教师，反而可能推开学生与教师的距离。
3. 具体表现：在重复内部，裁剪后的学生模型赋予“跳出重复”的概率低于教师，而赋予“继续重复”的概率高于教师；相比之下，未裁剪的运行能保持与教师模型的接近性。

Conclusion: 逐点裁剪前向KL目标并非总是有益的，它可能导致训练不稳定并引发严重的重复生成问题。该机制在数学上存在缺陷，不能保证学生模型向教师模型收敛，因此在涉及重复敏感任务（如数学推理）时应谨慎使用或重新评估其必要性。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own generated responses using feedback from the same model conditioned on privileged information. On mathematical reasoning, the original OPSD study finds that stylistic tokens can dominate the training signal over math-related tokens, and that pointwise clipping of the forward KL objective stabilizes training. Pointwise clipping caps each vocabulary-wise forward KL term at a fixed threshold before summing over the vocabulary. Follow-up studies have adopted this clipping, but its effect on training has not been directly examined. In matched training runs differing only in whether clipping is applied, we observe that clipped runs produce substantially more repetitions that persist to the end of the response than their unclipped counterparts. We trace this failure to the clipped objective. We prove that the clipped objective can fail to correct the student toward the teacher and can instead push clipped and unclipped token probabilities away from its teacher. Our training runs agree with this analysis: inside repetitions, the clipped student places less probability than its teacher on leaving the repetition, and more on continuing it, whereas the unclipped runs stay close to their teachers.

</details>


### [238] [Settle: Learning When to Stop Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38997)
*Ryan Brown,Zihao Fu,Chris Russell*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Settle方法，通过训练现有推理结束token并结合答案稳定性，在保持基座模型预测接近度的同时实现高效停止，显著减少Token消耗并提升精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决推理模型在答案已确定后仍继续生成的问题，优化推理过程中的Token使用效率。

Method: 利用已完成轨迹中的答案稳定性来学习停止时机；训练现有的推理结束（end-of-reasoning）token，同时约束其他预测值贴近基座模型；推理阶段仅需常规解码。

Result: 在MATH-500数据集（Qwen3-4B模型）上，Settle使Token数量减少40%，准确率仅下降0.5个百分点；相比在第一稳定答案处截断的监督微调方法，在几乎相同的Token计数下准确率提升6.16个百分点；其停止得分能预测正确答案是否保持不变。

Conclusion: Settle扩展了所评估停止方法的准确率-Token计数帕累托前沿，证明了其在平衡推理效率与准确性方面的有效性。

Abstract: Reasoning models often continue generating after their answers have settled. Settle learns when to stop from answer stability in completed traces. It trains the existing end-of-reasoning token while keeping other predictions close to the base model, and requires only ordinary decoding at inference. On MATH-500 with Qwen3-4B, Settle reduces token count by 40% with a 0.5-percentage-point decrease in accuracy. It gains 6.16 percentage points over supervised fine-tuning on the same traces shortened at their first stable answer, at nearly identical token counts. Its stopping score predicts whether a correct answer will remain correct. Settle extends the accuracy-token-count Pareto frontier of the evaluated stopping methods.

</details>


### [239] [The Invisible Language Tax: Token Premiums of French and Regional Languages in 2026 LLM Tokenizers, and a French-Optimized Prototype](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39001)
*Thomas Serval*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究揭示了不同语言在LLM Tokenizer下的“Token溢价”差异，法语比英语多用31%-58%的Token。通过实验证明增加多语言训练数据可降低该溢价，并提出了Baracoda FR v1.2原型，在法语上比Tekken少用11.5%的Token，但需进一步验证其对模型质量和任务成本的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM服务按Token计费且上下文窗口以Token计算，但相同内容在不同语言下所需的Token数量存在显著差异，导致非英语语言用户面临更高的隐性成本（Token溢价），影响公平性和使用效率。

Method: 1. 测量7种主流Tokenizer（OpenAI o200k, Llama 3, Qwen3等）在NTREX-128和《世界人权宣言》区域语言版本上的Token消耗；2. 控制变量实验（BPE, Europarl语料库, 5万词汇表）分析训练数据对Token溢价的影响；3. 设计并测试Baracoda FR v1.2字节级BPE原型，对比Tekken和其他模型。

Result: 1. 法语比英语多用31%-58% Token，简体中文波动为-5%至+40%，法国海外语言是英语的1.6-3.3倍；2. 增加法语训练数据可快速降低溢价但有边际递减效应，同时增加英语成本；3. Baracoda FR v1.2在6个未见语料上比Tekken节省11.5%法语Token和3.7%英语Token，但在其他语言表现较差，且不如CroissantLLM。

Conclusion: 当前主流Tokenizer存在显著的语言偏见和成本不平等，通过优化训练数据和分词策略（如Baracoda FR）可在特定语言上提升效率，但通用性仍需改进，且Token效率提升不等于模型质量或任务成本的最终优化，需后续实证研究。

Abstract: LLM services are billed per token and context windows are measured in tokens, yet the number of tokens needed for the same content varies across languages. We measure this token premium on seven tokenizers of widely used 2026 models (OpenAI o200k, Llama 3, Qwen3, DeepSeek V3/V4, Gemma 3, Mistral Tekken, and the Claude generation-5 tokenizer via Anthropic's counting API) on NTREX-128 (124 non-English reference translations) and on the Universal Declaration of Human Rights for regional languages. French requires 31% to 58% more tokens than English, whereas Simplified Chinese ranges from 5% fewer to 40% more and is cheaper than French on six of the seven tokenizers. Regional and overseas languages of France pay roughly 1.6 to 3.3 times the English count. We discuss how history re-sending, tiered pricing and fixed context windows amplify the absolute gap in agentic use. In a controlled experiment (BPE, Europarl, 50k vocabulary), adding French to tokenizer training data quickly reduces the premium, with diminishing returns and a growing cost for English. Finally, we present Baracoda FR v1.2, a byte-level BPE prototype with Tekken's vocabulary size. On a final test of six corpora never consulted during design, with a protocol declared fixed beforehand, it uses 11.5% fewer tokens than Tekken on French and 3.7% fewer on English; results hold after removing test sentences overlapping the training data and with an equal ordinary-token budget. It is worse on other languages and, at comparable vocabulary size, does not outperform CroissantLLM. These are segmentation results only; effects on model quality and task cost remain to be shown.

</details>


### [240] [A Missing Piece for Trustworthy AI Reviewers: From Benchmarking Rhetorical Robustness to SciCore Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39027)
*Chenguang Wang,Ming Li,Chengrui Fan,Jianpeng Chen,Han Chen,Tianyi Zhou,Dawei Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出“修辞鲁棒性”概念，构建RobustReview基准测试揭示AI审稿人易受文字表述影响，并推出SciCore双分支模型，通过结合全文评估与结构化科学核心提取，显著提升了AI审稿的稳定性与判别力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决AI审稿人可能因对同一科学内容的不同文字表述给出不同评判的问题，防止“修辞优化”优于“科学改进”，确保审稿结果既稳定又具区分度。

Method: 1. 定义“修辞鲁棒性”为内容保持重写下的稳定性与跨论文判别力的结合；2. 发布包含1,260个手稿版本的RobustReview基准测试，评估30种审稿配置；3. 提出SciCore模型，采用双分支结构，融合全文判决与基于提取的结构化“科学核心”的判决。

Result: 发现存在“虚假鲁棒性”（重写敏感性低但跨论文分数崩溃）；人类对齐与修辞鲁棒性排名不一致；现有内容聚焦提示协议未一致提升鲁棒性；SciCore在GPT-5.5比较中实现了领先的联合稳定性-判别力曲线，并保持具有竞争力的人类对齐水平。

Conclusion: 修辞鲁棒性是AI审稿的一个独立且重要的评估目标；基于“科学核心”的审稿方法能有效降低对修辞的敏感度，提升AI审稿的质量与公平性。

Abstract: AI reviewers can assign different judgments to manuscripts that report the same science in different wording, potentially rewarding rhetorical optimization over scientific improvement. We formulate Rhetorical Robustness as the joint requirement of stability across content-preserving rewrites and discrimination across papers. We introduce RobustReview, a controlled full-manuscript benchmark with 1,260 manuscript versions, and evaluate 30 reviewer configurations. The benchmark reveals false robustness, where low rewrite sensitivity coincides with score collapse across papers, and shows that human alignment and rhetorical robustness rank reviewers differently. Moreover, the evaluated content-focused prompting protocol does not consistently improve robustness across backbones. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SciCore, a dual-branch reviewer that averages a full-manuscript judgment with a judgment based on an extracted, structured science core. This design combines manuscript-level assessment with a content-normalized view intended to reduce rhetorical sensitivity. In our primary GPT-5.5 comparison, SciCore achieves a leading joint stability-discrimination profile among the benchmarked reviewers while maintaining competitive human alignment. These results identify rhetorical robustness as a distinct evaluation target and demonstrate the potential of science-core review to improve it.

</details>


### [241] [RSIGame: Autonomous Agentic Game Development with Recursive Self-improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39045)
*Wenyi Wu,Minghao Fu,Jieyu You,Kun Zhou,Siqi Liu,Aayush Salvi,Yiheng Lin,Ce Zhang,Xiaohan Lan,Jiahui Zhu,Yujie Zhong,Qi She,Biwei Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出RSIGame框架，通过局部与全局循环的递归自我改进及经验内化，显著提升大语言模型生成游戏的质量与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决现有自动游戏生成中，简单迭代优化易导致过拟合、产生脆弱代码（含未修复Bug、缺失行为）且泛化能力差的问题。

Method: 构建自主智能体开发框架RSIGame：1) 局部循环（探索-诊断-改进）结合动态检查清单进行证据驱动的修订；2) 全局循环监控质量、保留最佳检查点并检测饱和或退化；3) 将成功经验内化至生成器中进行训练。

Result: 在140个GameCraft-Bench任务及多种引擎/生成器上，RSIGame在同等预算下持续改善游戏质量。Qwen3.8-27B经内化后在Godot和Phaser得分超越GPT-5.5单次生成分数，且生成Token减少11倍。

Conclusion: 递归自我改进机制与经验内化策略能有效克服自动游戏生成的缺陷，实现高质量、高效率的游戏自动生成。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models have made automatic game generation increasingly feasible, yet reliably improving generated games beyond a playable version remains challenging. Naive iterative refinement can easily overfit a small set of test cases, producing fragile games with unresolved bugs, missing behaviors, and poor generalization to broader player interactions. We introduce RSIGame, an autonomous agentic game development framework with recursive self-improvement. RSIGame organizes development into complementary local and global loops. Concretely, a local explore-diagnose-improve loop broadly explores the executable game, diagnoses and prioritizes discovered issues, and performs evidence-grounded revision, where an evolving checklist continually accumulates new testing and improvement guidance. A global loop tracks overall quality, preserves the best checkpoint, and detects saturation or regression over long-horizon development. Beyond test-time improvement, RSIGame further internalizes successful development experience into the generator through training. Across 140 GameCraft-Bench tasks, two game engines, and five generators, RSIGame consistently improves game quality under matched development budgets. Notably, experience internalization enables Qwen3.8-27B to reach 61.38 on Godot and 58.53 on Phaser, exceeding GPT-5.5 one-shot scores while reducing Qwen's generation tokens by 11 times.

</details>


### [242] [Structure vs. Chain-of-Thought: Evaluating LLM Criteria Extraction for Depression Severity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39049)
*Xinkai Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究比较了大语言模型（LLM）通过直接评分和基于临床标准提取两种方式来评估社交媒体帖子中的抑郁严重程度。结果显示，尽管基于标准的提取方法更具可审计性，但在实际检测严重病例方面，它往往遗漏更多案例，且性能提升并不显著或依赖数据拟合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在比较LLM直接对抑郁严重程度进行评级与标记具体临床标准这两种方法的优劣，特别关注哪种方式能更有效地识别严重抑郁病例，同时兼顾结果的可审计性。

Method: 使用两个Reddit语料库，测试三种不同规模的大语言模型（从9B到前沿规模），结合PHQ-9和BDI-II两个问卷。采用二次加权 kappa 系数衡量与标注数据的一致性，对比直接提示、思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）以及基于临床标准的提取方法，并分析了固定阈值与基于标签数据拟合阈值的差异。

Result: 1. 在主要语料库上，前沿模型仅在阈值基于标签数据拟合时，其标准提取得分略高于思维链，但差异不显著；若使用预先固定的阈值，则无显著提升。
2. 在涉及抑郁社区的特定语料库中，9B模型倾向于将大多数帖子标记为严重，而使用预先固定的规则优于直接提示和思维链。
3. 关键发现：更高的序数一致性并不意味着更好的严重病例检测能力。PHQ-9标准提取方法漏掉了大多数严重帖子，且从直接提示转向思维链再到标准提取，几乎在所有比较中都增加了漏检率。
4. 在重新标注的压力数据集上，使用自身特征（包括词数）的模型与前沿模型的标准提取性能无显著差异。

Conclusion: 虽然基于临床标准的提取方法便于临床医生审计，但它并未在检测严重抑郁病例上表现出优势，反而可能导致更高的漏检率。简单的启发式规则或针对特定数据集优化的特征在某些情况下可能比复杂的LLM提取方法更有效。因此，在追求可审计性的同时，不能忽视模型对极端严重病例的检测能力。

Abstract: A large language model (LLM) can rate depression severity directly from a social media post or mark which clinical criteria the post shows and let code turn the count into a label. The latter is easier to audit because a clinician can check each marked criterion. We compare these approaches on two Reddit corpora using three LLMs (from 9B to frontier scale) and two questionnaires (PHQ-9, BDI-II), and measure agreement with quadratic weighted kappa. For the two frontier models, criteria extraction scores above chain-of-thought on one corpus only when its decision thresholds are fitted on labeled data. Neither model's gain is significant, with or without recalibrating chain-of-thought on the same labels. With thresholds fixed a priori from PHQ-9's criteria, extraction shows no gain on either corpus, even where models mark over two criteria per post. The 9B model behaves differently on a corpus from depression communities. It labels most posts severe, whether prompted directly or with chain-of-thought, while the a priori rule beats both without labels. After chain-of-thought is recalibrated on the same labels, no significant gap remains, consistent with a calibration effect. Yet higher ordinal agreement does not ensure better detection of severe cases. PHQ-9 criteria extraction misses most severe posts, and moving from direct prompting to chain-of-thought and then to extraction increases misses in nearly all comparisons. On the primary corpus, a relabeled stress dataset, a model using that dataset's own features, including word counts from the text, is not significantly different from frontier criteria extraction under the a priori rule.

</details>


### [243] [CORE: Conflict-Oriented Reasoning Elimination for Verifiable Language-Model Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39069)
*Siyu Song,Rui Xu,Jia Lin,Kai Liu,Weifang Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CORE是一种搜索控制器，通过获取验证器提供的认证冲突核心（certified conflict core）进行回溯跳跃（backjumping）和缓存，显著减少语言模型推理中的验证器调用次数并提高成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的测试时推理系统在遇到失败时通常仅重启或修改最新步骤，忽略了早期决策导致的错误，导致效率低下且无法有效利用失败信息。

Method: 提出CORE框架：1) 请求验证器提供认证冲突核心；2) 回溯到该核心中的最新决策点；3) 缓存冲突以避免重复。理论证明在特定条件下搜索是完备的。实验基于图着色实例及5个推理任务，使用Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen3-8B模型进行评估。

Result: 1) 在2,000个图着色实例中，相比时序修复（chronological repair），CORE在中位数验证器调用上分别减少了39.8%（30变量）和35.0%（36变量），缓存进一步提升了性能；2) 在5个推理任务中，CORE在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen3-8B上的平均成功率分别为75.9%和84.2%，优于Tree of Thoughts（72.5%和81.8%）；3) CORE在两种模型上均使用了更少的验证器调用和生成的token数。

Conclusion: 使用认证的失败解释（certified failure explanations）来指导语言模型的搜索过程具有显著价值，能有效提升推理效率和准确性。

Abstract: Test-time reasoning systems often respond to failure by restarting or revising the latest step, even when an earlier decision caused the error. We introduce CORE, a search controller that requests a certified conflict core from a verifier, backjumps to the latest decision in that core, and caches the conflict to avoid repeating it. Under sound verification, finite branching and depth, and exhaustive proposals, the uncapped search is complete and never prunes a valid solution. On 2,000 planted graph-coloring instances with matched proposals and an exact verifier, CORE reduces median verifier calls by 39.8% at 30 variables and 35.0% at 36 variables relative to chronological repair; caching further improves on backjumping alone. Across five reasoning tasks, CORE achieves 75.9% mean success with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and 84.2% with Qwen3-8B, compared with 72.5% and 81.8% for Tree of Thoughts. It also uses fewer verifier calls and generated tokens on both backbones. These results show the value of using certified failure explanations to direct language-model search.

</details>


### [244] [LexReward: A Taxonomy-Driven Reward Framework for Legal Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39071)
*Yida Cai,Xin Dai,Bingxiang He,Huiyuan Xie,Yuxiao Ye,Zhenghao Liu,Yang Bai,Zhiyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LexReward框架，通过风格、要素和推理链三个维度构建细粒度法律奖励模型，利用DPO和强化学习显著提升法律语言模型在各维度的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有法律奖励方法多依赖粗略的整体判断，缺乏领域特异性及可解释性，无法全面捕捉法律回答在词汇、事实引用及逻辑推理等多维质量。

Method: 引入基于分类法的LexReward框架，从Style（词汇句法）、Element（法律主体/事实/法规/判决）和Chain（推理顺序/完整性/正确性/无冗余）三个维度制定评估标准；构建成对偏好数据用于直接偏好优化（DPO）及奖励模型训练。

Result: 基于标准的奖励能可靠区分不同质量的法律回答；DPO训练提升了模型在所有三个维度的性能；各维度特定的奖励模型LexRM可通过强化学习独立优化对应维度的策略表现，且无需参考答案。

Conclusion: 提出的多维分类法和奖励构建机制有效，LexReward为法律语言模型提供了更具特异性和可解释性的奖励信号，支持下游任务的高效优化。

Abstract: Legal language models require reward signals that capture not only answer correctness but also the multidimensional quality of legal responses. Existing reward methods, however, often rely on coarse-grained holistic judgments, providing limited domain specificity and interpretability. We introduce LexReward, a taxonomy-driven framework for legal reward modeling. LexReward characterizes legal response quality along three complementary dimensions: Style, covering lexical and syntactic quality; Element, assessing legal subjects, facts, statutes, and decisions; and Chain, evaluating the order, completeness, correctness, and non-redundancy of legal reasoning. For each dimension, we develop rubrics that specify evaluation criteria and quality levels. The resulting rewards are used to construct pairwise preference data for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and reward-model training. Experiments show that the rubric-based rewards reliably distinguish legal responses of different quality and that DPO training on the preference data improves performance across all three dimensions. The learned reward models, LexRM, also support effective downstream optimization: each dimension-specific reward model improves policy performance in its corresponding dimension through reinforcement learning, without requiring reference answers at reward time. Dimension-wise analyses further support the effectiveness of the proposed taxonomy and reward construction.

</details>


### [245] [Beyond Text: LLM-Based Dimensional Emotion Evaluation in Multimodal Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39072)
*Yutong Hu,Jinho Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出基于LLM的多模态对话情感评估框架，在IEMOCAP数据集上实现离散情感识别与VAD连续维度评估。LoRA微调的LLaMA模型表现优于GPT，最佳Valence CCC达0.7822（SOTA）。研究表明文本化音频描述对较小模型提升显著，且性能差异与标注者一致性高度相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管对话情感识别研究广泛，但将大语言模型应用于多模态对话中的连续维度情感评估（特别是VAD）仍缺乏深入探索。

Method: 构建基于LLM的框架，结合SpeechCueLLM方法将声学线索转化为自然语言描述。在IEMOCAP数据集上，对LLaMA、GPT和Qwen系列的六种模型进行零样本提示、少样本提示及LoRA微调评估，涵盖离散情感识别与VAD维度评估任务。

Result: 1. LoRA微调的LLaMA模型在两项任务上均大幅超越提示工程的GPT模型，证明领域适应性比模型规模更重要；2. 最佳模型在Valence维度上CCC达到0.7822，创IEMOCAP新纪录；3. 消融实验显示，文本化音频描述使小模型加权F1提升3.5-3.6，但对最大模型贡献微弱；4. VAD各维度性能不对称性与IEMOCAP标注者同意度层级一致。

Conclusion: 领域适配（如LoRA微调）对LLM在多模态情感分析中的表现至关重要；将声学信息转化为文本描述能有效增强小模型的感知能力；模型性能瓶颈主要受限于标注数据本身的一致性而非模型容量。

Abstract: Emotion recognition in conversation has been widely studied, but applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to continuous dimensional emotion evaluation in multimodal dialogue remains largely unexplored. We propose an LLM-based framework that performs discrete emotion recognition and Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) dimensional evaluation on IEMOCAP, incorporating acoustic cues as natural language descriptions following the SpeechCueLLM approach. We evaluate six models spanning the LLaMA, GPT, and Qwen families under zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, and LoRA fine-tuning. LoRA fine-tuned LLaMA models substantially outperform prompt-engineered GPT models on both tasks despite GPT's larger scale, a gap we attribute to domain adaptation rather than model capacity. Our best model achieves a Valence CCC of 0.7822, a new state-of-the-art on IEMOCAP. Ablation studies confirm that textual audio descriptions meaningfully improve smaller models (+3.5 to 3.6 weighted F1) while contributing little for the largest model, suggesting audio cues are most valuable when linguistic capacity is limited. The performance asymmetry across VAD dimensions closely mirrors the annotator agreement hierarchy in IEMOCAP's own annotations.

</details>


### [246] [False Frontiers: Diagnosing and Mitigating Co-Cheating in Self-Evolving Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39102)
*Meijia Chen,Hao Li,Zheng Lu,Hongshan Lin,Junbai Tian,Yichen Liu,Zijun Tian,Yufan Zou,Shuhan Sun,Hanxin Chen,Zeyu Zhang,Weizhi Du,Yueting Li,Tianyu Shi,Alaa Khamis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对自进化搜索代理中存在的“共作弊”（co-cheating）问题，即提议者和求解者因共享错误导致内部奖励虚高但外部正确率下降，本文提出CrossFit方法。该方法通过将源文档分组并交叉验证，有效抑制虚假一致性，显著提升了模型在下游搜索基准上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自进化搜索代理通过联合优化提议者（生成问题）和求解者（回答问题）构建训练课程，但这种闭环机制引入了“共作弊”失败模式：两者日益倾向于共享相同的错误，导致内部奖励信号改善，但外部正确性并未同步提升，甚至出现伪标签正确率停滞或下降的现象。

Method: 1. **多样本验证 (MSV)**：作为直接缓解手段，查询同一模型三次带源数据和三次不带源数据以决定任务准入并替换不可靠伪标签，但残留较多共作弊且计算成本高。
2. **CrossFit**：主要方法，将提议者的源文档分为A、B两组；用仅基于B训练的辅助求解器评估由A生成的问题，反之亦然。通过交叉拟合的一致性确定提议者奖励，确保同源伪标签无法通过反馈求解器复现，同时保持原求解者更新规则不变。
3. **消融实验**：通过排除源数据的反馈重放提案，进一步隔离反馈祖源与课程变化的影响。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-4B和9B模型上重新运行循环：MSV将虚假一致性质量从6.1%降至5.7%（4B），从8.8%降至7.2%（9B）；而CrossFit将其大幅降低至3.0%和3.7%。结合排除源数据的反馈后，虚假一致性进一步降至0.4%和0.1%。在七个下游搜索基准测试中，CrossFit相比标准耦合自进化平均性能分别提升8.8和8.4分，相比Search-R1分别提升8.7和7.8分。

Conclusion: CrossFit通过解耦提议与求解的源依赖关系，有效缓解了自进化过程中的共作弊问题，显著提高了伪标签的真实性和模型在搜索任务中的整体表现，优于现有的多样本验证方法和基线算法。

Abstract: Self-evolving search agents build their own training curricula by jointly optimizing a proposer that generates questions and a solver that answers them. This closed loop introduces a failure mode we call co-cheating: the proposer and solver increasingly agree on shared errors, so internal reward improves without a matching gain in external correctness. A post-hoc audit against source evidence shows co-cheating growing more severe over successive rounds of self-evolution, with pseudo-label correctness stagnating or declining even as the in-loop training signal improves. The most direct mitigation is to verify proposals before training: we introduce multi-sample verification (MSV), which queries the same model three times with the source and three times without it to decide task admission and replace unreliable pseudo-labels. MSV partially reduces false agreement but leaves substantial residual co-cheating and costs six extra labeler generations per candidate. These limitations motivate CrossFit, our main method: it partitions the proposer's source documents into groups A and B; questions generated from A are scored by an auxiliary solver trained only on B, and vice versa. The cross-fitted agreement determines proposer reward, so a same-source pseudo-label cannot be reproduced through the feedback solver, while the original solver's update rule is unchanged. Rerunning the loop with Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B, MSV reduces false-agreement mass from 6.1% to 5.7% and from 8.8% to 7.2%, whereas CrossFit reduces it to 3.0% and 3.7%. Replaying identical proposals with source-excluded feedback further reduces false agreement to 0.4% and 0.1%, isolating feedback ancestry from curriculum changes. Across seven downstream search benchmarks, CrossFit improves average performance over standard coupled self-evolution by 8.8 and 8.4 points and over Search-R1 by 8.7 and 7.8 points at 4B and 9B.

</details>


### [247] [Bongard: Training Machine Intuition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39111)
*Li Ding,Haidi Jin,Chen Ji*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Bongard，一种基于T5Gemma 2的4B参数System One模型，通过分离编码与解码分支及三阶段训练（监督判断、语义关系、动作结果），实现高效机器直觉。在DecisionBench上准确率达78.05%，推理延迟低至36ms，为高吞吐量决策任务提供了开源高效的替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类智能依赖于无需展开中间步骤的模式识别和情境判断（即“系统一”直觉）。现有方法缺乏将机器直觉作为独立能力进行设计和训练的机制，旨在构建一个能像人类一样快速做出判断的高效AI系统。

Method: 1. 架构：采用T5Gemma 2 4B编码器-解码器结构，编码器双向读取状态和问题指令，多个解码分支共享该编码，实现“一次读取，多次判断”。2. 训练：分三个阶段进行，涵盖监督判断、语义关系到动作结果，更新全部70.9亿参数。3. 后训练：包括联合嵌入后训练以提升对重述问题的鲁棒性，以及沙盒阶段学习动作结果分布。

Result: 1. 性能提升：联合嵌入后训练使保留集重述准确率从75.7%提升至85.9%；沙盒阶段使冻结面板准确率从50.6%提升至64.8%。2. 基准测试：在DecisionBench上达到78.05%准确率，在61个系统中排名第四。3. 效率：在RTX PRO 6000上，短请求中位延迟仅36ms，单次状态处理221ms可回答32个问题。

Conclusion: Bongard证明了机器直觉可以通过表示学习和结果反馈进行系统化训练。该模型提供了一个开放、高效且低延迟的解决方案，适用于需要高吞吐量决策的工作负载，验证了将直觉作为独立计算能力的可行性。

Abstract: Human intelligence relies heavily on learned intuition: recognising patterns and judging situations without explicitly unfolding every intermediate step. We introduce Bongard, an open-weight System One model that treats machine intuition as an independent capability to design and train. A T5Gemma 2 4B-4B encoder-decoder separates reading the evidence from making judgments. The encoder reads the state bidirectionally together with the question instructions, and separate decoder branches share this encoding, so many judgments about the same situation require only one reading of the state. A trained head returns probabilities over the supplied candidates without generating text. Training proceeds in three stages, from supervised judgments to semantic relationships to action outcomes, and each stage updates all 7.09 billion trainable parameters on one Blackwell GPU. Joint-embedding post-training raises accuracy on held-out rephrasings from 75.7% to 85.9%. A sandbox stage then learns outcome distributions from action rollouts and exact oracles, raising accuracy on a frozen sandbox panel from 50.6% to 64.8%. On DecisionBench, the final model reaches 78.05% accuracy over 23,900 decisions and ranks fourth of 61 systems in the public comparison. On one RTX PRO 6000, its median latency is 36 ms for short requests, and 32 questions about one state take 221 ms. Bongard demonstrates that machine intuition can be systematically trained via representation learning and outcome feedback, providing an open, efficient alternative for high-throughput decision workloads.

</details>


### [248] [Diagnosing On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39118)
*Yang Li,Gongle Xue,Yuheng Yuan,Yijia Guo,Shizhe Zhang,Liwen Hu,Lei Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文诊断了策略内自蒸馏（OPSD）在数学推理中的表现，发现其并非通用的可靠方法。OPSD的效果高度依赖于教师信号与模型的兼容性，否则会导致无效增长、性能退化或行为崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管策略内自蒸馏（OPSD）被视为提升语言模型推理能力的有前景的方法，但其在语言推理中的具体行为尚不明确，现有研究结果从适度增益到行为崩溃差异巨大，缺乏系统性理解。

Method: 对0.6B至8B参数的模型进行控制实验和逐词元（token-level）分析，深入诊断OPSD在数学推理任务中的机制与表现。

Result: 1. 教师信号由“推理模式对齐”和“完整教师前缀”塑造，而非仅由特权语义决定；2. OPSD仅在狭窄的兼容性范围内有效，否则导致无效长度增长、稳定退化或行为崩溃；3. 教师信号不稳定且无法预测下游性能。

Conclusion: OPSD是一种对参数和条件极其敏感的算法，不应被视为一种普遍可靠的、用于提升推理能力的后训练方法。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has attracted growing interest as a promising approach to improve the reasoning ability of language models. Without external rewards nor a separate stronger teacher, the self-teacher with privileged information could provide dense signals on student's trajectories. However, its behavior in language reasoning remains unclear, with reported outcomes ranging from modest gains to behavioral collapse. In this work, we diagnose OPSD for mathematical reasoning across models spanning 0.6B--8B parameters. We conduct controlled experiments and token-level analyses to fully delve into OPSD. We point out that teacher's signal is shaped by reasoning-mode alignment and the complete teacher prefix, rather than by privileged semantics alone. OPSD improves reasoning only in narrow compatibility regimes. Otherwise, it produces ineffective length growth, stable degradation, or behavioral collapse. Token-level analysis shows that teacher's signal is not stable and does not predict downstream performance. Based on these results, we argue that OPSD is a sensitive algorithm rather than a generally reliable reasoning-improvement post-training method.

</details>


### [249] [DAGent: Evaluate-then-Grow Planning for Deep Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39154)
*Hanwen Liu,Yuanfu Sun,Qiaoyu Tan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出DAGent框架，通过“评估后生长”增量规划策略和DAGRPO结构化强化学习算法，解决现有DAG多智能体系统在深度研究中计划僵化和计算浪费的问题，显著提升了多基准测试的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于有向无环图（DAG）的多智能体系统采用“先计划后修补”策略，在执行前实例化完整任务计划，仅在失败或缺失证据时进行修复。这种策略在深度研究场景中具有脆弱性：系统在证据最弱时承诺度最高，且后续修订会在本不应规划的分支上浪费计算资源。

Method: 1. **DAGent框架**：采用“评估后生长”（Evaluate-then-Grow）的增量规划方法，由协调器（Orchestrator）根据已完成节点的置信度和不确定性信号，分批扩展任务图。
2. **分层上下文层**：默认传播紧凑的QueryDocs，同时保留完整的执行轨迹以供按需召回。
3. **DAGRPO算法**：一种针对GRPO的适配算法，注入拓扑条件信用给执行器（Executor） rollout，并对协调器计划施加结构合规正则化，利用记录下来的DAG拓扑提供结构化的强化学习信号。

Result: 1. 在BrowseComp-Plus、GAIA和xBench-DeepSearch基准测试中，DAGent在Qwen3-235B-A22B规模下分别超越最强开源基线5.3/5.8/2.0分。
2. 性能提升在四种开源骨干模型及GPT-5（327K上下文）中均得到复现。
3. 在Qwen3-8B规模下，DAGRPO相比同等预算的结果导向GRPO基线，平均Pass@1指标提升3.0分。
4. 相同架构对比显示，基于证据的条件规划比“先计划后修补”方案在更低的每任务token消耗、工具调用和步骤足迹下实现更高准确率。

Conclusion: DAGent通过增量规划和结构化强化学习，有效解决了深度研究中多智能体系统的计划僵化问题，实现了更高的准确性和计算效率。

Abstract: Deep research tasks require agents to navigate large knowledge spaces, synthesize evidence across many sources, and adapt their plans as findings emerge. Directed acyclic graph (DAG)-based multi-agent systems suit this setting because they support parallel execution and isolate each sub-task within a focused dependency context. Yet existing DAG-based agents instantiate a task-level plan before execution and repair the graph only after failures or missing evidence are observed. This Plan-then-Patch strategy is brittle for deep research: the system commits most strongly when its evidence is weakest, and later revisions waste computation on branches that should not have been planned. We propose DAGent, a DAG-based multi-agent framework with Evaluate-then-Grow incremental planning: an Orchestrator grows the task graph one batch at a time, conditioning each expansion on confidence and uncertainty signals from completed nodes. A hierarchical context layer propagates compact QueryDocs by default while preserving full execution traces for on-demand recall. The recorded DAG topology admits structural RL signals that outcome-only recipes cannot define; DAGRPO, a GRPO adaptation, injects topology-conditioned credit on Executor rollouts and a structural compliance regularization on Orchestrator plans. Across BrowseComp-Plus, GAIA, and xbench-DeepSearch, DAGent surpasses the strongest open-source baseline by 5.3 / 5.8 / 2.0 points at the Qwen3-235B-A22B scale, and the lead replicates across four open-source backbones and extends to GPT-5 at 327K context. At the Qwen3-8B scale, DAGRPO improves over a same-budget outcome-only GRPO baseline by 3.0 average Pass@1 points. A same-architecture comparison shows that evidence-conditioned planning reaches higher accuracy at lower per-task token, tool-call, and step footprints than its Plan-then-Patch counterpart. Code: https://github.com/hanwenliu6825/DAGent

</details>


### [250] [ViLegalExpert: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Vietnamese Legal Retrieval and Question Answering from Real-World Consultations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39189)
*Dat Tien Nguyen,Nghia Hieu Nguyen,Anh Thi-Hoang Nguyen,Dung Ha Nguyen,Kiet Van Nguyen,Ngan Luu-Thuy Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ViLegalExpert，一个包含17.2万+问题、覆盖34个法律领域的越南法律基准，旨在解决现有基准覆盖不足的问题，推动可信越南法律AI发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的越南法律基准对真实世界法律咨询的覆盖有限，无法满足可信法律AI系统基于权威来源回答法律问题的需求。

Method: 从真实的公民-律师咨询中构建大规模基准ViLegalExpert，包含172K+问题、34个法律领域、专业答案及专家验证的法律证据；支持法律信息检索、抽取式QA和生成式QA任务。

Result: 实验显示证据检索和 grounded 答案生成存在显著挑战；预训练模型在QA任务上表现强劲，混合检索在证据检索方面效果最佳；自然语言法律问答难以映射到权威条款。

Conclusion: ViLegalExpert是一个具有挑战性的基准，有助于评估和提升越南法律AI系统的可靠性与真实性。

Abstract: Trustworthy Legal AI requires systems that can answer legal questions while grounding their responses in authoritative sources. However, existing Vietnamese legal benchmarks provide limited coverage of real-world legal consultations. We introduce \textbf{ViLegalExpert}, a large-scale benchmark constructed from authentic citizen--lawyer consultations, containing over \textbf{172K} questions across \textbf{34 legal domains}, together with professional answers and expert-verified legal evidence. ViLegalExpert supports legal information retrieval, extractive QA, and abstractive QA. Experiments with representative retrieval methods and language models reveal substantial challenges in evidence retrieval and grounded answer generation. While pretrained models perform strongly on QA, hybrid retrieval achieves the best retrieval performance. These results demonstrate the difficulty of mapping naturally expressed legal questions to authoritative provisions and establish ViLegalExpert as a challenging benchmark for reliable Vietnamese Legal AI.

</details>


### [251] [RAIM: Robust Aggregation of Inexpensive Models for Hallucination Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39229)
*Elia Onofri,Roberto Di Pietro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出RAIM聚合方案，利用廉价开源小模型面板替代昂贵的前沿大模型进行忠实度自动评估，在保持93%性能的同时大幅降低推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决前沿专有大模型作为评估裁判时成本高、吞吐量低的问题，探索廉价开源模型能否有效替代。

Method: 提出RAIM（Robust Aggregation of Inconsistent Models），结合交叉拟合堆叠逻辑回归与可接受性测试，通过校准集判断聚合是否优于单一最佳成员且接近前沿水平。

Result: 在Claude Sonnet面前保留中位数93%的Cohen's κ；以1/64的推理成本实现竞争力；在部分基准上优于专用检测器，且能根据误差分布动态选择最优策略。

Conclusion: 当多个能力较强的成员错误分布不同时，聚合效果显著；若存在主导成员则回退到该领导者。通过校准集审计即可低成本决定何时使用廉价面板替代前沿模型。

Abstract: Automatic evaluation of faithfulness increasingly relies on a large language model acting as a judge, yet the most reliable judges are proprietary frontier models, costly and ill-suited to high-throughput monitoring. We investigate whether a panel of cheap open-weight judges (4--9B) can be aggregated to stand in for a frontier one, what the substitution sacrifices, and when it is worth making. We propose RAIM, an aggregation scheme robust to the members' correlated errors, coupling a cross-fitted stacked logistic regression with an admissibility test that, read from the members' own outputs, identifies when aggregating them improves on their best member and stays within reach of the frontier judge. We instantiate RAIM with ten judges from disjoint families across eight faithfulness benchmarks. Against Claude Sonnet, the panel retains a median 93% of its Cohen's $κ$ and gives up only 2.9 points of balanced accuracy on average; read as paired differences, it clearly improves on one benchmark and clearly worsens on three (only two by a non-negligible margin), leaving four unresolved. At a sixty-fourth of the frontier's inference price, the operative expense is a one-time in-domain calibration on 50--100 labelled records. The panel is also competitive with purpose-trained detectors on their home benchmarks (within 1.3 accuracy points of GPT-4o and 1.9 of the LLM-AggreFact leader), and beats the strongest one we reran by 6 points on our grounded sets. Whether aggregation pays depends on the members themselves: where several capable members err on different items, the panel improves on its best judge and approaches the frontier; where one dominates, the stacker recovers the leader, and only there does the frontier remain materially ahead. Both conditions are read off the calibration set at no further cost, so a cheap panel can stand in for a frontier one wherever this audit admits it.

</details>


### [252] [4MT-VLM: How Coarse Is a VLMs Cognitive Map?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39238)
*Markus Frey*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出4MT-VLM数据集与基准，测试VLM在视角变化下的空间识别能力。发现当前模型虽具初步认知地图，但空间分辨率粗糙，视角改变后无法维持稳定3D理解，性能远低于人类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决智能体在从未见过的视角下识别地点的问题，并评估现有视觉语言模型（VLM）的空间泛化与认知地图能力。

Method: 构建包含五种刺激模式（移除外观线索但保持布局固定）的程序生成景观数据集4MT-VLM；在16个开源和闭源模型上进行测试，采用4AFC（四选一强制选择）作为评估指标，模拟人类临床测试条件。

Result: 模型能从研究视角识别地点，但相机移动后性能急剧下降，在135°旋转时低于25%随机水平（人类为85%）。前沿模型（Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.6）在旋转试验中正确率仅39%-31%，仅在干扰物距离超过30米时才有所恢复。

Conclusion: 当前VLM拥有初级认知地图，但其空间分辨率过于粗糙，无法在视角变化后维持对世界的稳定、三维理解。

Abstract: An agent that moves must recognise a place from a viewpoint it has never seen. We introduce 4MT-VLM, a dataset of procedurally generated landscapes, each rendered across five stimulus modes that remove appearance cues while holding layout fixed: shape and colour, shape only, colour only, bare terrain peaks with no objects, and a valley viewpoint that puts the peaks on the horizon. The last condition is commonly used in clinics to probe hippocampal function in human patients. We test this benchmark across sixteen different open and closed-source models and report 4AFC performance, a measure which is also used to grade human participants. We observe that models identify a place from the studied viewpoint but lose it once the camera moves, dropping below the 25% chance level at 135° where a human observer scores 85%. Frontier models (Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.6) answer only 39% and 31% of rotated trials correctly, recovering to 85% and 55% only when distractors are moved more than 30 meters apart. Our benchmark demonstrates that while current VLMs possess rudimentary cognitive maps, their spatial resolution remains fundamentally too coarse to maintain a stable, 3D understanding of the world once the viewpoint changes.

</details>


### [253] [Concept Subspaces Compute Beyond the Logit Lens: A Weights-Only Test for Locating Representations Upstream of Readout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39263)
*Aojie Yuan,Zhiyuan Julian Su,Haiyue Zhang,Zijian Su*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种双向几何诊断方法，用于评估提取的概念子空间与模型输出解码方向的关系。通过对比发现，现有的概念估计器（如FARS）在主导读出方向的能量占比极低，远低于最后一层PCA和下一词元控制，表明概念结构与主导读出方向存在显著分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究虽已建立概念子空间对模型行为的影响，但缺乏对其与输出读出（output readout）之间关系的明确度量，导致难以区分概念结构本身与主导读出方向，从而限制了因果充分性的主张。

Method: 引入“双向几何诊断”，测量提取子空间与未嵌入矩阵（unembedding matrix）主要右奇异方向的重叠度，并以面向输出的正向对照为基准。测试集包括格式无关推理子空间（FARS），并在九个秩匹配估计器和二十六个模型上进行评估，辅以干预研究验证因果效应。

Result: 1. 激活衍生的概念估计器在顶级读出跨度中的平均能量仅占0.38%–0.80%；2. 最后一层PCA能量占比为3.56%，在25/26模型中超过FARS；3. 同一层的下一词元控制能量约为FARS的十三倍，且在所有测试模型中均有区分度；4. FARS在不同概念上重提取时表现出高跨格式检索率（62%–100%），证明提取过程的转移性而非固定基；5. 干预研究显示模型依赖的源导向效应，但远低于全向量替换的效果。

Conclusion: 几何分析与干预控制共同证实了概念结构与主导读出方向的可区分性，同时指出当前方法在确立因果充分性方面的局限性，强调需结合多种控制手段来严谨解释概念子空间的机制。

Abstract: A concept subspace's effect on model behavior does not establish how it relates to the output readout. We introduce a two-sided geometric diagnostic that measures an extracted subspace's overlap with the dominant right-singular directions of the unembedding matrix, evaluated against output-oriented positive controls. Given an extracted basis, the raw diagnostic requires only model weights. Our testbed is the Format-Agnostic Reasoning Subspace (FARS), a ten-dimensional basis extracted from eighteen reasoning concepts expressed in six surface forms. Across nine rank-matched estimators and twenty-six models, four activation-derived concept estimators carry only 0.38--0.80% mean energy in the top-ten readout span. Final-layer PCA carries 3.56%, exceeding FARS in 25 of 26 models. A same-layer next-token control, evaluated using a fitted linear translator for depth matching, carries approximately thirteen times more energy than FARS, with separation in all 25 tested models. Re-extracting FARS on ten disjoint concepts yields 62--100% cross-format retrieval across twenty-four generative models, demonstrating transfer of the extraction procedure rather than a fixed basis. A complementary four-model, three-seed intervention study finds model-dependent source-directed effects that remain well below full-vector replacement. Together, the geometry and intervention controls distinguish concept structure from dominant readout directions while limiting claims of causal sufficiency.

</details>


### [254] [Offline Guidance, Online Reasoning: Reusing LLM Feedback for Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39346)
*Bohan Zhang,Linan Yue,Weibo Gao,Pengyu Chen,Hong Guo,Yanqi Hao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出RLC方法，将黑盒大模型的一次性自然语言指导转化为小模型隐藏空间中的持久纠错经验，实现离线获取、在线复用，无需参数更新或在线调用大模型即可提升小模型推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决大模型推理强但成本高、小模型易部署但推理弱的能力-部署差距；现有知识蒸馏需额外训练，在线协作需重复访问大模型且无法复用指导信息。

Method: 提出可重用潜在纠错（RLC）机制：离线利用黑盒大模型生成自然语言指导，将其转换为小模型隐藏空间中的持久纠错经验并存储于外部库；推理时根据小模型当前推理状态检索这些经验，实现纠错经验的在线复用。

Result: 在多个推理基准测试和不同规模的小语言模型上，RLC在不进行参数更新且无在线大模型调用的情况下， consistently 提升了小模型的推理性能。

Conclusion: RLC有效弥合了大模型与小模型之间的能力差距，提供了一种低成本、高效率的LLM-SLM协同范式，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities but are often costly to access through commercial APIs, while small language models (SLMs) are easier to deploy locally yet remain weaker in reasoning. This capability-deployment gap has motivated LLM-SLM collaboration, which aims to improve SLM reasoning using LLM capabilities while preserving the deployment advantages of SLMs. Existing approaches mainly follow two paradigms. Knowledge distillation uses LLM-generated answers and reasoning trajectories to train SLMs offline, but requires parameter updates and additional training. Alternatively, online collaboration routes difficult problems to an LLM or leverages LLM-generated guidance and corrections when an SLM encounters difficulties. Although effective, online collaboration requires repeated LLM access. Moreover, the guidance produced for a particular problem is discarded after inference and cannot benefit subsequent problems involving similar reasoning states. In the paper, we focus on a more constrained setting in which the LLM is accessed only offline, the SLM parameters remain fixed, and online inference is performed solely by the SLM. To this end, we propose Reusable Latent Correction (RLC), which converts one-off natural-language guidance from a black-box LLM into persistent corrective experiences in the hidden space of an SLM. RLC stores these experiences in an external bank and retrieves them according to the SLM's current reasoning state, enabling the SLM to reuse LLM-derived corrections during inference without any online LLM calls. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks and SLM scales show that RLC consistently improves SLM reasoning without parameter updates or online LLM calls. Code is available at https://github.com/ZBH031/reusable-latent-correction.

</details>


### [255] [Ready2Blend: From Natural-Language Instructions to Composable Alignment Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39365)
*Jeesu Jung,Hwan Chang,Juseon Do,Jeonghwan Choi,Jinho Choo,Sungwoo Nam,S. K. Hong,Hwanjun Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Ready2Blend，一种结合自然语言灵活性与学习对齐的持续对齐方法。通过AlignFormer将需求映射为固定长度提示并存储在模块化提示库中，保持主干网络冻结。利用组合正则化实现推理时的提示混合与重加权，在仅用少量提示token和更少训练时间的情况下，达到接近联合训练的性能水平，同时支持免重训的个人化和无顺序组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决大语言模型（LLMs）在持续对齐中适应新需求而不遗忘旧行为的问题。现有方法中，自然语言指令灵活但控制力间接，后训练提供强适应性但需重复参数更新且成本高。旨在结合两者优势，实现高效、灵活的持续对齐。

Method: 1. **Ready2Blend框架**：结合自然语言灵活性与学习对齐。
2. **AlignFormer**：将每个需求映射为固定长度的对齐提示，存入模块化提示库。
3. **冻结主干**：主干模型和先前提示保持冻结，避免灾难性遗忘和高昂的计算成本。
4. **组合正则化**：将文本需求的语义几何结构转移到提示空间，支持推理时的提示混合与重加权。
5. **模块化设计**：支持加权个人化和无顺序组合，无需重新训练。

Result: 在两个实际持续对齐设置中，Ready2Blend是唯一的冻结主干方法，其性能达到联合训练参考基准的93.1%-98.5%，具有竞争力的记忆保留能力。相比后训练方法，它仅需少量提示token，训练时间减少高达4.3倍。

Conclusion: Ready2Blend提供了一种高效、灵活的持续对齐解决方案，通过冻结主干和模块化提示机制，在保持高性能的同时显著降低计算资源消耗，并支持无需重训的动态个性化和组合功能。

Abstract: Continual alignment requires LLMs to adapt to new requirements without forgetting previously acquired behaviors. Natural-language instructions are flexible and composable but offer only indirect control, whereas post-training provides stronger adaptation at the cost of repeated parameter updates. We introduce Ready2Blend, which combines the flexibility of natural language with learned alignment. AlignFormer maps each requirement to a fixed-length alignment prompt stored in a modular prompt bank, while the backbone and prior prompts remain frozen. Composability regularization transfers the semantic geometry of textual requirements into prompt space, enabling inference-time blending and reweighting. Across two practical continual alignment settings, Ready2Blend is the only frozen-backbone method that matches post-training-based alignment methods, reaching $93.1$-$98.5\%$ of a joint-training reference with competitive retention, while requiring only a few prompt tokens and up to $4.3\times$ less training time. Its modular design further enables weighted personalization and order-free composition without retraining. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [256] [Making Grid Beam Search Less Greedy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39368)
*Sean Papay,Roman Klinger*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出“公平网格束搜索”（Fair Grid Beam Search），解决现有网格束搜索在强制词汇约束时存在的偏差问题，同时保持线性计算复杂度并提升生成概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的两种主要解码范式DFA约束束搜索和网格束搜索中，前者计算成本高（前向传播次数随约束token数指数增长），后者虽快但存在偏差：倾向于先满足易满足的约束，将难约束留到最后，导致生成质量不均。

Method: 提出“公平网格束搜索”，这是对传统网格束搜索的改进方法，旨在消除其内在的选择偏差，同时仅需要线性数量的前向传播调用。

Result: 实验证实了网格束搜索确实存在约束排序偏差；相比之下，公平网格束搜索不仅消除了这种偏差，还在两项受限生成任务中找到了概率更高的文本字符串。

Conclusion: 公平网格束搜索是一种更优的解码策略，它在保持高效线性计算复杂度的同时，解决了网格束搜索的不公平性，从而提升了受限文本生成的整体质量。

Abstract: A common formalism for constraining the output of autoregressive text generation models involves lexical constraints, words or phrases which are required to occur in the generated text. DFA-constrained beam search and grid beam search are two widely used paradigms for decoding from autoregressive models while enforcing lexical constraints. As the former approach requires a number of forward passes exponential in the number of constraint tokens, it is often dispreferred to the latter, which requires only linearly many forward calls. However, while grid beam search achieves an exponential speedup, it does so in a manner which does not treat all of the constraints equally. In this paper, we demonstrate that grid beam search is biased to incorporate easier-to-satisfy constraints first, leaving harder constraints to the end of the sequence. This contrasts with DFA-constrained beam search, which exhibits no such bias. To address this shortcoming, we propose fair grid beam search, a modification to grid beam search which avoids this bias while still requiring only linearly many forward passes. Experimentally, we confirm grid beam search's bias on two constrained generation tasks, finding significant differences in how it orders constraint tokens as compared to DFA-constrained beam search and fair grid beam search. Furthermore, we find that fair grid beam search not only fixes grid beam search's bias, but finds higher-probability strings in the process.

</details>


### [257] [Exploring Heterogeneous Model Merging Approach for Complex Knowledge Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39369)
*Jiahe Fan,Si Chen,Yinghao Hou,Wenbo Xia,Ke Xu,Hong Xie,Enhong Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了无需训练、蒸馏或语义对齐的“异构合并”方法，将专业模型的能力直接转移到通用语言模型的参数层面。通过Intersection-Merge (IM)和Activate-Prune-Merge (APM两种现有方法，成功实现了从专家模型到通用模型的跨架构能力迁移，证明了简单异构合并的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上，将面向任务的专业模型行为转移到通用语言模型通常需要复杂的训练、知识蒸馏或表示对齐过程。本文旨在探索是否可以在不依赖梯度更新或语义对齐的情况下，直接在参数层面实现这种能力的转移，以简化流程并提高效率。

Method: 应用两种现有的无训练异构合并方法：1. Intersection-Merge (IM)：通过注入与接收者形状匹配的前缀对齐捐赠者切片来实现；2. Activate-Prune-Merge (APM)：利用前向传播激活统计信息选择保留哪些捐赠者维度，然后进行注入。这两种方法均不涉及梯度更新或语义对齐，仅对骨干参数进行插值。

Result: 在嵌入（embedding）、重排序（reranking）、奖励建模（reward modeling）以及混合专家（MoE）代码专家等多个领域的迁移实验中，IM和APM方法均能提升通用接收者的性能。结果表明，简单的异构合并能够跨越不同的专家角色移动能力。

Conclusion: 无需训练的异构合并方法可以有效实现从专业模型到通用语言模型的能力转移，为模型整合提供了一种高效且无需额外训练成本的新途径。

Abstract: Specialized models encode task-oriented behavior, but transferring that behavior to a general language model usually requires training, distillation, or representation alignment. We study whether such ability can instead be transferred directly at the parameter level. We apply two existing training-free heterogeneous merging methods, previously shown to transfer knowledge between general language models, to specialist-to-general transfer, projecting a specialist donor into the recipient's shape and interpolating backbone parameters without gradient updates or semantic alignment. Intersection-Merge (IM) injects a prefix-aligned donor slice matching the recipient shape, while Activate-Prune-Merge (APM) uses forward-pass activation statistics to select which donor dimensions to retain before injection. Across embedding, reranking, reward modeling, and MoE code-specialist transfer, both methods improve the general recipient, showing that simple heterogeneous merging can move capabilities across diverse specialist roles.

</details>


### [258] [TTLab at Daleel 2026: STAR-Ar, Sequence Tagging for Argument Recognition in Arabic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39385)
*Bhuvanesh Verma,Ali Abusaleh,Alexander Mehler*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出STAR-Ar模型（BERT-BiLSTM-CRF）用于阿拉伯语论点挖掘，在Daleel 2026共享任务中实现73.7%的F1分数，并发现辩论数据集优于社论数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语论点挖掘（AM）资源匮乏，需解决辩论和社论文本中论点话语单元（ADU）的检测与分类问题。

Method: 采用BERT-BiLSTM-CRF架构，将ADU识别与分类联合建模为token级序列标注任务，结合上下文Transformer嵌入与结构转换约束以支持精确跨度检测。

Result: 验证集F1得分为72.69，测试集F1得分为73.7；领域特定分析显示，仅使用社论数据训练的模型表现低于使用辩论数据训练的模型，主要归因于社论数据集规模较小。

Conclusion: STAR-Ar有效解决了阿拉伯语论点检测与分类任务，且数据源类型（辩论vs社论）显著影响模型性能，代码已开源。

Abstract: Argument Mining (AM) is a critical NLP task that remains significantly under-resourced in Arabic. This paper presents $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$, a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture for argument discourse detection and classification, as our system for Daleel 2026, the inaugural Arabic argument mining shared task. The task requires the identification and classification of argumentative discourse units (ADUs) in debate and editorial texts.We jointly model these two objectives as a token-level sequence labeling task using a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture that combines contextual transformer embeddings with structural transition constraints to support accurate span detection. $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ achieves an F1-score of 72.69 on validation and 73.7 on test data. Our domain-specific analysis shows that models trained exclusively on editorials underperform those trained on debates, a disparity we primarily attribute to the smaller size of the editorial dataset. The code for $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ is available at ${\href{https://github.com/ENTAILab/daleel_2026_Arabic-Argumentative-Discourse-Mining}{\faGithub~TTLab at Daleel 2026}}$

</details>


### [259] [QuantCode Model: Specializing Language Models for Executable Algorithmic Trading Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39420)
*Alexey Chernysh,Orkhan Ekhtibarov,Dmitry Zmitrovich*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究通过持续预训练和监督微调（SFT）优化大语言模型在算法交易代码生成中的表现。基于QuantCode-Bench基准测试，发现SFT能显著提升策略生成的正确率和回测成功率，而持续预训练虽提升单次通过率但可能损害多轮交互能力。研究还揭示了领域专业化导致的工具调用能力退化问题及恢复方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型虽具备通用代码生成能力，但在可执行算法交易这一高度专业化的场景中面临挑战：需将自然语言策略准确转化为特定交易框架的正确程序逻辑，并在历史数据上执行产生交易，同时保持语义忠实性。现有模型在此专用领域的性能仍有待提升。

Method: 1. 提出两种互补机制：在算法交易框架代码上进行持续预训练，以及在代理验证的请求-代码对上进行监督微调（SFT）。
2. 构建并评估基准：使用包含400个任务的QuantCode-Bench（针对Backtrader策略生成）及类SWE-bench的仓库级跟踪进行评估。
3. 实验对象：Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 和 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 模型。
4. 评估指标：Judge Pass率、成功回测率、单轮及多轮（最多10轮）代理交互成功率。

Result: 1. 持续预训练：Qwen3.5-397B-A17B的Judge Pass从41.5%提升至47.5%；Qwen3.6-35B-A3B从27.8%提升至33.0%。但仅靠持续预训练会降低修复后的最终代理成功率（从47.5%降至32.5%），表明指令跟随能力下降。
2. SFT效果：在持续预训练后应用SFT对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B效果显著，Judge Pass达58.2%，成功回测率达83.5%。单轮代理成功率从22.3%升至58.3%，最终成功率从47.5%升至79.5%。
3. 能力保留失败：领域专业化导致解析器合规的结构化工具调用能力退化；目标恢复SFT可恢复工具调用格式，但无法完全恢复基础检查点的仓库级代理性能。

Conclusion: 面向框架的预训练、经验证的监督微调以及显式的能力保留评估，分别解决了领域特定可执行代码生成中的不同失效模式。结合这两种机制能有效提升模型在算法交易场景下的代码生成准确性与执行可靠性。

Abstract: Large language models are strong general-purpose code generators, but executable algorithmic trading remains a demanding specialization target: a model must translate a natural-language strategy specification into correct program logic for a specialized trading framework, execute on historical data, produce trades, and remain semantically faithful to the request. We study two complementary mechanisms for specializing language models for this setting: continued pretraining on algorithmic-trading framework code and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on agent-validated request-to-code pairs. Evaluation is centered on QuantCode-Bench, our 400-task benchmark for Backtrader strategy generation, together with a repository-level SWE-bench-like track. Continued pretraining improves single-turn Judge Pass from 41.5% to 47.5% for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and from 27.8% to 33.0% for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. SFT applied after continued pretraining yields a larger gain for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, reaching 58.2% Judge Pass and 83.5% successful backtests; in agentic evaluation it raises first-turn success from 22.3% to 58.3% and final success after up to 10 turns from 47.5% to 79.5%. Continued pretraining alone improves first-turn agentic success but lowers final success after repair from 47.5% to 32.5%, consistent with degraded instruction following, whereas SFT improves both. We also identify a capability-retention failure: domain specialization degrades parser-conformant structured tool calling, and targeted recovery SFT restores tool-call formatting but not the base checkpoint's repository-level agent performance. The results show that framework-oriented pretraining, validated SFT, and explicit capability-retention evaluation address distinct failure modes in domain-specific executable code generation.

</details>


### [260] [DuplexAct-Bench: Broadening Full-Duplex Speech Evaluation toward Proactive Interaction across Diverse Behavioral Requirements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39446)
*Keyue Xing,Wentao Ding,Mengmeng Wang,Wenming Tu,Zilong Zheng,Yipeng Kang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出DuplexAct-Bench，一个涵盖六种互补行为的双语全双工语音基准，评估12个系统在时序和内容上的表现，揭示当前系统在处理实时交互时机和行为上存在显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全双工语音基准仅覆盖实时交互行为的子集，且通常在有限的语境条件下进行，无法全面反映真实交互场景。

Method: 构建包含Pre-session、In-session和No-explicit三种条件的双语（英/中）基准，涵盖中断、让步、主动发起、主动沉默及后援反馈等六种互补行为；对1,290个流式试验中的12个全双工语音系统进行时序和内容维度的评估。

Result: 不同行为、条件和系统间表现差异显著；语义质量与行为时序之间频繁不匹配；现有系统尚无法稳健地管理实时交互中的参与时机、意愿及方式。

Conclusion: 当前全双工语音系统在模拟真实实时交互的行为鲁棒性方面仍有巨大提升空间，需同时优化语义质量与时序控制。

Abstract: Existing full-duplex speech benchmarks cover only subsets of real-time interaction behaviors, often under limited contextual conditions. We introduce DuplexAct-Bench, a bilingual benchmark that systematically covers six complementary behaviors, from interruption and yielding to proactive initiation, active silence, and backchanneling, across Pre-session, In-session, and No-explicit conditions. Across 1,290 English and Chinese streaming trials, we evaluate 12 full-duplex speech systems on both Timing and Content. Results reveal substantial variation across behaviors, conditions, and systems, as well as frequent mismatches between semantic quality and behavioral timing. These findings show that current systems remain far from robustly managing when, whether, and how to participate as real-time interaction unfolds. Project page: https://alitaxky.icu/DuplexAct-Bench/

</details>


### [261] [Synthetic Data Characterization via Training Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39447)
*Irene Lago,Ana Ezquerro,David Vilares*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究通过样本级可学习性指标，对比分析了LLM生成数据与人类撰写数据在不同分类任务中的分布特征及鲁棒性，并评估了基于此的数据选择策略对两类数据源的不同影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解大语言模型（LLM）生成数据的效用和局限性对于掌握其在各类学习任务中的表现至关重要。

Method: 首先生成涵盖单标签/多标签分类、标注和树预测任务的合成数据集；其次，从编码器训练动态中推导机器生成数据与自然数据的经验数据分布，并估计这些分布在不同编码器间的鲁棒性；最后，评估基于可学习性信号的数据选择策略对两种数据源的影响差异。

Result: 研究揭示了LLM家族和规模变化下的合成数据特性，并通过训练动态建立了机器数据与自然数据的可比分布，验证了基于可学习性的数据筛选方法能有效区分并利用不同来源的数据优势。

Conclusion: 通过量化合成数据的样本级可学习性，为评估和优化LLM生成数据在机器学习任务中的应用提供了实证依据和方法论支持。

Abstract: Interpreting properties of LLM-generated data is important for understanding its utility and limitations across learning tasks. In this work, we characterize synthetic data through sample-level learnability, studying variation among LLM families and scales, alongside human-written data as a reference. We first generate synthetic datasets spanning single- and multi-label classification, labeling, and tree prediction tasks. We then derive empirical data distributions from encoder training dynamics for both machine and organic data, and estimate the robustness of these distributions across encoders. Finally, we evaluate how data selection strategies based on these learnability signals affect both data sources differently.

</details>


### [262] [Right-Wing Rock or Just Rock? A Computational Linguistic Analysis of Frei.Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39460)
*Carlotta Schneeberger,Kevin Tang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究通过计算语言学方法分析德国乐队Frei.Wild的音乐文本，旨在解决其政治倾向的界定难题。研究证实该乐队虽保持政治模糊性，但倾向于右翼光谱；基于高达97% ROC-AUC的分类器识别出超过半数歌曲具有右翼极端主义特征，展示了计算方法在辅助监管边界案例中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对传播右翼意识形态的Rechtsrock亚文化，监管机构常因“边界案例”难以定性而面临监管困境。本研究旨在明确特定乐队（Frei.Wild）究竟属于一般德国摇滚乐还是右翼政治倾向，以支持更精准的内容监管。

Method: 构建德语摇滚数据集及右翼摇滚语料库作为参考基准；对目标乐队Frei.Wild的歌曲进行词汇分析，识别民族主义叙事；训练并应用高性能分类器对其歌曲进行政治倾向自动分类。

Result: 1. 确认Frei.Wild在政治归属上保持策略性模糊，但整体倾向右翼光谱；2. 词汇分析揭示其歌词中存在民族主义叙事；3. 两个高性能分类器（最高ROC-AUC达97%）判定其超过半数的歌曲属于右翼极端主义范畴。

Conclusion: 计算方法能有效提升对音乐中右翼极端主义倾向的识别能力，特别是在处理如Frei.Wild这类具有政治模糊性的边界案例时，为监管机构的决策提供了量化依据和技术支持。

Abstract: Rechtsrock is a subgenre of rock music that spreads right-wing ideology, often instrumentalized to recruit adolescents into the radical scene. Monitoring institutions counteract this by manually examining and, in some cases, banning extremist content; however, there are border cases that evade regulation. We present a study aimed at determining whether such a case, the band Frei.Wild, should be classified as politically right-leaning or as part of the general German rock genre. We sampled a German rock dataset and created a corpus for right-wing rock to use as reference in this analysis and found that we can confirm the intuitions from previous investigations that Frei.Wild successfully maintains an ambiguity with regard to their political affiliation. However, the tendency is towards the right-wing spectrum. Lexical analyses reveal nationalistic narratives and two high-performing classifiers (up to 97% ROC-AUC score) label more than half of their songs as right-wing extremist. Our analysis provides insight into how computational methods can improve the process of identifying right-wing extremist tendencies in music, especially in borderline cases like Frei.Wild. The code and data are made available for future research.

</details>


### [263] [Spike-driven Vision-Language-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39514)
*Shuai Wang,Malu Zhang,Mingquan Liu,Weihui Dai,Dehao Zhang,Jieyuan Zhang,Yimeng Shan,Zijian Zhou,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出首个基于脉冲神经网络的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架Spike-driven VLA，通过稀疏事件驱动计算实现资源受限平台上的高效机器人操控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主流VLA模型依赖大型Transformer，导致高延迟和高能耗，难以部署在资源受限平台上；脉冲神经网络（SNNs凭借稀疏事件驱动特性，为高性能、低能耗计算提供了新范式。

Method: 构建包含三个核心组件的端到端直接训练框架：1. 开发脉冲视觉与指令编码器，将多模态输入编码为稀疏可靠的脉冲表示；2. 引入多赢家脉冲融合机制，利用双向top-k竞争神经元路由抑制背景干扰并生成融合记忆；3. 设计脉冲动作分块Transformer，结合融合记忆与当前机器人状态进行脉冲交叉注意力计算，生成连续动作块。

Result: 在LIBERO和Meta-World基准测试中，该模型以较少的参数数量和更低的预估推理能耗，实现了与传统VLA模型具有竞争力的性能表现。

Conclusion: 确立了神经形态VLA建模的基础框架，为实现资源高效的具身智能奠定了重要基础。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bridge multimodal understanding and robotic control, advancing the dominant paradigm for embodied intelligence. However, most existing models rely on large Transformers, whose latency and energy costs hinder deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Through sparse event-driven computation, spiking neural networks offer a promising paradigm for high-performance and energy-efficient computing. Here, we propose the first Spike-driven VLA framework enabling end-to-end direct training for robotic manipulation, which mainly comprises three core components. First, we develop spiking visual and instruction encoders for multimodal perception, encoding visual observations and language instructions into sparse, reliable spike representations for subsequent cross-modal fusion. Then, we introduce Multi-Winner Spike Fusion for instruction-guided scene understanding, using bidirectional top-$k$ winner-take-all spike routing to suppress background interference and yield fused memory. Finally, we propose a Spike Action Chunking Transformer that incorporates spiking cross-attention over the fused memory and the current robot state, enabling efficient end-to-end generation of continuous action chunks for robotic control. Extensive experiments on LIBERO and Meta-World demonstrate that Spike-driven VLA achieves competitive performance with fewer parameters and lower estimated inference energy than conventional VLA models. This work establishes a foundational framework for neuromorphic VLA modeling, paving the way for future advances in resource-efficient embodied intelligence.

</details>


### [264] [CATCH: A Controllable Analysis Testbed for Reward Hacking in Coding RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39533)
*Shouli Wang,Yanfeng Jia,Zhihao Ou,Zitao Su,Ruize He,Haotong Xie,Hao Peng,Juanzi Li,Xiaozhi Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CATCH，一个用于研究编码强化学习中奖励黑客行为的可控测试平台。该平台通过暴露环境漏洞和提供执行级金标准标签来重现和识别奖励黑客行为，并支持对初始黑客倾向和奖励难度进行控制。实验表明，CATCH能产生多样化的训练轨迹，揭示了模型初始状态和奖励难度对黑客行为的影响，并发现思维链监控器的防护效果会随策略模型学会利用代码注释欺骗监控器而减弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，大语言模型可能利用环境漏洞获取高奖励而不提升预期能力（即奖励黑客行为）。目前由于缺乏能重现黑客行为并可靠识别它的测试平台，监控和缓解这一过程中的奖励黑客行为面临挑战。

Method: 引入CATCH测试平台，通过以下方式工作：1) 故意暴露环境漏洞；2) 比较易受攻击评估器下的成功与独立审计下的任务正确性以提供基于执行的黄金标签；3) 通过监督微调数据混合控制模型的初始黑客倾向；4) 通过奖励设计控制获得奖励的难度，从而系统比较黑客动态和干预措施。

Result: 1. CATCH能产生具有明显奖励黑客行为的多样化RL训练轨迹。2. 初始模型和奖励难度共同影响奖励黑客行为的出现。3. 评估了不同检测和缓解方法的有效性。4. 关键发现：思维链（CoT）监控器初期能抑制黑客行为，但随着策略模型学会用代码注释误导监控器，这种保护作用会逐渐消失。

Conclusion: 需要在整个训练过程中使用CATCH来评估黑客缓解措施的有效性，因为现有的监控机制可能被模型适应并绕过。CATCH为研究、监测和缓解RLVR中的奖励黑客行为提供了必要的工具。

Abstract: During reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), large language models (LLMs) can exploit loopholes in their environments to obtain high rewards without improving the intended capabilities, i.e., reward hacking. Despite its risks to training efficiency and safety, monitoring and mitigating reward hacking during training remain challenging, which is limited by a lack of testbeds that reproduce hacking and reliably identify it. We introduce CATCH, a controllable testbed for studying reward hacking in coding RL. CATCH deliberately exposes environmental loopholes and provides execution-based gold labels by comparing success under a vulnerable evaluator with task correctness under an independent audit. It also can control the model's initial hacking tendency through supervised fine-tuning data mixtures and the difficulty of earning rewards through reward designing, enabling systematic comparisons of hacking dynamics and interventions. Experiments show that CATCH can produce diverse RL training trajectories with clear reward hacking, and analyses demonstrate that both initial models and reward difficulties shape the emergence of reward hacking. We further evaluate the effectiveness of different reward hacking detection and mitigation methods. A key finding is that a chain-of-thought monitor initially suppresses hacking, but this protection erodes as the policy model learn to mislead the monitor with code comments. This highlights the need to evaluate hacking mitigations throughout training with CATCH. The source code and resources are publicly released at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/CATCH.

</details>


### [265] [Compact Language, Complex Model Shifts: How and Where Ambiguity and Underspecification Affect LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39572)
*Michaela Regneri,Nina Scheller,Sören Laue*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究词汇歧义和未指定性对语言模型训练的影响，发现二者均能提升模型性能（与类型-标记比率相关），但会降低含歧义词序列的生成准确性；内部表示显示伪同义词会被消歧，而伪上位词的未指定性在生成过程中得以保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究词汇歧义（lexical ambiguity）和未指定性（underspecification）如何影响语言模型的训练过程、生成表现及内部表征机制。

Method: 创造人工同义词（artificial homonyms）和人工上位词（artificial hypernyms）作为伪词，分析语言模型在训练过程中处理这些模糊或未经指定的伪词类型的生成性能；通过监测模型是否消歧以及内部表示的变化，提供关于歧义和消歧如何在内部被表征的初步机制解释。

Result: 1. 歧义和未指定性均以随其影响语言的类型-标记比率（type-token ratio）缩放的方式提高模型性能。2. 包含歧义词或其同义词的序列生成准确率低于其他文本。3. 伪同义词的内部表示反映了消歧过程，而伪上位词的未指定性在生成过程中被维持。

Conclusion: 语言模型在处理歧义和未指定性时表现出复杂的权衡：虽然整体性能因增加词汇多样性（类型-标记比率）而提升，但在具体序列生成的准确性上存在代价；且模型对不同类型模糊性（同义vs上位）的处理机制不同，分别体现为消歧和保持未指定状态。

Abstract: We analyze how lexical ambiguity and underspecification affect language model training. We create artificial homonyms and artificial hypernyms as pseudowords and analyze the generative performance of language models as they are trained with increasing amounts of these ambiguous or underspecified pseudoword types. We further analyze whether the models disambiguate ambiguous or underspecified statements and provide a first mechanistic account of how ambiguity and disambiguation are represented internally. Our main results show that both ambiguity and underspecification increase model performance in ways that scale with their influence on the language's type-token ratio. However, the accuracy of generating sequences containing ambiguous words or their synonyms decreases compared to other texts. We also show that internal representations of pseudowords reflect disambiguation of pseudo-homonyms, but underspecification of pseudo-hypernyms is maintained during the generative process.

</details>


### [266] [Thinking Outside the Box: Can Language Models Rely on External Guidance Selectively?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39578)
*Minghan Wang,Boyuan Wang,Jinhang Zuo,Yuxin Tao,Fang kong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Box^2-Bench基准测试，研究语言模型在可靠与不可靠工作流引导下的行为。发现前沿模型虽受益于可靠引导，但在误导下仍脆弱。通过反事实SFT和基于结果的RL训练开放权重模型，提升了其对外部信息的选择性依赖能力，增强了鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着语言模型能力提升，由人类设计的Agent工作流若存在不可靠引导，会限制模型执行效果。需要探究模型如何在利用有用引导的同时，能够覆盖不可靠引导的能力（即“跳出盒子思考”）。

Method: 1. 引入Box^2-Bench基准：固定模型和任务，变化工作流可靠性，以隔离模型对引导的依赖调节机制。
2. 使用坏工作流数据训练两个开源模型，保留好工作流用于评估。
3. 探索两种互补训练策略：反事实监督微调（Counterfactual SFT）提升鲁棒性；基于结果的强化学习（Outcome-based RL）增加对有帮助工作流的使用倾向。
4. 验证该能力在其他外部信息形式（如同伴纠正、受损记忆）中的泛化性。

Result: 1. 前沿模型通常能从可靠引导中获益，但在引导误导或不可靠时表现脆弱。
2. 经过特定训练后，模型能更好地平衡对可靠与不可靠引导的依赖。
3. 反事实SFT提高了鲁棒性，而基于结果的RL增加了对外部有益信息的利用。
4. 这种选择性依赖能力可泛化至同伴纠正和抗干扰记忆等场景。

Conclusion: 对外部易错信息的选择性依赖是衡量Agent可靠性的一个重要维度，这一维度无法仅通过任务性能来捕捉。

Abstract: Agent harnesses often improve language models with human-designed workflows, but as models grow more capable, unreliable guidance can increasingly constrain their execution. We call the ability to benefit from useful guidance while overriding unreliable guidance thinking outside the box. We introduce Box$^2$-Bench, which holds the model and task fixed while varying workflow reliability to isolate how models regulate their reliance on guidance. On Box$^2$-Bench, frontier models often benefit from reliable guidance but remain vulnerable when it is misleading or becomes unreliable. To test whether this capability can be learned, we train two open-weight models using bad workflows, reserving good workflows for evaluation. We explore two complementary training strategies: counterfactual supervised fine-tuning improves robustness, while outcome-based reinforcement learning can shift the balance toward greater use of helpful workflows. We further find that this behavior extends beyond workflows to other forms of external information, improving peer correction and robustness to corrupted memory. Together, our results identify selective reliance on fallible external information as a dimension of agent reliability not captured by task performance alone.

</details>


### [267] [Is This Evidence Decision-Critical? Learning to Verify Rule-Governed Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39608)
*Haoyang Zhang,Jianpeng Zhao,Qi Hao,Pengyang Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出InterPact框架，通过基于干预的影响学习（counterfactual verification）识别规则决策中关键证据，提升模型在合规检查等场景下的准确性和安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于规则的推理任务（如资格核查、合同审查）中，语言模型需评估证据并依据明确规则做出判断。若忽视或误读关键证据，可能导致决策反转；而准确识别关键证据有助于增强模型对条件判断的检查能力，从而支持更准确、安全的决策。

Method: 提出InterPact（INTERvention-based imPACT learning framework），包含以下核心步骤：1）使用冻结的语言模型编辑案例事实生成训练对，保持规则和无关条件不变；2）人工审核标签记录条件和决策的变化；3）通过固定组合操作，将基于证据的条件概率加权到条件决策预测中，使验证器监督决策变化传播至基础模型；4）推理时，训练后的基础模型可直接从原始案例和目标证据中判断关键性，无需额外监督。

Result: 在适配的规则驱动决策案例上，InterPact在单案例证据关键性验证任务中达到68.28%的准确率，优于所有六个基线模型。

Conclusion: 学习到的决策敏感性可作为优先检查证据的基础，InterPct有效提升了模型在规则治理决策中对关键证据的识别能力。

Abstract: Rule-based reasoning, as in eligibility checks and contract reviews, requires language models to assess evidence against individual conditions and combine their judgments under explicit rules. Errors in evidence assessment can leave a decision unchanged, but misinterpreting or overlooking decision-critical evidence can reverse it. Identifying such evidence allows more capable models to focus on checking the corresponding condition judgments, supporting accurate and safe decisions. Recognizing the evidence's criticality requires understanding how evidence affects a condition judgment and how that judgment affects the decision. To achieve the goal, we propose a INTERvention-based imPACT learning framework (InterPact), which enables counterfactual verification of evidence criticality in rule-governed decisions. Specifically, its evidence intervention constructor generates training pairs for a propagation verifier by editing case facts with a frozen language model while holding rules and non-target conditions fixed. Human-reviewed labels record the resulting condition and decision changes, while complete state-to-decision mappings supervise consequences beyond the observed edit. During training, the verifier weights learned conditional decision predictions by evidence-based condition probabilities through a fixed composition operation, propagating decision-change supervision into the base model. At inference, the trained base model directly judges criticality from the original case and target evidence, without human or stronger-model supervision. On single-case evidence criticality verification over adapted rule-governed decision cases, InterPact achieves 68.28% accuracy, outperforming all six baselines. These results support learned decision sensitivity as a basis for prioritizing evidence checks.

</details>


### [268] [Marginal Response Surface Elicitation for Zero-Label Tabular Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39639)
*Liangyu Teng,Yicheng Ding,Jing Liu,Hengsong Liu,Juncen Guo,Hongru Li,Jingyu Zhang,Liang Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出MARS方法，利用大语言模型（LLM）从无标签数据中提取领域先验，构建零样本表格分类器，显著提升预测性能并降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统表格学习依赖标注数据，而LLM可根据任务描述和特征语义提供领域先验，实现无需标注数据的预测。现有直接提示方法成本高且性能有限，需更高效的方法利用LLM先验。

Method: 提出边际响应面提取（MARS）：从无标签数据中选取各特征的代表值，提示LLM生成类别支持得分和特征权重；通过中位数聚合多次响应构建特征响应函数，最终通过加权求和进行预测，无需进一步LLM查询。

Result: 在八个表格基准任务上，MARS取得最高的平均AUC和AP指标，分别比直接提示方法高出1.97和6.21个百分点，同时显著降低端到端成本；不同规模LLM的评估也验证了其相对于直接提示的预测优势。

Conclusion: MARS能有效将特征级LLM先验转化为可复用的零样本表格分类器，在性能和成本效益方面优于直接提示方法，为无监督/零样本表格学习提供了新范式。

Abstract: Tabular learning uses structured data to predict target outcomes. Traditionally, this process has relied on labeled data. However, large language models (LLMs) can be used to elicit domain priors based on the task description and feature semantics, thereby enabling predictions without labeled data. We propose Marginal Response Surface Elicitation (MARS), a method that transforms feature-level LLM priors into a reusable, zero-shot tabular classifier. To construct this classifier, MARS selects representative values for each feature from unlabeled data and prompts the LLM to provide corresponding class support scores and feature weights. It then aggregates multiple responses using the median to construct feature response functions, and makes predictions through their weighted sum without further LLM queries. Across eight tabular benchmark tasks, MARS achieves the highest average AUC and AP, outperforming direct prompting by 1.97 and 6.21 percentage points respectively, while substantially reducing end-to-end costs. Evaluations with LLMs of different sizes further demonstrate its predictive advantage over direct prompting.

</details>


### [269] [Zero-Compute Cross-Lingual Transferability Estimation Using Typological Feature Proxies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39640)
*Dalton Raphael Harmsen,Swier Garst,Thomas van Osch,Zarè Palanciyan,Joaquin Vanschoren*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究表明，利用免费可用的语言类型学特征即可预测跨语言迁移效果，其预测精度优于非类型学控制模型，且不受脚本或语系混淆影响。这提供了一种零计算成本的筛选工具，可替代大量昂贵的训练实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化跨语言迁移（即源语言知识如何促进目标语言）通常需要进行广泛的多元语言预训练，成本高昂。本文旨在探究是否可以从易于获取的语言类型学特征中预测这种迁移，并分析高资源语言的显著性究竟源于类型学相似性还是数据质量/数量偏差。

Method: 使用基于24种语言的先前工作构建的跨语言迁移矩阵，训练一个仅依赖类型学特征的随机森林模型进行预测。通过留一法语言评估、留一法脚本评估和留一法语系评估协议验证模型的鲁棒性。此外，将迁移分解为类型学项和资源-脚本偏差项，以分离这两种因素的影响。

Result: 1. 仅类型学模型的预测性能达到 $ρ=0.705$ 和 $R^2=0.49$，显著优于非类型学控制模型（$ρ=0.62$）。
2. 该信号在排除特定脚本或语系后依然稳健，证明脚本和语系混淆无法解释该效应。
3. 最佳源语言排名受资源和脚本偏差影响，但类型学预测本身不受此偏差影响。

Conclusion: 语言类型学数据库包含关于跨语言迁移的低成本且密集的信号。类型学特征可作为零计算成本的筛选工具，有效替代数百次昂贵的训练运行，且其预测结果独立于数据和脚本偏差，从而更准确地反映语言间的内在结构相似性带来的迁移潜力。

Abstract: Cross-lingual transfer describes how knowledge in a source language benefits a target language. Measuring it quantitatively requires broad multilingual pre-training, as prior work has done with cross-lingual transfer matrices. We ask whether transfer is predictable from freely available typological features, and whether the prominence of high-resource source languages reflects typology or data quality and quantity. We show that typological databases contain cheap and dense signals about cross-lingual transfer. Our typology-only random forest on a 24-language prior-work transfer matrix scores leave-one-language-out $ρ{=}0.705$ and $R^2{=}0.49$, beating a non-typological control at $ρ{=}0.62$, which verifies the ability of typology-only predictions to reconstruct costly measured cross-lingual transfer. The signal survives leave-one-script-out and leave-one-family-out protocols, so script and family confounding do not explain the effect. By decomposing the transfer into a typology term and a resource-and-script bias term, we find the best-source ranking sensitive to this bias. In contrast, typology is not affected by this bias, which makes it a zero-compute screening tool that replaces hundreds of training runs with a model fit. Our code is available \href{https://github.com/dharmsen/typo-x-ling-transfer}{here}.

</details>


### [270] [SEPAL: Separated Expert Pairs with Answer-Level Fusion for Reliable LLM Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39645)
*Weijie Ren,Yanwen Zhang,Hao Li,Zhuolin Qi,Hengyi Zhang,Naibo Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SEPAL框架，通过三个独立的Actor-Critic团队（负责推理、证据 grounding 和验证）解决多智能体协作中反馈导致错误传播的问题，在五个基准上平均准确率提升1.81%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM多智能体协作中，共享讨论会导致修正与暴露于相同错误耦合，从而降低投票所需的多样性；而Self-consistency缺乏反馈机制，单对Actor-Critic仅优化单一候选项。

Method: 引入SEPAL框架，分配三个私有的Actor-Critic团队分别执行推理、证据 grounding 和验证任务。通过角色特定训练赋予不同推理目标，每个Critic仅在团队内部指导修订以防止跨候选项的错误传播，最终仅对最终答案进行多数投票，保持推理历史分离。

Result: 在五个开源骨干模型和五个问答基准测试中，SEPAL相比匹配的单对Actor-Critic方法，平均准确率提高了1.81个百分点，且所有五个骨干模型均有所提升。

Conclusion: SEPAL通过隔离团队间的反馈和角色特定的训练，有效提升了多智能体协作的准确性和多样性，优于现有的Self-consistency和单对Actor-Critic方法。

Abstract: Multi-agent collaboration lets large language models (LLMs) improve question answering through deliberation and feedback. Yet shared discussion couples correction with exposure to the same mistakes, which can erode the diversity needed for voting. Self-consistency offers sampling diversity without feedback, while single-pair Actor-Critic collaboration refines only one candidate. We introduce SEPAL, which assigns three private Actor-Critic teams to direct reasoning, evidence grounding, and verification. Role-specific training gives the teams different reasoning objectives beyond sampling variation. Each Critic guides revisions within its own team, preventing feedback from carrying errors across candidates. Once revision ends, majority voting combines only the final answers, keeping the reasoning histories separate until the decision. Across five open-weight backbones and five question-answering benchmarks, SEPAL improves mean accuracy by 1.81 percentage points over a matched single Actor-Critic pair, with improvements across all five backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/zhansan114514/SEPAL.

</details>


### [271] [The Evolution of Attention in Large Language Models: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Emerging Trends](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39661)
*Zhentao Tan,Jingyi Shen,Yanbo Li,Yao Liu,Yue Wu,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文综述了LLM中“模型内部上下文记忆”的发展，提出五维分析框架（表示、更新、访问、读出、整合），揭示从单一注意力机制向深度协同、稀疏读写及状态化多维记忆路由的演进趋势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决自注意力机制带来的二次预填充成本和KV缓存随上下文长度线性增长的问题，梳理并比较显式记忆压缩、稀疏访问、循环状态构建等多样化研究路线。

Method: 构建五维透镜（Memory Representation, Update, Access, Readout, Integration）进行理论分析；基于14条主要模型谱系和11个高性能开源端点的59个发布级记录，重构机制级发展与架构采用情况。

Result: 1. 显式记忆与循环状态方法虽接口不同但功能重叠；2. 异构架构在网络深度上协同，层内分布互补处理，层间复用记忆与路由特征，使“深度”成为记忆管理的新维度；3. 提出“状态化多维记忆路由假设”，即持久记忆按时间范围、网络深度、底物类型和粒度组织，通过稀疏写/读协调维护与查询贡献。

Conclusion: 高效序列架构设计的核心已从孤立的Attention算子，转向对上下文记忆的组织、生命周期管理及选择性使用。

Abstract: Self-attention gives LLMs fine-grained, query-dependent access to context, but dense token interactions incur quadratic prefill cost and a key--value cache growing with context length. Research thus spans explicit-memory compression, sparse access, recurrent state construction, structured state dynamics, and heterogeneous mechanism composition. This survey analyzes these developments as model-internal contextual memory. We introduce a five-dimensional lens---Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration---describing what is represented, how it changes, what is query-eligible, how it is read, and how readouts form outputs. This lens compares overlapping research lines without imposing one computational model.
  We reconstruct mechanism-level developments and architectural adoption using 59 release-level records from 14 major model lineages and 11 high-performing open-weight endpoints. First, explicit-memory and recurrent-state methods retain distinct interfaces but increasingly control overlapping memory functions. Second, heterogeneous architectures increasingly coordinate across network depth: layer-wise composition distributes complementary memory processing across representational stages, while cross-layer reuse carries selected memory and routing artifacts forward. Depth thus becomes a dimension along which contextual memory is constructed and managed. Third, these developments motivate a stateful multidimensional memory-routing hypothesis: persistent memory is organized across temporal scope, network depth, substrate type, and representation granularity, while coordinated Sparse Write and Sparse Read determine what is maintained and what contributes to each query. Overall, efficient sequence architecture design increasingly concerns the organization, lifecycle, and selective use of contextual memory rather than an isolated Attention operator.

</details>


### [272] [Better Supervision Is Nearby: Neighborhood On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39687)
*Xincheng Wei,Yifan Ding,Yoshua Li,Yuquan Lu,Ziheng Li,Yi Lu,Dongsheng Ma,Rongxiang Weng,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出邻域OPSD（N-OPSD），通过构建专家池和在线路由机制，利用局部参数扰动产生的互补监督信号，显著提升数学推理模型在AIME等基准上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准OPSD仅使用固定参数的特权教师进行监督，忽略了邻近参数设置可能提供的额外互补监督信息。

Method: 离线阶段通过贪婪选择构建冻结专家池，奖励超越当前最佳水平的参考token增益；在线阶段采用MaxPeak选择锚点token，并通过分位数选择在匹配锚点的专家中进行路由，学生通过截断前向KL目标学习选定专家的完整下一个token分布。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B、4B和8B模型上，N-OPSD在AIME 2024、AIME 2025和HMMT February 2025三个基准上的Average@12指标分别比标准OPSD提升了2.75、1.67和1.94分。

Conclusion: N-OPSD有效利用了局部扰动带来的互补校正信息，通过分离锚点方向与支持强度优化训练过程，且推理阶段仅需蒸馏后的学生模型，兼顾了性能与效率。
