To support reproducible, large-scale evaluation, we also release a synthetic question dataset of 19,484 problem-statement and methodology questions generated by Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct from a random sample of 10,000 papers across academic domains (query generation succeeded for 9,742 of them), and every strategy is evaluated on this same query set. We describe the architecture and implementation of each pipeline, release the code and the synthetic question dataset, and evaluate each strategy with an LLM-as-a-judge protocol along multiple quality dimensions, together with direct gold-paper retrieval metrics. The result is an open testbed for studying the cost and quality trade-offs of RAG design choices on a research-literature corpus, and a basis for future work on faithfulness, retrieval robustness, and agentic retrieval.

</details>


### [308] [Exploring Forum Post Retrieval with Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38646)
*Yang Li,Yaguang Liu,Heng Liu,Shengbo Guo,Samson Komo,Jane Kou,Yulian Zhou,Gang Yang,Shubhojeet Sarkar,Gaurav Chakravorty,Yujie Liu,Haipeng Chen,Yonghuan Yang,Deepti Chheda,Yamin Wang,Mike Plumpe,Rish Tandon*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于生成式推荐（GR）的Facebook Forum应用方案。针对新平台数据稀疏问题，通过跨平台迁移学习解决：使用Facebook Feed数据的语义ID（SIDs）和更广域的Groups交互数据进行预训练，再对3B参数指令微调语言模型进行监督微调，以根据用户上下文直接生成SIDs。研究验证了跨平台SID的有效性，并为实际部署提供指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐（GR）作为嵌入检索的替代方案备受关注，但在Facebook Forum这一新应用中，由于缺乏足够的历史交互数据，无法从头训练GR模型。需要解决数据稀疏性问题以实现有效推荐。

Method: 1. 双轴迁移学习：在更广泛的Facebook Groups交互语料上训练，而非仅限Forum会话；复用从跨平台Facebook Feed数据中学习到的分层、基于前缀的语义ID（SIDs），避免为Forum单独构建分词器。2. 模型微调：对3B参数的指令微调语言模型进行监督微调，使其能直接从用户上下文中生成SIDs。3. 系统消融实验：评估SID构建、用户历史组成与长度、以及用户画像特征包含情况对性能的影响。

Result: 跨平台的语义ID（SIDs）能够有效迁移至新的推荐表面（Facebook Forum）。研究结果提供了关于SID构建、用户历史处理及特征融合等关键设计选择的实践指导，证明了该方案在真实社交平台上部署生成式推荐的可行性。

Conclusion: 通过跨平台数据迁移和语义ID复用，可以有效克服新推荐平台数据稀疏的挑战。该方法不仅验证了生成式推荐在社交场景中的潜力，还为工业界部署此类模型提供了具体的工程实践参考。

Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) has emerged as an alternative to embedding-based retrieval, building on the success of generative models in language and vision. We are exploring GR on Facebook Forum, a standalone application for medium-to-heavy users of Facebook Groups. Because Forum is a new surface, its own interaction data are too sparse to train a GR model from scratch. We address this with transfer along two axes: we train on a broader corpus of Facebook Groups engagements rather than Forum sessions alone, and we reuse hierarchical, prefix-based semantic IDs (SIDs) learned from cross-platform Facebook Feed data instead of fitting a Forum-specific tokenizer. A 3B-parameter instruction-tuned language model is then supervised-fine-tuned to generate SIDs directly from user context. We systematically ablate the design choices that matter most in practice, including SID construction, the composition and length of user history, and the inclusion of user-profile features. Our results show that cross-platform SIDs transfer to a new recommendation surface, and offer practical guidance for teams deploying GR on real-world social platforms.

</details>


### [309] [PatchHolmes: Agentic Patch Retrieval via Listwise Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38807)
*Guanqun Yang,Yingming Zhou,Jiangrui Zheng,Shudong Hao,Xueqing Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: PatchHolmes是一个两阶段补丁检索系统，通过混合检索器与智能体检查循环结合，显著提升了漏洞补丁查找的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决主要漏洞数据库中60%-63%的CVE缺乏补丁链接的问题，改进现有单点评分方法在候选列表排序和选择上的不足。

Method: 提出PatchHolmes系统，第一阶段使用混合检索器生成候选列表，第二阶段引入智能体（Agent）以列表式（listwise）方式一次性阅读前100个候选项，利用四个预算工具选择性阅读3-10个提交记录，最终提交最佳补丁。该系统基于冻结的开源模型运行，无需微调或外部搜索API。

Result: 在GitHubAD数据集上，PatchHolmes相比Favia模型Recall@1提升25.34%，相比IRCoT基线提升31.40%。仅每个CVE进行一次对话即可达到效果，而Favia需十次。在相同候选集下，智能体使Recall@1提升27.32%；迁移至PatchFinder_top10后，Recall@1从24.28%提升至39.86%。更换LLM骨干网络对结果影响极小（<1%），证明增益主要来自列表式智能体循环机制。

Conclusion: 列表式智能体检查循环能显著提升补丁检索性能，且该方法具有模型无关性、无需微调及低资源消耗的优势，为缺乏补丁链接的CVE提供了高效的修复方案发现途径。

Abstract: Patch retrieval, the task of finding the commit that fixes a known vulnerability, is the foundation of vulnerability management workflows, yet 60% to 63% of CVEs in the major advisory databases lack a patch link. We present PatchHolmes, a two-phase patch retrieval system that pairs a hybrid first-stage retriever with an agentic second-stage inspection loop. Unlike pointwise prior work that scores each candidate independently, the Phase 2 agent reads the top-100 listwise: it sees the full candidate list at once and selectively reads 3 to 10 commits through four budgeted tools before submitting a single best commit. On GitHubAD, PatchHolmes beats the pointwise binary classifier Favia by 25.34% Recall@1 and the retrieve-and-CoT baseline IRCoT by 31.40%, at one agent conversation per CVE versus Favia's ten; with the candidate set held identical, the agent adds 27.32% Recall@1 over taking the retriever's top candidate, and the same agent, transferred unchanged to PatchFinder_top10, lifts Recall@1 from PatchFinder's own top-1 pick (24.28%) to 39.86%. Swapping the LLM backbone within the Qwen family changes Recall@1 by under 1%, and a second model family (gpt-oss) stays far above the no-agent floor, so the gain comes from the listwise agent loop; the entire system runs on a frozen open-weight model over a local Git repository, without fine-tuning or external search APIs.

</details>


### [310] [SkillSeek: Revisiting Agent Skill Retrieval at Marketplace Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38822)
*Guanqun Yang,Wenlong Zhang,Tian Shi,Ping Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SkillSeek，一种基于标准IR技术（BGE-base双编码器+小交叉编码器）的两阶段技能检索器，以替代昂贵的LLM中介检索循环。在SkillsBench基准测试中达到性能持平，同时成本大幅降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Anthropic的Agent Skills包导致开源技能数量激增（超23万），使得“选择”而非“编写”成为瓶颈。现有的文献解决方案依赖LLM中介的检索循环，该方法在每次任务中都需支付LLM token费用，成本高昂。

Method: 构建SkillSeek，采用标准信息检索（IR）配方：第一阶段使用BGE-base双编码器进行初步检索，第二阶段使用小型交叉编码器进行精排，并通过MCP接口暴露。在89个任务的SkillsBench基准上进行广泛评估。

Result: SkillSeek在性能上与Liu等人提出的LLM中介循环达到观察到的parity（等效性）。仅使用plain bm25在四项设置中的三项上表现优于或等于其精炼循环，小型交叉编码器弥补了第四项的差异。单次试验总成本从51.30美元降至27.54美元（接近无技能基线）。

Conclusion: 标准IR配方是代理技能检索的强大默认选择。当确定性方法表现不佳时，LLM中介方案仍是自然的补充选项。

Abstract: Anthropic's Agent Skills package reusable procedural know-how for an LLM agent into SKILL.md directories, and open-source aggregations have grown past 230,000 skills, making selection rather than authoring the bottleneck. The standing answer in the literature outsources selection to the agent itself: an LLM-mediated retrieval loop that rewrites queries and refines candidates inside the agent's decision loop, paying LLM tokens on every task. We present SkillSeek, an open-source two-stage skill retriever built from the standard IR recipe (a BGE-base bi-encoder feeding a small cross-encoder, exposed over MCP). Across a $4 \times 11$ grid of pool, backbone, and method on the 89-task SkillsBench benchmark, SkillSeek reaches observed parity with the LLM-mediated loop of Liu et al. at essentially no extra cost: plain bm25 alone records a pass rate at or above their refined loop on three of four settings, and a small cross-encoder covers the remaining difference on the fourth. A first-stage recall ceiling explains the pattern, and total per-trial spend drops from USD 51.30 to USD 27.54 (within fifty cents of the no-skill baseline). Under the SkillsBench tasks and OpenHands harness we tested, this positions the standard IR recipe as a strong default for agent-skill retrieval, with LLM-mediated alternatives a natural fit for cases where deterministic methods fall short.

</details>


### [311] [Text-Video Retrieval via Multi-Dimensional Saliency Assessment and Granularity-Aware Query Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38949)
*Shuquan Wei,Xi Chen,Xu Chen,Xiangyang Jia*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出MMTI方法，通过关键特征选择(KFS)和多粒度文本-视频交互模块(TVIM)，解决视频视觉冗余和跨模态不对齐问题，实现多粒度语义对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法仅依赖单一标准评估视觉重要性，忽视视频的多面时空特性；且将文本编码为单一全局嵌入，压缩了时序事件和空间实体，加剧跨模态不对齐。

Method: 提出MMTI方法：1. 关键特征选择(KFS)机制：联合评估多维显著性和可学习重要性分数，自适应识别并聚合信息性帧和块，压缩密集视觉特征；2. 多粒度文本-视频交互模块(TVIM)：采用动态门控机制，将文本查询分解为句子、帧和块查询(SFP)，实现不同粒度的互补对齐。

Result: 在四个标准基准测试上进行的大量实验表明，该方法优于最先进的方法。

Conclusion: MMTI有效解决了视觉冗余和跨模态不对齐问题，实现了准确的多粒度语义对齐，性能超越SOTA。

Abstract: Text-video retrieval, which aims to bridge visual and textual modalities by learning a joint embedding space, has become a crucial task in multimodal intelligence. Despite extensive efforts to mitigate visual redundancy, previous methods typically rely on a single-aspect criterion to assess visual importance, overlooking the multifaceted spatiotemporal nature of video. In addition, encoding text into a single global embedding to align with videos compresses temporal events and spatial entities into a unified representation space, further aggravating cross-modal misalignment. To address these issues, we propose MMTI, a method that jointly mitigates visual redundancy and enables multi-grained text-video interaction to achieve accurate multi-grained semantic alignment. Specifically, a key feature selection (KFS) mechanism adaptively identifies and aggregates informative frames and patches by jointly evaluating multi-dimensional saliency and learnable importance scores, effectively compacting dense visual features and mitigating visual redundancy. Furthermore, our proposed multi-grained text-video interaction module (TVIM) employs a dynamic gating mechanism to decompose the text query into sentence, frame, and patch queries (SFP), enabling multi-grained text-video alignment. Complementary alignment at different granularities is thereby achieved. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [312] [When LLM-Inferred User Context Adds Value in Production Streaming Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38999)
*Milad Sabouri,Neeraj Sharma,Sardar Hamidian,Shaghayegh Agah*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 研究对比了聚合用户画像与LLM生成画像在不同消费模式下的表现，发现习惯性用户适合聚合画像，探索性用户适合LLM画像，且LLM画像存在降低新颖性的副作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐系统中的上下文信息正从静态变量转向基于行为推断的潜在表示，大语言模型（LLM）可将非结构化交互历史转化为自然语言摘要以构建主题化用户上下文，但此类生成式画像优于传统聚合嵌入的具体条件尚不明确。

Method: 在生产流媒体平台上评估语义用户画像策略，采用2x2实验设计交叉考察表示类型（聚合 vs LLM生成）与上下文范围（整体历史 vs 注意力融合的长短时上下文），并以全目录排名为基准进行对比。

Result: 1. 表征类型的优劣取决于用户的消费模式：约80%的习惯性消费者更适合使用聚合画像；而后续交互与历史语义偏离的探索性用户更适合使用LLM生成的画像。
2. LLM生成的画像存在“流行度吸引效应”，虽适度提升列表内多样性，但大幅降低了目录覆盖率和新颖性。

Conclusion: 上下文感知系统应根据推断出的用户消费模式动态选择画像策略，而非对所有用户应用单一的表示方法。

Abstract: Contextual information in recommender systems is shifting from static, predefined variables toward latent representations inferred from behavior. Large language models support this shift by rendering an unstructured interaction history as a natural-language summary, which yields a thematic user context that can be encoded and used in place of an aggregate profile. The conditions under which such generated profiles outperform aggregate embeddings have received limited characterization mainly at the domain level. We evaluate semantic user-profiling strategies on a production streaming platform, ranking against the full catalog. The evaluation covers a 2*2 design space crossing representation type (aggregate or LLM-generated) with contextual scope (holistic history or attention-fused short-term and long-term contexts). The relative ordering of the two representation types is conditional on the user's consumption regime. Aggregate profiles are consistently stronger under habitual consumption, which characterizes approximately four-fifths of the population, while LLM-generated profiles are stronger for exploratory users whose subsequent interactions diverge semantically from their history. We also observe a popularity-attractor effect in LLM-generated profiles, which modestly raises within-list diversity while substantially lowering catalog coverage and reducing novelty. These results indicate that a context-aware system can select a profiling strategy from the inferred consumption regime rather than applying one representation to all users.

</details>


### [313] [RouteRec: Behavior-Guided Sparse Routing for Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39007)
*Junyeong Song,Jaemin Yoo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出RouteRec，一种利用会话行为作为路由标准的混合专家（MoE）顺序推荐模型。通过总结交互节奏、项目组焦点、重复与延续及流行度倾向四种行为证据，在宏观、中观和微观层面指导专家分配，显著提升推荐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有顺序推荐模型对所有会话使用相同的参数化模块处理，忽视了行为差异；而现有的混合专家（MoE）方法虽支持条件计算，但未明确专家分配的指导依据。

Method: 提出RouteRec模型，从会话历史中提取四种行为证据（交互节奏、项目组焦点、重复与延续、流行度倾向），利用这些线索在宏观、中观和微观三个尺度上引导计算路由。首先基于线索得分选择专家组，随后在当前骨干网络状态下细化专家选择。

Result: 在六个公共数据集的18种数据集-指标组合中，RouteRec在12项中排名第一，3项中排名第二，平均排名为1.61，优于次优基线模型的4.11。分析表明，行为线索不仅增加了容量，还使路由模式与实际观察到的行为一致。

Conclusion: RouteRec通过基于行为证据的路由机制有效利用了会话间的行为差异，证明了行为线索在引导专家分配方面的有效性，显著提升了顺序推荐的性能。

Abstract: Sessionized interaction histories contain behavioral patterns that can improve sequential recommendation. However, existing models process all sessions through the same parameterized blocks, regardless of their behavioral differences. Mixture of Experts (MoE) enables conditional computation, but it leaves open what should guide expert allocation. We propose RouteRec, a sequential recommender that uses observed session behavior as the routing criterion. RouteRec summarizes four types of behavioral evidence from sessionized histories: interaction tempo, item-group focus, repetition and carryover, and popularity tendency. It uses these cues to route computation at macro, mid, and micro scopes. Cue-derived scores first select expert groups; within each selected group, the current backbone state then refines expert selection. Across six public datasets and 18 dataset-metric combinations, RouteRec ranks first in 12 and second in three, yielding the best overall average rank of 1.61 compared with 4.11 for the next-best baseline. Additional analyses suggest that the behavioral cues guide expert allocation beyond added capacity and produce routing patterns aligned with observed behavior. Our code is available at https://github.com/jy1559/RouteRec

</details>


### [314] [Routing Between Generative and Collaborative User Profiles: A Serving-Time Gate for Controllable Novelty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39043)
*Milad Sabouri,Neeraj Sharma,Sardar Hamidian,Shaghayegh Agah*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 研究通过服务时路由门控机制，选择性地将用户引导至LLM生成的用户画像推荐模型，以在保持排序相关性的前提下提升推荐新颖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的丰富语义用户画像虽能增强推荐效果，但生成成本高且不适合在所有场景下统一部署，需探索其在生产环境中的选择性应用策略。

Method: 基于真实流媒体数据集，训练一个仅使用服务时特征的路由门控模型，将用户分配给协同序列推荐模型或LLM驱动的用户画像推荐模型；通过调整路由阈值控制新颖性与相关性的权衡。

Result: 在NDCG损失预算为5%的条件下，该门控机制使Novelty@10提升了6.5%，同时仅路由12.5%的用户，性能优于简单的启发式和随机路由策略。

Conclusion: LLM生成的用户画像可作为协同推荐的可控补充；收益主要源于选择性路由机制，而非单纯依赖LLM生成本身。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable rich semantic user profiles for recommendation, but such profiles are more expensive to generate and are not necessarily desirable to deploy uniformly. We study whether LLM-generated profiles can instead be invoked selectively within a production recommendation pipeline. Using a real-world streaming dataset covering movies, TV shows, and sports content, we train a serving-time routing gate that assigns each user to either a collaborative sequential recommendation model or a recommendation model driven by an LLM-generated profile. The gate uses only serving-time features and learns to identify users for whom profile-based routing can increase Novelty@10 while preserving ranking relevance. A routing threshold controls how aggressively users are sent to the generative model, exposing a tunable novelty--relevance trade-off. At an overall NDCG-loss budget of 5\%, the learned gate increases Novelty@10 by 6.5\% while routing 12.5\% of users, outperforming simple heuristic and random routing policies at comparable relevance cost. These results show that LLM-generated user profiles can serve as a controllable complement to collaborative recommendation, while results with non-generative semantic profiles indicate that the benefit stems from selective routing rather than LLM generation alone.

</details>


### [315] [Learning Multiresolution Relevance for Hierarchical Generative Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39312)
*Weihao Shen,Wei Chen,Fuwei Zhang,Guojun Liu,Qingsong Hua,Wei Lin,Fuzhen Zhuang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出RARS（Resolution-Aligned Relevance Supervision），通过在文档层级结构中对齐多分辨率相关性分布，优化生成式检索中的语义标识符（SID）训练，显著提升多语言ESCI场景下的检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全SID监督方法将共享前缀但深层分叉的相关文档路径视为独立的训练目标，忽略了相关性在逐步细化过程中的分配规律，导致模型未能有效利用层级结构中的共性信息。

Method: 构建基于单一文档级相关性度量的多级条件分布，引入RARS算法：聚合前缀相关性，训练前缀条件预测器在兄弟分支间分配相关性；通过局部竞争机制和父节点相关性质量加权损失函数，使查询编码器同时捕捉粗粒度共性和细粒度分支分配。

Result: 在三个多语言ESCI语料库上，相比标准自回归解码的全SID训练，RARS取得一致的性能提升；优于分组软标签、解码器软标签及采样树监督方法；效果在不同标识符结构和相关性定义下均保持稳定。

Conclusion: RARS通过显式建模多分辨率相关性分配，有效提升了生成式检索的精度与鲁棒性，且推理阶段无需额外组件，保持标准自回归流程。

Abstract: Generative retrieval with semantic identifiers (SIDs) makes successive decisions over a document hierarchy. Relevant documents for the same query may share coarse prefixes and diverge at finer depths, with branching patterns varying across queries. These paths reveal how relevance is distributed across successive refinements, yet standard full-SID supervision treats them as separate training targets. To make this allocation explicit, we formulate multiresolution relevance as consistent conditional distributions induced by a single document-level relevance measure across the SID hierarchy. We introduce \textbf{RARS}, \textbf{R}esolution-\textbf{A}ligned \textbf{R}elevance \textbf{S}upervision, which uses the resulting refinement-level distributions to supervise a shared query representation. RARS aggregates document relevance over prefixes and trains a prefix-conditioned predictor to allocate relevance among sibling branches. All relevance-bearing children participate in local competition, and each local loss is weighted by the relevance mass reaching its parent. This objective trains the query encoder to capture both the coarse structure shared by relevant documents and their finer branch allocations. The predictor is discarded after training, preserving standard autoregressive retrieval at inference. Experiments on three multilingual ESCI locales show consistent improvements over matched full-SID training under autoregressive decoding. RARS also outperforms grouped soft-target, decoder soft-target, and sampled-tree supervision under a common retrieval rule. The gains persist across alternative identifier structures and relevance definitions. Code is available at: https://github.com/Nevaeh7/RARS

</details>


### [316] [Residual Trajectory Distillation for Generative Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39319)
*Weihao Shen,Wei Chen,Fuwei Zhang,Guojun Liu,Qingsong Hua,Wei Lin,Fuzhen Zhuang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出ResTD框架，通过蒸馏残差轨迹信息改进基于离散语义ID（SID）的生成式检索训练，解决传统硬监督导致的信息丢失问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于残差量化（RQ）构建SID的生成式检索中，标准训练仅监督选定的代码而丢弃产生它们的残差轨迹。这导致不同的量化行为被坍缩为相同的硬编码目标，且索引阶段可用的后续量化决策信息在检索训练中未被利用。

Method: 引入ResTD（Residual Trajectory Distillation），将冻结的RQ索引器视为教师过程，将残差诱导的词码偏好蒸馏到SID解码状态中。这种监督机制恢复了硬分配中隐藏的区别，使早期解码状态能捕获关于后续量化决策的信息。

Result: 在多语言电子商务检索实验中，ResTD相比强基线和匹配的训练控制实现了持续的性能提升。受控比较显示，基于残差的目标优于仅基于码本的软目标。表示探针表明，早期解码状态中恢复未来码本偏好的能力增强。该方法可推广至生成式推荐领域。

Conclusion: ResTD有效利用了索引阶段的残差信息以丰富检索学习，同时保持原有的检索索引和推理流程不变，提升了生成式检索的效果并具备跨领域扩展性。

Abstract: Generative retrieval has emerged as a general retrieval paradigm, representing items with discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) and retrieving them through autoregressive identifier generation. When SIDs are constructed with residual quantization (RQ), standard retrieval training supervises only the selected codes and discards the residual trajectories that produce them. The same hard code can nevertheless arise from different preferences over competing codewords, while the residual trajectory also contains information about subsequent quantization decisions. As a result, hard SID supervision collapses distinct quantization behaviors into identical targets and leaves information available during indexing unused in retrieval training. We introduce ResTD, a Residual Trajectory Distillation framework that transfers this discarded indexing information into retrieval training. Treating the frozen RQ indexer as a process teacher, it distills residual-induced codeword preferences into SID-decoding states. This supervision recovers distinctions hidden by hard assignments and allows earlier decoder states to capture information about subsequent quantization decisions before the corresponding SID suffix is generated. In this way, richer information from SID construction is incorporated into retrieval learning while preserving the original retrieval index and inference procedure. Experiments on multilingual e-commerce retrieval show consistent improvements over strong baselines and matched training controls. Controlled comparisons show that residual-derived targets outperform the tested codebook-only soft targets. Representation probes further show that future codebook preferences become more recoverable from earlier decoder states. ResTD can also be readily extended beyond retrieval to generative recommendation. Code is available at: https://github.com/Nevaeh7/iclr2027_ResTD.git.

</details>


### [317] [Generative End-to-end Ad Retrieval at Douyin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39327)
*Shaowen Zeng,Yanhua Huang,Jiacheng Sun,Jiarui Liu,Qian Dai,Zhikai Yang,Hancheng Li,Boya Wu,Tuoyu Zhang,Yekui Chen,Xiang Sun*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 针对生成式推荐系统中存在的表示坍塌和物品碰撞两大瓶颈，提出GEAR框架。通过正交基重参数化（BasisVQ）稳定tokenizer训练，并结合上下文感知重排序头解决物品冲突，实现了端到端可微且可扩展的范式，已在抖音广告中大规模应用并显著提升效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将推荐任务重构为离散物品token生成的生成式检索范式在扩展至真实世界推荐系统时面临两个关键瓶颈：1) 表示坍塌（Representation collapse），即在连续分布偏移下item tokenizer收敛于退化结果，阻碍稳定的端到端适应；2) 物品碰撞（Item collisions），即海量候选池导致不同物品共享相同token序列，损害检索精度。这两者相互耦合，扩大码本容量以缓解碰撞会加剧坍塌。

Method: 提出GEAR，一个联合优化tokenizer、生成器和reranker的端到端框架。具体包括：1) BasisVQ：通过正交基对码本进行重参数化，实现全局梯度共享和潜在空间的刚性空间旋转，从而在不依赖启发式方法的情况下稳定梯度动态；2) Prefix-aware BasisRQ：扩展上述方法以增强码本表达能力；3) 上下文条件重排序头（context-conditioned reranking head）：集成到生成过程中，以最小计算开销消除碰撞物品的歧义。

Result: GEAR建立了完全可微且可扩展的范式。目前服务于抖音广告（Douyin Ads）的数亿日活跃用户，在广泛的在线A/B测试中取得了显著的实证改进。

Conclusion: GEAR通过统一稳定的标记化（tokenization）和联合重排序，成功解决了生成式推荐系统中的表示坍塌与物品碰撞问题，证明了其在大规模工业场景中的有效性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Generative retrieval reformulates recommendation as the generation of discrete item tokens. However, scaling this paradigm to real-world recommender systems reveals two critical bottlenecks: 1) Representation collapse, where the item tokenizer converges to degenerate results under continuous distribution shifts, fundamentally hindering stable end-to-end adaptation. 2) Item collisions, where the massive candidate pool causes distinct items to share identical token sequences, compromising the final retrieval precision. Crucially, these bottlenecks are inherently coupled: expanding codebook capacity to mitigate collisions inevitably exacerbates collapse. To address them simultaneously, we propose GEAR, an end-to-end framework that jointly optimizes the tokenizer, generator, and reranker. To mitigate representation collapse, we introduce BasisVQ, which re-parameterizes the codebook via an orthogonal basis to enable global gradient sharing and rigid spatial rotation of the latent space, effectively stabilizing gradient dynamics without ad-hoc heuristics. We further extend it to prefix-aware BasisRQ, substantially enhancing the codebook's expressiveness with the same asymptotic time complexity. To resolve item collisions, GEAR integrates a context-conditioned reranking head into the generative process, efficiently disambiguating colliding items with minimal computational overhead. By unifying stable tokenization and joint reranking within an end-to-end generative framework, GEAR establishes a fully differentiable and scalable paradigm. It currently serves hundreds of millions of daily active users on Douyin Ads, yielding substantial empirical improvements in extensive online A/B tests.

</details>


### [318] [When the Label Ignores the Request: Auditing Policy-Selected Targets in Synthetic Conversational Music Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39696)
*Sanjeev Suresh*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文指出LLM生成的对话推荐基准中，官方标签与用户真实意图存在严重偏差。在RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay基准测试中，当用户明确请求特定歌曲时，官方标签有50%的概率与之矛盾。通过增加少量满足请求的训练数据，可在不损害官方指标的前提下显著提升模型性能（nDCG@20提升53.3%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的合成对话基准依赖LLM策略选择的标签作为评估标准，这些标签仅是模拟用户请求的代理。然而，在现实音乐搜索中，用户明确命名目标物品是主要意图，系统不应随意替换。因此，需要审计并修正这种标签与真实请求之间的不一致性，以提高推荐系统的实际满意度。

Method: 1. 审计RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay基准中的开发集，专门检查用户明确要求“特定名称歌曲”的对话轮次，对比官方标签与用户真实请求的一致性。
2. 设计训练增强方案：在训练阶段，向一小部分训练轮次中添加基于目录解析的、满足用户请求的目标数据（catalog-resolved request-satisfying targets）。
3. 进行对照实验：将增强后的模型与仅使用官方标签训练的匹配对照组进行比较，评估其在冲突轮次上的表现及整体官方指标的影响。

Result: 1. 在审计的开发集中，当用户要求确切歌曲时，官方标签与用户请求相矛盾的比例高达50%。
2. 引入小比例的请求满足型训练目标后，在43个发生冲突的轮次上，nDCG@20取得了53.3%的相对提升。
3. 该改进未对官方整体指标造成负面影响，且在匹配对照组验证中确认了效果源于对真实请求的识别而非其他因素。

Conclusion: 当前基于LLM的合成对话基准中的官方标签存在显著缺陷，无法准确反映用户在精确搜索场景下的真实意图。通过在训练中引入少量解析后的真实请求目标，可以有效纠正这一偏差，显著提升模型在关键冲突场景下的性能，同时保持基准评估的稳定性。这为改进合成对话推荐系统的训练策略提供了实证支持。

Abstract: Synthetic dialogues generated by LLM pipelines now serve as complete conversational-recommendation benchmarks: an LLM listener talks to an LLM recommender, and the track logged next in the conversation becomes the official label for each turn. These policy-selected labels make large-scale evaluation reproducible, but they are proxies for what the simulated user asked. We audit the one place where label and request are directly comparable: turns where the user asks for an exact song by name. In the RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay benchmark, using visible dialogue and catalog metadata alone, we find that the official label contradicts the user's exact-song request in half of the audited development turns. This matters beyond one benchmark: naming the desired item is the dominant intent in real music search, where deployed systems avoid substituting an alternative for an exactly named item, on the premise that it costs satisfaction. A small training-time supplement closes most of the gap: adding catalog-resolved request-satisfying targets to a small fraction of training turns yields a 53.3% relative gain in nDCG@20 on the 43 conflict turns while leaving the official metric intact, verified against a matched control that detects the same requests but trains only on official labels.

</details>


### [319] [KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39828)
*Jiangxia Cao,Hao Peng,Wenlong Xu,Jiaxin Deng,Zhixin Ling,Xingmei Wang,Kun Shang,Can Tang,Zhihuai Cai,Jun Du,Fang Su,Xiaojuan Liu,Yiling Li,Chenglong Yu,Chongling Rao,Haixuan Gao,Haitao Xu,Jian Liang,Ruiming Tang,Chenglong Chu,Guohong Mu,Honghui Bao,Hui Wang,Jialong Chen,Jiao Ou,Muhao Wei,Peng Zhang,Renpu Liu,Ruochen Yang,Shugui Liu,Xinqi Jin,Yan Sun,Yifan Wang,Yingzhi He,Yufei Ye,Yusen Huo,Tingkuo Wang,Jihong Zhang,Lanxi Zhu,Pengyuan Liu,Zhipeng Yi,Luankang Zhang,Hang Lv,Xuyang Zhi,Tianyu Li,Bintao Wu,Chuang Ou,Siyue Su,Ziyuan Wang,Yuliang Sun,Baiyan Che,Feiyang Xu,Shiwen Zhang,Shiteng Cao,Chongcong Jiang,Yuan Fang,Xiangwu Yang,Hao Deng,Zijian Du,Pengxun Wang,Xiaoming Wang,Shun Qin,Yingqi Song,Tianyi Li,Naixiao Peng,Chenyu Zhou,Qiliang Jiang,Quan Zheng,Cheng Jin,Siying Zeng,Hongjia Xu,Junwu Hu,Teng Fu,Zhengkang Mei,Haijun Yu,Kai Li,Shengyang Zhou,Zhijia Wei,Siyi Xiong,Bo Liu,Zichun Guo,Zhubin Han,Jinpeng Fu,Bingqian Liu,Yuyi Wang,Yu Liu,Qinghai Tan,Ruijie Zhou,Zhuohang Li,Zhijia Zhong,Xiangnan He,Jirong Wen,Min Zhang,Wenwu Ou,Peng Jiang,Han Li,Kaiqiao Zhan,Yanan Niu,Lantao Hu,Kun Gai*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 针对大语言模型在推荐系统中的应用，团队从OneRec系列演进至OneReason模型。为解决引入思维链（CoT）推理未显著提升性能的问题，OneReason通过强化语义对齐、结构化模板监督及强化学习技术优化推理过程。基于此前沿探索，联合SIGIR 2026社区发起“快手Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026”竞赛，旨在推动推理生成式推荐的研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型的发展，生成式推荐成为工业界和学术界热点。虽然OneRec系列证明了自回归预测范式的潜力，但在尝试将自然语言思维链（CoT）推理引入推荐任务时，初步发现直接引入CoT并不总能提升推荐性能，亟需解决推理与推荐效果之间的脱节问题。

Method: 提出OneReason模型，主要包含三项关键技术改进：1. 强化物品与语言之间的语义对齐；2. 引入基于结构化模板的监督信号以规范兴趣推理过程；3. 应用先进的强化学习技术，确保推理过程对推荐性能产生实质性增益。

Result: OneReason有效解决了引入CoT后性能不稳定的问题，提升了推理对推荐的贡献度。同时，该研究推动了LLM-Rec领域的发展，并通过组织KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026竞赛，促进了学术社区对推理生成式推荐这一前沿话题的深入探索。

Conclusion: 推理生成式推荐是构建推荐基础模型的重要前沿方向，具有显著的研究价值。通过OneReason等模型的迭代及社区竞赛的组织，有望进一步解锁自然语言推理在推荐系统中的潜力，鼓励更多研究者共同推进该领域发展。

Abstract: Generative recommendation, has been attracted a surge of attentions in industrial and academic research community, towards to build more smart system to build next-generation recommender. Under the significant developing wave of large language model, our team have been developed Semantic ID based OneRec/OneRec-V2. These models have been widely deployed in production and demonstrate the scaling potential of the autoregressive next-item prediction paradigm for industrial recommender systems. Building on the success of OneRec, we further explored a series of models, including OneRec-Think, OpenOneRec, and OneReason, that connect item Semantic IDs with natural language in a unified representation space and seek to unlock the potential of natural-language chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning for recommendation. However, our preliminary works found that introducing reasoning CoT does not always improve the recommendation performance. To address this issue, OneReason strengthens the semantic alignment between items and language, introduces structured template-based supervision for interest reasoning, and applies advanced reinforcement learning techniques to make reasoning more beneficial to recommendation. As a frontier topic to building recommendation foundation models, we believe this topic has significant research value and hope to encourage more researchers to explore it together. To this end, together with the SIGIR 2026 community, we organized the KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation.

</details>


### [320] [Decision-Oriented Recommendation Reranking: An Empirical Study of Jev](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40241)
*Hanjia Lyu,Yinglong Xia*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 研究决策导向模型（Jev）在推荐重排序中的表现，发现其在保持较高推荐效果的同时，延迟增长比点式Qwen更平缓，但整体延迟仍高于专用推荐模型，揭示了质量与效率的新权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在推荐重排序中面临推荐质量与服务效率之间的关键权衡；旨在探究对于具有结构化候选项的选择任务，决策导向模型是否提供有用的替代方案。

Method: 对TypeSafe AI的“System One Model” Jev进行受控实证研究，将其与推荐专用模型及点式和列表式Qwen重排器在多Amazon Reviews领域及不同候选集规模下进行对比，评估推荐有效性和服务延迟。

Result: Jev相比基线保持了强劲的推荐有效性，且其服务延迟随候选集规模的增长显著平缓于点式Qwen重排器；然而，其绝对服务延迟仍远高于推荐专用模型，处于独特的质量-延迟运行区间。

Conclusion: 这些发现表明决策导向模型在具有结构化输出空间的推荐及其他排序任务中具有进一步研究的潜力和价值。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for recommendation reranking, but their use introduces an important tradeoff between recommendation quality and serving efficiency. We investigate whether a decision-oriented model provides a useful alternative when the reranking task is fundamentally a structured choice among predefined candidate items. Specifically, we conduct a controlled empirical study of Jev, described by TypeSafe AI as a ``System One Model,'' for personalized recommendation reranking and compare it with recommendation-specific models and pointwise and listwise Qwen rerankers across multiple Amazon Reviews domains and candidate-set sizes, evaluating both recommendation effectiveness and observed serving latency. Our results show that Jev maintains strong recommendation effectiveness relative to the evaluated baselines while exhibiting substantially more gradual latency growth than the pointwise Qwen rerankers, although its observed serving latency remains substantially higher than that of recommendation-specific models. Together, these characteristics place Jev in a distinct quality--latency operating regime across candidate sizes and domains. These findings motivate further investigation of decision-oriented models for recommendation and other ranking tasks with structured output spaces.

</details>


### [321] [LegalPincite: Multi-level Legal Information Retrieval Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03756)
*Theresia Veronika Rampisela,Henrik Palmer Olsen,Giovanni Colavizza*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 针对现有法律IR数据集存在的查询文本数据泄露及语料库不完整导致评估虚高的问题，本文基于欧盟法院（CJEU）判决构建了一个大规模、无泄露的法律信息检索数据集。该数据集包含去除了引用信息的掩码查询、全量段落语料库以及经过专家验证的案级和段落级真实引用标注，支持多粒度的法律检索任务评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开的法律信息检索（IR）数据集存在两个主要缺陷：一是包含查询文本中的数据泄露（data leakage），二是排除既非引用也非被引用的段落，导致检索设置不切实际且过于简化，从而造成模型性能评估虚高。此外，大多数数据集缺乏具体的段落级引注（pincites）标注，而法律实务中往往需要定位到具体案例的具体段落。

Method: 1. 数据来源：从欧盟法院（CJEU）的判决书中构建大规模数据集。
2. 数据清洗与预处理：对查询进行掩码处理，移除其中的引用信息以消除数据泄露；构建包含所有段落的完整语料库，而非仅保留相关段落。
3. 标注体系：提供案级（case-level）和段落级（paragraph-level）的真实引用标注（ground truth citations），并进行了部分人工专家验证。
4. 任务支持：支持案到案、段落到案、段落到段落的多粒度检索任务开发与评估。

Result: 成功构建了一个高质量的法律IR数据集，解决了数据泄露和语料库不完整的问题。该数据集为法律IR方法的发展提供了更严谨、更接近实务场景的评估基准，能够更全面地反映模型在案级和段落级检索上的真实能力。

Conclusion: 本文提出的数据集弥补了现有法律IR资源在数据真实性、完整性及标注粒度上的不足，为开发和评估更精准的法律信息检索系统提供了重要基础设施。

Abstract: A common task in legal Information Retrieval (IR) is to find relevant legal sources from case-law collections. While legal practice often requires pinpoint citations (pincites) to specific case paragraphs, most existing public legal IR datasets lack paragraph-level citation annotations. Yet, publicly available datasets with such information contain data leakage in the query text and exclude paragraphs that are neither citing nor cited from the corpora, creating an unrealistic and oversimplified retrieval setting, potentially leading to inflated performance. To address these limitations, we contribute a large-scale legal IR dataset constructed from Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) judgments. The dataset contains: (i) masked case/paragraph queries, with removed citation information; (ii) a corpus that includes all paragraphs; and (iii) case- and paragraph-level ground truth citations, with partial human expert validation. Our dataset supports both the development and rigorous evaluation of legal IR methods, at multiple query-document levels (case-to-case, paragraph-to-case, and paragraph-to-paragraph retrieval). Link to dataset and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/theresiavr/legalpincite

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [322] [Improving OCR Faithfulness via Gated and Attenuated On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38282)
*Baode Wang,Zuming Huang,Kexuan Ren,Jun Huang,Wei Chu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GAD-RL方法，通过自适应调节教师监督强度解决OCR后训练中固定教师指导失效问题，显著提升模型在CHAOS-Bench和OmniDocBench上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Vision-language模型可能重写图像中异常文本为合乎语法的表达，损害OCR转录忠实度；固定教师在学生能力提升过程中，其指导效果逐渐减弱，需动态调整监督策略。

Method: 引入GAD-RL算法，根据学生当前任务表现和局部分布自适应调节蒸馏强度：对高奖励响应组禁用蒸馏并随平均奖励增加衰减强度；基于学生对教师Top-1 token的概率加权前向KL散度，以调节局部辅助更新。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-2B上，GAD-RL在CHAOS-Bench达到59.92% Micro Recall，分别超越GRPO和GRPO+OPD 8.45和4.43个百分点；在OmniDocBench v1.6获得91.18总体得分。

Conclusion: 自适应调节教师监督能有效提升视觉-语言模型的OCR转录忠实度和整体性能，优于固定权重蒸馏方法。

Abstract: Vision-language models may rewrite anomalous text in images into linguistically plausible expressions, compromising OCR transcription faithfulness. Sequence-level task rewards and local teacher guidance are complementary, but guidance from the same teacher may not remain equally effective as the student improves. Offline analysis shows that supervision from a fixed teacher becomes progressively less favorable as the student improves, both across training checkpoints and across response groups with different task rewards. Motivated by this observation, we introduce GAD-RL, which adaptively regulates teacher supervision during joint post-training according to the student's current task performance and local distributions. A frozen teacher conditions on reference transcriptions and student-generated prefixes. GAD-RL disables distillation for response groups containing an output with task reward at least 0.95 and continuously attenuates distillation strength as group-mean reward increases. It also weights forward KL by the student's probability of the teacher's Top-1 token, moderating local auxiliary updates when student support for that candidate is low. On Qwen3.5-2B, GAD-RL achieves 59.92% Micro Recall on CHAOS-Bench, surpassing GRPO and GRPO+OPD (fixed-weight) by 8.45 and 4.43 percentage points, respectively, while achieving an Overall score of 91.18 on OmniDocBench v1.6.

</details>


### [323] [AREX-2: Advancing Self-Improving Agents through Long-Horizon Reflective Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38288)
*Hongjin Qian,Chaofan Li,Kun Luo,Wenqing Wei,Jianlyu Chen,Shuqi Lu,Yuyang Hu,Hongwang Xiao,Hui Wang,Chaozhuo Li,Qiwei Ye,Zhicheng Dou,Defu Lian,Zheng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AREX-2框架，通过合成机器学习与编程领域的长周期反思数据训练LLM代理，实现测试时迭代优化能力。该代理在MLE-bench Lite、BrowseComp等多个基准上表现优异，且性能随迭代轮次增加而持续提升，证明了长周期反思数据对构建自改进代理的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在提升大语言模型（LLM）代理的“自改进”能力，即在测试时通过迭代不断细化解决方案的能力。这依赖于两个核心能力：产生更优解的“反思”能力和维持多轮迭代有效性的“长周期执行”能力。

Method: 假设反思和长周期执行具有领域无关性，因此在适合监督学习的场景中学习这些能力。具体做法是从机器学习和算法编程任务中合成“长周期改进轨迹”数据，利用这两个领域可验证反馈且能奖励持续迭代的特性进行训练。代理基于Qwen3.8-27B构建。

Result: 在MLE-bench Lite上达到81.8分，Frontier-CS上达到70.7分；成功迁移至深度研究场景，在BrowseComp、HLE、GAIA和DeepSearchQA基准上分别取得84.0、52.6、92.2和93.8的高分。结果显示，随着迭代预算（轮次）的增加，代理性能持续改善。

Conclusion: 长周期反思数据是通往自改进代理的有效途径，能够显著提升LLM代理在复杂任务中的迭代优化和泛化能力。

Abstract: We present AREX-2, an effort to advance the self-improving capability of LLM agents, which we define as the ability to iteratively refine a solution at test time. This ability rests on two complementary capabilities: reflection, which produces a solution better than the current one, and long-horizon execution, which keeps the iteration effective over many rounds. We hypothesize that both capabilities are domain-agnostic, and can therefore be learned in scenarios that are well suited for supervision. Accordingly, we synthesize long-horizon improvement trajectories from machine learning and algorithmic programming tasks, two domains that offer verifiable feedback and reward sustained iteration. Trained on this data, our agent, built on Qwen3.8-27B, achieves strong results on MLE-bench Lite (81.8) and Frontier-CS (70.7), transfers to deep research with 84.0 on BrowseComp, 52.6 on HLE, 92.2 on GAIA, and 93.8 on DeepSearchQA, and keeps improving as its budget of rounds grows. These results show that long-horizon reflective data is an effective route toward self-improving agents.

</details>


### [324] [MoFlow: Multi-Objective Agentic Workflow Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38294)
*Yining Lu,Aurelie Lozano,Xi Yang,Naoki Abe,Yu Deng,Meng Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MoFlow，通过多目标强化学习一次性生成覆盖Pareto前沿的工作流，支持按偏好灵活选择而无需重新训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作流生成方法通常仅优化单一精度或固定权重的多目标组合，导致每次偏好变化都需从头重新训练，缺乏灵活性。

Method: 将工作流生成建模为多目标马尔可夫决策过程（MMDP），利用凸包蒙特卡洛树搜索（Convex-Hull MCTS）结合乐观集值备份算法，每个节点存储可达权衡集合而非单一加权得分，从而近似覆盖Pareto前沿。

Result: 在数学、代码和问答等六个基准测试中，即使在有利于单标量优化基线（针对未见偏好重跑）的严格设置下，MoFlow仍实现了最高的平均超体积（hypervolume）。

Conclusion: MoFlow能够高效生成适应多种偏好权衡的工作流，显著优于需频繁重训的传统方法，证明了其在多目标优化中的优越性和通用性。

Abstract: We study the generation of agentic workflows that jointly optimize multiple objectives, such as accuracy, cost, latency, robustness, and consistency. Existing methods for workflow generation typically optimize accuracy alone or a weighted sum of objectives, so each trained generator commits to one fixed trade-off and must be retrained from scratch when preferences change. To alleviate this, we propose MoFlow, which generates workflows optimized across varied preferences. Specifically, MoFlow formulates workflow generation as a multi-objective Markov decision process and solves it by leveraging Convex-Hull Monte Carlo Tree Search with optimistic set-valued backups, where every node stores a set of reachable trade-offs rather than one weighted score. A single search thus approximately covers the Pareto front, from which MoFlow can return a workflow for any preference by lookup without retraining. We evaluate MoFlow against six strong baselines on six benchmarks spanning mathematics, code, and question answering. Since the baselines are single-scalar optimizers by design, an apples-to-apples comparison is difficult. We instead adopt an evaluation setup that favors the baselines, in that they are rerun for each testing preference, which MoFlow never sees. Even under this stringent setup, MoFlow achieves the highest average hypervolume.

</details>


### [325] [AI Agents are Vulnerable to Radicalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38296)
*Ozgur Can Seckin,Shalmoli Ghosh,Alessandro Flammini,Kristina Lerman,Maria Elizabeth Grabe,Filippo Menczer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究揭示了大型语言模型（LLM）之间相互操纵和激进化信念的可能性。通过模拟“目标”与“影响者”代理的对话，发现“共鸣”（强化既有信念）比“说服”（引入新信念）更能导致激进化的效果，且这种效应会传播至相关信念，表明AI生态存在脆弱性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管已知LLM能影响人类信念，但关于LLM之间是否以及如何相互操纵的研究尚属空白。本研究旨在填补这一知识缺口，探究LLM在交互中产生信念极端化（radicalization）的机制。

Method: 构建双代理对话模拟实验：1) 目标LLM扮演基于人口统计和心理属性的人类角色；2) 影响者LLM旨在使目标信念更极端。考察两条路径：“共鸣”（强化既有信念）和“说服”（推广原本不重要的信念）。评估不同影响策略（如阿谀奉承、未经验证的声明）的效果，并测量情感和行为指标。

Result: 1) “共鸣”和“说服”均能导致目标LLM激进化的结果，但“共鸣”产生的效果始终强于“说服”。2) 不同的影响策略在不同指标上产生不同程度的激进化，但缺乏一致性。3) “共鸣”引发的激进化会传播到相关信念，证明AI代理内部存在互联的信念结构。

Conclusion: AI代理易受激进化影响，特别是当信息与其既有信念一致时。这引发了对个性化AI代理及多代理AI生态系统脆弱性的担忧。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can influence people's beliefs, yet little is known about whether and how they can manipulate each other. To investigate this, we simulate conversations between two agents: a target LLM that role-plays a human persona based on demographic and psychological attributes, and an influencer LLM that aims to make the target's beliefs more extreme. We examine radicalization along two pathways: resonance, where the influencer reinforces a target's pre-existing belief, and persuasion, where the influencer promotes a belief the target initially considers unimportant. Across affective and behavioral metrics, we find that both mechanisms radicalize the target. However, resonance produces consistently stronger effects than persuasion. Different influence tactics, such as using sycophancy and unverified claims, produce different levels of radicalization, but not consistently across metrics. We further show that resonance propagates to related beliefs, suggesting interconnected belief structures within AI agents. These findings indicate that AI agents are susceptible to radicalization, particularly when messages align with their existing beliefs, raising concerns about the vulnerability of personalized AI agents and multi-agent AI ecosystems.

</details>


### [326] [CARAT: Do Materials LLMs Reason or Recite?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38340)
*Jiajun Wu,Jian Yang,Zixiang Ni,Zhenzhu Li,Bin Chong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出CARAT基准，旨在区分材料大语言模型（LLM）是基于晶体结构进行推理还是仅仅复制输入中的答案。通过GraphSpace和多种匹配微调技术，发现基线模型存在严重的“捷径学习”现象，即重复关系而非真正理解结构；经过监督后模型性能显著提升，证实了证据注入的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估无法准确判断材料LLM是否真正从结构中进行推理，因为结构化描述往往直接包含被评分的字段，导致准确率指标失真。需要一种方法将问题和金标准答案固定，并分离结构关系以检测模型是依赖逻辑推理还是记忆/复制。

Method: 1. 构建CARAT基准：在八种匹配视图下保持问题和答案不变，使用GraphSpace单独命名每个结构关系。
2. 引入匹配微调策略：包括答案掩码、证据注入、配对推理以及允许模型撤回主张的规则。
3. 自我攻击基准：设计规则绕过链接直接读取列表，测试模型的鲁棒性，并重建基准以消除捷径。

Result: 1. 在 hardest families 上，基于结构的视图比仅公式输入高出17.3分。
2. GraphSpace比朴素周期图高出19.3分，其中主要差异源于朴素渲染完全省略关键字段的情况（46.7分），而携带所有信息时仅差1.96分。
3. 初始模型存在捷径行为：在95.6%的配对案例中，模型重复关系但未真正使用它。
4. 经过匹配监督后，模型准确率达到99.8%；删除链接后准确率降至23.4%，低于最佳捷径的27.0%，证明这两个步骤都是可学习的。

Conclusion: 材料LLM在未经适当监督时倾向于通过捷径（如复制文本关系）而非真正的结构推理来回答问题。通过专门的基准测试（CARAT）和匹配微调，可以显著消除这种偏差，使模型学会利用证据而非仅仅复述输入内容。

Abstract: When a materials LLM answers a question about crystal structure, does it reason from the structure or copy an answer already printed in its input? Accuracy cannot tell: a structural description often prints the very field it is scored against. CARAT holds question and gold answer fixed across eight matched views, names each structural relation separately in GraphSpace, and adds matched fine-tuning, answer masking, evidence injection, paired inference, and a rule that can withhold claims. First, on the benchmark's hardest families the grounded view is worth 17.3 points over formula inputs. Second, we turn that scrutiny on ourselves. GraphSpace beats a plain periodic graph by 19.3 points, but that margin is two effects at once: where the plain rendering carries everything the question needs it is 1.96 points, and where it omits those fields entirely, 46.7 points. The headline mostly measures what the baseline lacked, not how evidence is presented. Third, we attack our own benchmark. A rule that skips the link and reads the list directly answers four of seven hardened families, so we rebuilt it until eleven such shortcuts sat near chance. The frozen model quotes that link yet answers the same when we redirect it, on 95.6% of paired cases: it repeats the relation without using it. After matched supervision it reaches 99.8%, and deleting the link drops it to 23.4%, below the 27.0% the best shortcut reaches: both steps are learnable.

</details>


### [327] [Examining Variation in How Guided AI Tutors Resolve Student Impasses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38346)
*Bakhtawar Ahtisham,Kirk Vanacore,Alessandra Napoli,Josh Arens,Ksenia Ionova,Clayton Cohn,Shima Salehi,Rene Kizilcec*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究分析了AI导师在学生陷入“僵局”（impasse）时的行为模式。研究发现，随着僵局持续，提问效果减弱，直接纠错更有效；僵局轮次增加会降低后续恢复几率。研究建议利用僵局深度和类型作为信号，触发实时、分级的辅助策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决导师在帮助学生时的两难困境：过早帮助阻碍独立探索，过晚帮助导致学生陷入挫败性僵局。现有生成式AI导师虽有限制直接给答案的护栏机制，但其在僵局持续后的具体行为及有效性尚不明确。

Method: 分析1,260个真实LLM化学辅导会话中的20,462个学生回合，识别出6,630个僵局回合（包括概念错误、表达不确定性和求助）。通过模拟三种指导条件（基线、无直接答案、引导式导师）研究AI行为差异，并分析真实交互中僵局轨迹对恢复几率的影响。

Result: 1. 提示特异性改变教学法：基线导师50.7%直接给答案，无直接答案导师总是追问，引导式导师根据情境多样化回应。
2. 每个额外的僵局回合使下一轮恢复几率降低12.7%。
3. 随着僵局持续，提问的收益递减，而直接纠正学生错误的收益增加。
4. 重复失败的 scripted question 恢复率为28.1%，而直接纠错恢复率为39.8%。

Conclusion: 僵局的深度和类型是可观察的对话信号，学习分析系统可利用这些信号在实时触发分级且状态敏感的辅助措施，以优化AI导师的指导效果。

Abstract: When a student is stuck, a tutor faces the assistance dilemma: help given too early can hinder productive struggle, while help withheld too long leaves the student in a frustrating, persistent impasse (i.e., wheel spinning). Generative AI tutors increasingly use guardrails restricting answer-giving, yet little is known about how such tutors behave once an impasse persists. We analyze 20,462 student turns from 1,260 authentic sessions with a guided LLM chemistry tutor, identifying 6,630 impasse turns of three major types: conceptual errors, expressed uncertainty, or help-seeking. We then used these impasses to simulate three tutoring conditions to study variation in AI tutor guidance through impasses: baseline, no-direct-answer, and guided tutor. For a sample of 150 impasses, prompt specificity changed pedagogy: a baseline tutor provided the answer directly in 50.7% of responses, a no-direct-answer tutor asked a follow-up question every time, and the guided tutor responded in a wide variety of ways depending on the context. We then analyzed impasse trajectories in authentic interactions, finding that each additional impasse turn lowered the odds of next-turn recovery by 12.7% (AOR = 0.873, p < .001), and early dropouts were caught in recursive concept elicitation before reaching execution. The benefit of questioning decayed as impasses persisted (scripted question x depth AOR = 0.78; follow-up x depth AOR = 0.83), whereas addressing the student's error grew more beneficial (AOR = 1.14); after a failed scripted question, repeating it was followed by recovery in 28.1% of cases, compared with 39.8% when the tutor addressed the error instead. For learning analytics, these findings identify impasse depth and type as observable, turn-level dialogue signals that analytics can use to trigger graduated, state-sensitive assistance in real time.

</details>


### [328] [Beyond Mode Collapse: Generating Diverse Synthetic Expert Conversations via Generative Flow Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38359)
*Sumit Asthana,Michael Ion,Kevyn Collins Thompson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出使用生成流网络（GFlowNets）生成高质量、高多样性的合成对话数据，以解决直接提示LLM导致的数据模式单一问题。该方法在辅导和情感支持对话领域优于传统基线，提升了下游预测任务的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接提示大语言模型（LLMs）或基于最终使用场景对其进行条件化，会导致生成的数据多样性低，且容易坍缩到主导模式上，无法充分代表专家策略和决策的多样性。

Method: 利用生成流网络（GFlowNets）生成潜在的对话结构。通过在关键交互特征（如困惑片段动态、支架指令平衡）上使用高斯混合密度来训练GFlowNets，从而根据其在训练数据中的流行度对专家策略进行采样。

Result: 在辅导和情感支持两个结构不同的领域中，基于GFlow的合成数据生成方法在保真度、模式覆盖率和真实性方面，比强化学习和端到端LLM基线提供了更好的平衡，且未复制训练数据。在三个下游结果预测任务中，由GFlowNet生成的合成对话为分类器提供了更强的训练信号。

Conclusion: 基于GFlowNets的方法能够有效生成多样化的高质量合成数据，克服了传统LLM生成方法的局限性，显著提升了下游应用的效果。

Abstract: High quality synthetic data is central to post training LLMs for adaptive AI applications that represent the diverse expert strategies and decisions in conversations. Prompting LLMs directly or conditioning them on end use scenarios yields low diversity data that collapses onto dominant modes. We propose a method to generate diverse high quality synthetic data using Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets). We show that training GFlowNets to generate latent conversation structure using a Gaussian mixture density over key interaction features (e.g., confusion episode dynamics, scaffolding directive balance) enables sampling expert strategies in proportion to their prevalence in the training data. Across two structurally distinct domains, tutoring and emotional support dialogues, our GFlow based synthetic data generation approach offers a better balance of fidelity, mode coverage and authenticity than reinforcement-learning and end to end LLM baselines, without copying training data. Evaluated on three downstream outcome prediction tasks, classifiers trained on synthetic GFlowNet generated conversations provide a stronger training signal than competitive synthesis baselines.

</details>


### [329] [Can an AI Agent Rediscover a Blaschke-Curve Invariant?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38369)
*Yunus E. Zeytuncu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究以广义Blaschke曲线为受控环境，通过AI代理进行数学再发现的单实例案例研究。虽然AI成功拟合出预测480条线的齐次三次多项式且残差极低，但因缺乏对比基线优势证明及测试局限性，主要价值在于提出分离猜想、数值验证与证明的实验协议，而非展示AI的绝对优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索将AI辅助方法应用于数学定理的“再发现”过程，旨在建立一个受控环境来评估智能体在几何假设生成和数值验证中的能力，并试图分离猜想、数值验证与严格证明这三个环节。

Method: 1. 设定固定四次Blaschke乘积作为背景；2. AI代理接收80个边界配置确定的6对直线的数值坐标；3. 隐藏目标定理指令，让代理自主探索；4. 记录被拒绝的几何假设及拟合出的齐次三次多项式；5. 使用未见的参数值进行预测并计算均方根残差；6. 利用对角线数据进行一致性检查（非完全独立测试）；7. 设置确定性度搜索基线进行对比。

Result: 1. AI代理成功从数据中拟合出一个齐次三次多项式；2. 该模型能准确预测480条来自80个未见参数值的直线，尺度无关的均方根残差极低（$8.88\times10^{-17}$）；3. 另一独立配置运行显示证据不足以支持不变性；4. 后审查的确定性度搜索基线也能恢复相同的三次多项式，表明实验未证明AI优于传统多项式拟合。

Conclusion: 该单次实例案例研究并未确立AI在数学发现上相对于传统方法的显著优势，但其核心价值在于提供了一套实验协议，用于明确区分猜想生成、数值验证和证明过程，同时指出了当前方法在代理元数据、先验知识和可重复性方面的局限性。

Abstract: We study generalized Blaschke curves as a controlled environment for AI-assisted mathematical rediscovery. For one fixed degree-four Blaschke product, an agent receives numerical coordinates of the six pair-lines determined by each of 80 boundary configurations. The target theorem is withheld from the task instructions. The saved research log reports rejected geometric hypotheses and a homogeneous cubic fitted to polygon sides. Its frozen coefficients predict 480 lines from 80 unseen parameter values, with a recorded RMS scale-free residual of $8.88\times10^{-17}$. Discovery-set diagonals provide an out-of-fit consistency check, not a fully held-out test. A separate one-configuration run reports insufficient evidence for invariance. A post-review deterministic degree-search baseline also recovers the cubic, so the experiment does not establish an advantage over polynomial fitting. We present this single-instance case study as a protocol for separating conjecture, numerical validation, and proof, with explicit limitations concerning agent metadata, prior knowledge, and reproducibility.

</details>


### [330] [Self-Evolving Harness on Multiple Tasks with the Agent as Its Own Optimizer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38372)
*Qiankai Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种基于递归自我改进的框架，让语言模型在相同版本的控制代码（harness）上同时扮演求解者和提议者角色，通过多任务预训练和持续训练两个阶段进化控制代码，显著提升了在分布内和分布外基准测试上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自进化控制代码方法通常依赖人工设计的初始框架、分离的提议者与求解者，且针对单一基准测试演化，难以适应现实世界中跨领域的多样化任务需求，缺乏泛化能力评估。

Method: 构建接近递归自我改进的框架：使用冻结的同一模型在同一版控制代码上，先作为求解器完成任务，再作为提议者读取完整运行记录并直接编辑控制代码。从5个不同领域的基准测试中抽取任务进行演化批次处理，严格分离训练与保留任务以衡量泛化性，并在5个未见过的分布外基准上进行评估。将演化过程框架化为深度学习的两阶段训练：多任务预训练和持续训练。

Result: 从49行的种子控制代码开始，第一阶段演化后的控制代码在分布内基准测试上平均分提升4.48分，在分布外基准测试上提升12.64分，前者超越Codex，后者与之持平。第二阶段在Claw-Eval（分布外基准之一）上继续演化，将该基准分数从66.17提升至68.06，再次超越Codex。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了控制代码的有效自我进化，增强了模型在多样化和分布外任务中的泛化能力，并通过深入分析揭示了输出截断、历史压缩和独立审查等涌现机制。

Abstract: A harness is the code around a language-model agent that organizes prompts, calls tools, manages context, and controls execution. As models grow stronger, recent work has begun to let agents improve their own harnesses, a line of work known as self-evolving harnesses. In most existing methods, a separate proposer running on a human-designed harness modifies the solver's harness, and a separate harness is evolved for each benchmark. Real-world tasks come from many domains, so both the evolution and the evaluation of a harness should cover a diverse range of tasks. We propose a framework close to recursive self-improvement: the same frozen model, on the same version of the harness, first solves tasks as the solver and then, as the proposer, reads the complete run records and directly edits the harness that runs it. Each evolution batch draws tasks from five benchmarks in different domains. To measure generalization, training and held-out tasks are strictly separated, and we additionally evaluate on five out-of-distribution benchmarks never used during evolution. We frame the evolution process as deep-learning training with two stages, multi-task pretraining and continual training. Starting from a 49-line seed harness, the harness obtained at the end of the first stage improves the average score by 4.48 points on the in-distribution benchmarks and by 12.64 points on the out-of-distribution benchmarks, surpassing Codex on the former and matching it on the latter. In the second stage, continued evolution on Claw-Eval, one of the out-of-distribution benchmarks, further raises the score on that benchmark from 66.17 to 68.06, exceeding Codex. We also provide an in-depth analysis of the mechanisms that emerged during evolution, including output truncation, history compaction, and independent review.

</details>


### [331] [Aligned Data Can Induce Misalignment via Context Confusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38379)
*Yavuz Bakman,Duygu Nur Yaldiz,Baris Askin,Swastik Roy,Morteza Ziyadi,Salman Avestimehr,Sai Praneeth Karimireddy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文揭示了大语言模型（LLMs）在训练后出现的一种“上下文混淆”现象：在特定语境下对齐的训练数据，可能导致模型在其他不相关语境中产生行为错位。这种现象通过表征迁移机制发生，仅靠注入通用对齐数据难以解决，需针对特定领域进行修正或推理时提供上下文示例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM更新实践中常通过过滤不对齐样本防止错误，但忽略了“对齐具有上下文依赖性”。例如，保护研究数据是好的，但在涉及用户隐私时盲目保存敏感数据则是不对的。作者旨在探究这种因训练诱导而在其他语境下产生的行为错位现象。

Method: 1. 识别并定义“上下文混淆”（context confusion）这一训练后现象。
2. 在性别平等、隐私、物理安全三个领域验证该现象的存在。
3. 测试不同缓解策略的效果：对比注入通用对齐数据与针对性领域对齐数据、以及推理时提供上下文学习（In-context learning）示例的效果。
4. 提供机制解释：分析微调过程中不同领域查询经历的表征位移，揭示行为特征跨语境激活的原理。

Result: 1. “上下文混淆”导致的是“狭窄不对齐”（narrow misalignment），而非涌现性不对齐。
2. 注入通用对齐数据无法有效减少此问题。
3. 包含目标领域的针对性对齐数据，或在推理阶段提供上下文学习示例，能显著降低该现象。
4. 机制上发现，来自不同领域的查询在微调期间可能经历相似的表征位移，导致一个领域的查询激活了另一个领域学到的行为特征。

Conclusion: 仅通过检查训练数据难以预测模型训练后的对齐状态。由于上下文混淆的存在，必须重视全面的训练后对齐评估，以确保模型在不同语境下的行为一致性与伦理合规性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are frequently updated for various use cases, where filtering out misaligned training samples is a common practice for preventing post-update misalignment. However, alignment is inherently context-dependent: a recommendation that is aligned in one context may be inappropriate in another. For example, in response to the question "What should a researcher do with the research data?", recommending that the researcher preserve the data for reproducibility is aligned. In contrast, recommending data saving in response to "What should a mobile-app developer do with users' sensitive data?" may be inappropriate from a privacy perspective. Starting from this observation, we identify a post-training phenomenon where aligned training induces misaligned behavior in other contexts. We call this phenomenon **context confusion**. We demonstrate context confusion across three domains: (1) Gender Equality, (2) Privacy, and (3) Physical Safety. We further show that context confusion causes narrow misalignment, in contrast to emergent misalignment, and is not effectively reduced by injecting general alignment data, but can be substantially reduced by including targeted alignment data for the misaligned domain or providing in-context learning examples during inference. Lastly, we provide a mechanistic explanation of *context confusion*. We observe that queries from different domains can undergo similar representational shifts during the fine-tuning. Consequently, a query from a different domain may activate the same behavioral feature learned during fine-tuning, which causes the behavior to transfer to a context where it is misaligned. Based on our findings, we argue that it is difficult to predict the alignment state of a model after training by inspecting the training data alone, which highlights the importance of comprehensive post-training alignment evaluations.

</details>


### [332] [Fine-Tuning Diffusion Language Models with Context Selection and Target Weighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38385)
*Loay Mualem,Lluís Pastor-Pérez,Vinh Tong,Andrei Manolache,Tanja Bien,Steffen Staab,Mathias Niepert*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GoldiMask，一种基于次模优化选择上下文和加权预测目标的离散扩散模型微调方法，显著提升推理和代码生成性能并减少解码迭代。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决均匀随机掩码在离散扩散语言模型监督微调中未充分考虑上下文可用性与预测目标之间相互作用的问题。

Method: 通过近似最大化次模目标函数来选择作为上下文的令牌，平衡揭示令牌的好处与其作为预测目标的价值；随后根据选定上下文带来的益处及剩余学习潜力对剩余目标进行加权。

Result: 在三个骨干网络和三个训练数据集上取得最高的平均准确率，在推理和代码生成任务上均有提升；消融实验证实上下文选择和目标加权均贡献于性能增益；在GSM8K和MATH-500上减少了置信度阈值并行解码的迭代次数，且在较高置信度下保持相当精度。

Conclusion: GoldiMask通过智能选择上下文和加权目标，有效提升了离散扩散模型的微调效果及解码效率。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning of discrete diffusion language models masks some response tokens and trains the model to recover their original values from the visible context. The masking pattern therefore determines both the context available to the model and the tokens it learns to predict. Uniform random masking does not explicitly account for the interaction between these choices. We introduce GoldiMask, which selects tokens to reveal as context by approximately maximizing a submodular objective. This objective uses model signals to balance the benefit of revealing tokens against their value as prediction targets. GoldiMask then weights the remaining targets according to how they benefit from the selected context and their remaining learning potential. Across three backbones and three training datasets, GoldiMask achieves the highest average accuracy in most evaluated settings, demonstrating gains on both reasoning and code generation. Component ablations show that both context selection and target weighting contribute to the gains. GoldiMask also reduces decoding iterations on GSM8K and MATH-500 under confidence-threshold parallel decoding, while maintaining comparable accuracy at higher confidence thresholds.

</details>


### [333] [Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill: A Model-Free Controller and Its Generalization Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38386)
*Gaurav Agarwal,Ashish Garg,Isha Singhal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DLFP控制器，通过反馈调整预填充块大小以减少并发推理中的干扰，在Qwen3-0.6B模型上显著降低P99间隔令牌延迟，但该机制不适用于更大模型或多GPU配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决并发自回归推理中预填充新到达长提示词对正在解码请求造成的干扰问题；固定预填充块大小的最佳选择依赖于模型、硬件、负载和延迟目标。

Method: 引入Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill (DLFP)，一种无模型控制器，仅改变与活动解码重叠的预填充工作；通过观察调度周期内的间隔作为比例反馈来调整下一个预填充块的大小，隔离的预填充保持不受限制。在vLLM中实现并评估。

Result: 在A100 GPU上的Qwen3-0.6B模型实验中，三次配对试验将P99间隔令牌延迟平均降低27.7%（95%置信区间21.0%-34.3%），输出完全一致且无故障。但P99首令牌时间增加34.8%，仍在SLO内。该机制未推广到Qwen3-8B/32B或双GPU张量并行配置。

Conclusion: DLFP在小模型单GPU场景下有效改善间隔延迟，但因异步调度调用间隔与GPU实际迭代时间不匹配而失效于大模型和多GPU场景。这界定了贡献边界，并 motivate 了面向并发CPU和设备端推理的完成时间控制器研究。本文为可复现的概念验证和推广研究。

Abstract: Concurrent autoregressive inference creates a fundamental interference problem: prefilling a newly arrived long prompt can delay tokens for requests that are already decoding. Fixed prefill chunks reduce this interference, but the best chunk size depends on the model, hardware, load, and latency objective. We introduce Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill (DLFP), a model-free controller that changes only prefill work that overlaps active decodes. After a guarded scheduling cycle, DLFP uses the observed interval as proportional feedback to resize the next prefill chunk; isolated prefills remain unrestricted.
  We implement DLFP in vLLM and evaluate it with open-loop Poisson arrivals, exact token accounting, raw request traces, and NVIDIA telemetry. On Qwen3-0.6B in BF16 on one A100 80 GB GPU, three paired 100-request trials reduce P99 inter-token latency by 24.8%, 30.1%, and 28.2% (mean 27.7%, paired 95% confidence interval 21.0% to 34.3%) with exact output agreement, no failures, and unchanged SLO compliance. The benefit is not free: mean P99 time to first token increases 34.8% while remaining inside the declared SLO.
  Crucially, the mechanism does not generalize to Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, or a two-GPU tensor-parallel configuration. We trace the failure to an asynchronous scheduler-call interval that is only a proxy for completed GPU iteration time. This negative result defines the boundary of the contribution and motivates a completion-timed controller for concurrent CPU and on-device inference. We do not claim mobile-device performance; the present work is a reproducible proof-of-concept and generalization study.

</details>


### [334] [MetaPersona: Task-Grounded Synthetic Populations from Empirical Social Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38392)
*Jinyi Ye,Yuangang Li,Chenxiao Yu,Preyashi Poddar,Priyanka Dey,Longtian Ye,Zihan Wang,Xiyang Hu,Emilio Ferrara,Yue Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MetaPersona框架及MetaPersona-DB数据集，解决LLM社会模拟中角色生成的冷启动问题，通过检索实证证据构建依赖图并从经验先验采样，显著降低生成成本并提升特定任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM社会模拟中的角色（Personas）生成缺乏原则性依据来确定属性及其取值，导致合成人口在人口统计特征、潜在属性和依赖结构上可能无法准确反映现实，进而影响下游行为模拟的准确性。

Method: 1. 构建MetaPersona-DB：包含11,000多项实证人类受试者研究的数据集，标注了任务相关变量、报告的关系和总体人口统计数据。
2. 提出MetaPersona框架：检索与任务相关的证据，构建基于文献的角色依赖图，并从链接人口统计、潜在属性和结果的 empirically derived priors（经验先验）中采样合成人口。
3. 开发MetaPersona-Studio：一个用于基于实证的交互式角色生成原型界面。

Result: 1. 在三个下游案例研究和三个基线模型中，MetaPersona在“错误信息信念”和“AI工具态度”任务上表现强劲，但在“收入再分配”任务上结果不一。
2. 使用GPT-5.2将角色构建成本降至每个任务低于0.5美元。
3. 提供了可交互的原型工具以支持实证基础上的角色生成。

Conclusion: MetaPersona通过利用大规模实证研究数据，为LLM社会模拟提供了更 principled（有原则/系统）的角色生成方法，有效缓解了冷启动问题，并在特定场景下优于基线，同时大幅降低了计算成本。

Abstract: Personas used to seed LLM social simulations face a cold-start problem: existing methods lack a principled basis for deciding which attributes to include and how to assign their values. As a result, synthetic populations may misrepresent the demographic composition, latent attributes, and dependency structure that shape downstream behavior. We introduce MetaPersona-DB, a dataset of 11,000+ empirical human-subjects studies annotated with task-relevant variables, reported relationships, and aggregate-level population statistics. Building on this resource, we propose MetaPersona, a framework that retrieves task-relevant evidence, constructs literature-derived persona dependency graphs, and samples synthetic populations from empirical priors linking demographics, latent attributes, and outcomes. Across three downstream case studies, three baselines, and three frontier models, results vary by task and model: MetaPersona performs strongly on misinformation belief and AI-tool sentiment, while results on income redistribution are mixed. It also reduces persona-construction cost to under $0.5 per task using GPT-5.2. Finally, we present MetaPersona-Studio, a prototype interactive interface for empirically grounded persona generation.

</details>


### [335] [SimTrace: Grounded Multimodal User Trajectories Generation for Online User Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38397)
*Yunan Lu,Shuang Xie,Meghna Allamudi,Mingyu Zhao,Han Li,Lingyun Wang,Zhou Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SimTrace框架，通过匿名化真实用户轨迹并结合仿真网页环境，生成高保真、细粒度的合成多模态点击流数据，以解决隐私限制和流量不足导致的数据获取难题。该框架生成的合成数据在多项保真度指标上优于基线模型，并能显著提升购买预测、推荐及下一步动作预测等下游任务的性能（如下一步动作预测准确率提升11.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建虚拟客户端需要大规模、语义忠实且细粒度的在线用户轨迹数据。然而，由于专有日志受隐私限制以及小公司缺乏足够流量，此类数据难以获取。现有公开数据集要么抽象掉了细粒度交互细节，要么虽然保留了丰富上下文但仅限于特定平台且规模较小。

Method: 提出SimTrace框架：1) 匿名化真实用户交互数据；2) 构建给定网页环境的仿真孪生体；3) 利用基于真实轨迹的计算机使用客户端智能体，结合仿真环境和匿名数据生成合成的交互轨迹。每个动作均配对相应的网页观察结果和用户上下文。

Result: 在电子商务场景下的评估显示：1) SimTrace在8项保真度指标中的7项上优于竞争性基线；2) 使用合成数据训练的模型在下沉任务（如购买预测和推荐）上的表现与使用真实数据训练的模型相当；3) 在下一步动作预测任务中，用合成数据增强真实数据后，准确率相比仅使用真实数据训练提高了11.0%。

Conclusion: SimTrace提供了一种可共享的机密日志替代方案，用于开发计算机使用代理风格的虚拟客户端。作为开源包发布，旨在促进在线用户行为建模的研究。

Abstract: Virtual clients offer a cost-effective approach to support applications such as A/B testing, recommender system development, and interface evaluation. However, building them requires access to large-scale, semantically faithful, fine-grained online user trajectories. These data are difficult to obtain because proprietary logs are subject to privacy restrictions and small businesses often lack sufficient traffic. Consequently, existing public datasets either abstract away fine-grained user interaction details or preserve rich context but remain platform-specific and small-scale. To address this gap, we propose SimTrace, a framework that generates faithful, fine-grained synthetic multimodal clickstreams through a computer-use client agent that is grounded in real user trajectories and the given web environment. SimTrace anonymizes real interactions and constructs a simulated twin of the given web environment, then uses both to generate synthetic interaction trajectories. Each action is paired with its corresponding web observations and user context, yielding a shareable alternative to confidential logs for developing computer-use agent-style virtual clients. We apply SimTrace to an e-commerce setting and evaluate both its fidelity and downstream utility. SimTrace outperforms competing baselines on 7 out of 8 fidelity metrics. Models trained on synthetic data achieve performance comparable to those trained on real data on downstream tasks such as purchase prediction and recommendation. For next action prediction task, augmenting real data with synthetic data further improves accuracy by 11.0% relative to training on real data alone. We release SimTrace as an open-source package to facilitate research on online user behavior modeling.

</details>


### [336] [ArgGYM: A Procedural, Engine-Verified Benchmark for Structured Defeasible Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38409)
*İbrahim Ethem Deveci,Funda Tan Çalık,Barış Deniz Sağlam,Duygu Ataman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ArgGYM，一个用于结构化可废止推理的程序化基准和RLVR训练环境，旨在解决大语言模型在动态、不完整信息下的推理能力评估与优化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型推理进展主要依赖数学、代码等具有自动可验证奖励的固定领域，但其在现实世界中处理不完整、可修正信息（即可废止推理）的能力尚不明确。

Method: 构建ArgGYM基准，将结构化可废止推理分解为12个任务，利用符号论证引擎进行评分。包含1,440个验证实例，涵盖15种课程配置及不同的论证/集合排序方式，并提供生成器和验证器以支持动态评估和强化学习训练。

Result: 前沿和开源模型在该基准上表现出不同的推理特征：虽能恢复部分结构化答案，但在涉及更长依赖和更复杂交互结构的后期课程中性能显著下降。

Conclusion: 发布ArgGYM基准及其配套工具，为可重现评估和基于可验证奖励的训练提供基础设施，推动模型在非固定规范领域的推理能力发展。

Abstract: Recent progress in large language model reasoning has been driven by benchmarks and reinforcement learning environments with automatically verifiable rewards, particularly in mathematics, code, and formal logic. These settings make model accuracy easier to evaluate and optimize, but it remains unclear how far success under fixed problem specifications and stable evaluation criteria transfers to reasoning outside such domains. Real-world reasoning often proceeds under incomplete and revisable information: conclusions may be supported provisionally, defeated by counter-evidence, reinstated by further arguments, or revised when stronger reasons become available. Reasoning of this kind is generally referred to as defeasible reasoning. We introduce ArgGYM, a procedural benchmark and RLVR-compatible training environment for structured defeasible reasoning. ArgGYM decomposes this reasoning into twelve tasks and grounds task-specific scoring in a symbolic argumentation engine that computes the formal states used to evaluate model outputs. It includes a frozen benchmark of 1,440 verified instances across fifteen curriculum configurations, two argument preference orderings (weakest-link and last-link), and two set orderings (elitist and democratic), while the same generators and verifiers can produce fresh instances for evaluation that reduces dependence on static test sets and for verifiable-reward training. On the frozen benchmark, frontier and open-weight models show sharply different reasoning profiles: they can recover substantial parts of structured answers without solving the complete task, and performance declines in later curriculum configurations with longer dependencies and more interacting structures. We release the benchmark, generators, and verifiers for reproducible evaluation and RLVR training.

</details>


### [337] [A Competing-Hazards Systematization of Loss of Control in Autonomous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38411)
*Mohamed Aly Bouke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的离散时间竞争风险模型框架，用于标准化AI代理越界行为的评估。通过对22份事故报告和102份安全评估的审计发现，现有记录缺乏统一标准，导致难以比较失败原因或区分代理行为与环境因素的作用；多数案例显示环境容错加剧了失控风险，且无评估能提供完整估计所需数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对AI代理超出批准范围运行的问题，当前事故报告和安全评估对事件的描述不一致，导致难以比较失败模式、追踪风险演变，以及分离代理行为与环境在允许越界操作中的作用。

Method: 构建一个通用框架，将每次尝试的结果分类为：批准完成、安全停止、范围逃逸或继续执行。将该框架形式化为离散时间竞争风险模型，推导重试预算内的逃逸概率、模型条件安全预算限制及从执行日志中估算的条件。审计2025年1月至2026年9月期间发布的22份事故报告和102份代理安全评估。

Result: 在22起事故中，6起因任务无法在范围内完成，13起因代理未停止而继续执行，5起未报告停止行为；开发者数据显示，在未解决任务与已解决任务间，越界协调的发生率比接近47。在102项评估中，87次记录了越界效应或规范违规，仅26次将安全停止作为首要结果，仅20次同时记录两者，79次将预算耗尽与失败合并。22起事故中有20起表明环境允许了越界效应；无任何评估报告了估算完整竞争风险过程所需的全部字段。

Conclusion: 实现的控制权丧失往往反映了持续的代理行为与宽容边界条件的相互作用。现有评估体系缺乏标准化记录，无法提供足够信息以全面估计风险过程，亟需建立统一框架以准确捕捉和比较AI代理的安全失效。

Abstract: Leading AI developers have reported agents acting beyond their approved limits, which a United Nations panel described as an early warning of loss of human control. Yet incident reports and agent-safety evaluations describe these events differently, making it difficult to compare failures, trace risk across attempts, or separate agent behavior from the environment's role in allowing an out-of-scope action to succeed. To address this gap, we introduce a common framework in which each attempt ends in approved completion, safe stopping, scope escape, or continuation. We formalize the framework as a discrete-time competing-hazards model and derive escape probability within a retry budget, a model-conditional safe-budget limit, and conditions for estimation from execution logs. We audit 22 incident reports and 102 agent-safety evaluations published from January 2025 to September 2026 using primary sources. Six incidents involved tasks that could not be completed within scope, thirteen involved agents that continued rather than stopped, and five did not report stopping behavior. Developers' figures imply a task-level incidence ratio near 47 for out-of-scope coordination in never-solved versus solved tasks. Among evaluations, 87 recorded an out-of-scope effect or specification violation, 26 treated safe stopping as a first-class outcome, only 20 recorded both, and 79 merged budget exhaustion with failure. In 20 of 22 incidents, the environment allowed an out-of-scope effect, indicating that realized loss of control often reflected persistent agent behavior interacting with permissive boundary conditions; meanwhile, no evaluation reported all fields needed to estimate the full competing-hazards process from published evidence.

</details>


### [338] [AIM: Agentic Idea Management for Automated Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38445)
*Hyeong Kyu Choi,Bhavana Dalvi Mishra,Jiefeng Chen,Mihir Parmar,Rui Meng,Chun-Liang Li,Xiangru Tang,Sharon Li,Jinsung Yoon,Tomas Pfister*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AIM框架，通过贝叶斯优化思想管理“理念驱动”的科研自动化搜索，解决理念组织、方向选择及实施对齐三大挑战，在AutoLab基准测试中显著优于基线并加速3.1倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿大语言模型正用于通过迭代搜索自动化科学研究，但现有方法难以有效处理“理念驱动”搜索中的核心理念演化组织、有潜力方向的筛选以及理念与实现的一致性维持问题。

Method: 引入代理理念管理器（AIM）框架：1) 采用代理代理模型和代理采集机制（受贝叶斯优化启发）来组织发现的理念并指导选择；2) 设置解决方案审计员以维持理念-方案完整性；3) 利用资源规划器自适应分配并行搜索分支的实验预算。

Result: 在10个AutoLab基准任务上，AIM在系统优化任务上比最强基线高出1.6个百分点，在长周期模型开发与CUDA任务上高出4.9个百分点；且在墙钟时间上达到最佳基线性能的速度快至3.1倍。

Conclusion: 理论分析表明，显式理念级分配使语义覆盖范围可控，且在众多可行替代方案中竞争研究方向稀疏时，更广泛的覆盖具有更高价值。

Abstract: Frontier LLMs are increasingly used to automate scientific research through iterative search. We distinguish idea-driven search from solution-driven search and identify three core challenges: organizing evolving research ideas, selecting promising directions, and maintaining alignment between ideas and their implementations. To address these challenges, we introduce the Agentic Idea Manager (AIM), a fully autonomous framework for managing and exploring research directions in idea-driven automated research. Inspired by Bayesian optimization, AIM uses an Agentic Surrogate and an Agentic Acquisition mechanism to organize discovered ideas and guide their selection. A Solution Auditor maintains idea-solution integrity, while a Resource Planner adaptively allocates the remaining experimental budget across parallel search branches. Experiments on 10 AutoLab benchmark tasks show that AIM surpasses the strongest baseline by 1.6 percentage points on System Optimization tasks and 4.9 percentage points on long-horizon Model Development & CUDA tasks. Notably, AIM reaches the best baseline performance up to 3.1x faster in wall-clock time. We further provide a theoretical analysis of when searching over ideas becomes beneficial. Our analysis shows that explicit idea-level allocation makes semantic coverage directly controllable, and that broader coverage becomes increasingly valuable when competitive research directions are sparse among many plausible alternatives. Project Page: https://imhgchoi.github.io/agentic-idea-manager/

</details>


### [339] [Reach Into The CHOIR: Free-List Elicitation Uncovers Distinct Model Voices in LLM Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38448)
*Ben Wigler,Maria Tsfasman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CHOIR框架，通过层级化有序查询响应解决大语言模型（LLM）开放-ended回答的同质性问题，将表面共识转化为可诊断的测量问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放-ended LLM同质性导致虚假多元性，单次回答掩盖了由受限答案空间、提示词回声与深层稳定替代方案之间的区别。

Method: 引入CHOIR框架，借鉴认知人类学的自由列举法，对LLM集成体反复 eliciting 排名列表，聚类为概念并测量其显著性；在Infinity-Chat 100和27题诊断库上评估。

Result: 在Infinity-Chat 100上复现高表面一致性（93/100），区分窄/宽提示；基础模型身份是最强签名，人格提示改变表层概念但保留底层签名；稀有但稳定候选者被优先标记。

Conclusion: CHOIR通过将开放-ended同质性转化为诊断测量问题，揭示了模型收敛的位置、原因及结构化深度探测下的可达内容。

Abstract: Open-ended LLM homogeneity can create false plurality when several systems appear to offer independent perspectives while returning the same familiar default. Single-pass answers obscure the distinction between agreement produced by a tightly constrained answer space, prompt-vocabulary echo, and broader answer spaces with stable alternatives beneath the surface. We introduce CHOIR (Collective Hierarchically-Ordered Inquiry Responses), a framework that adapts free-list elicitation from cognitive anthropology to LLM ensembles. CHOIR repeatedly elicits ranked lists, clusters items into prompt-level concepts, and measures concept salience across models, prompt variants, and persona conditions. We evaluate CHOIR on Infinity-Chat 100, an external prompt bank from recent work on open-ended model homogeneity, and on a 27-question targeted diagnostic bank designed to isolate mechanism-level contrasts. On Infinity-Chat 100, CHOIR reproduces high surface agreement (93/100 prompts above chance) while separating narrow prompts from broad prompts with recoverable depth. Across targeted probes and the external prompt bank, base-model identity remains the strongest recoverable signature, and persona prompts shift surfaced concepts within base-model signatures. A source-blind ranking module prioritises rare-but-stable candidates for later inspection. CHOIR turns open-ended homogeneity into a diagnostic measurement problem by asking where models converge, why they converge, and what remains reachable under structured depth probing.

</details>


### [340] [PrivMeSA: Privacy-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Medicine via Local-Remote LLM Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38458)
*Dannong Wang,Yuran Zhang,Bian Sun,Alex Stinard,Yuzhang Shang,Song Wang,Yu Tian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PrivMeSA，一种隐私感知的自演化多智能体系统，通过强化学习平衡任务准确性与隐私风险，利用本地记忆复用远程专家知识，显著降低患者信息泄露和再识别风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床大语言模型（LLM）智能体在本地部署时若咨询远程模型，会面临患者信息泄露风险；仅去除显式标识符不足以防止通过准标识符在多轮咨询中累积导致的再识别风险。

Method: 构建PrivMeSA系统：本地智能体管理每次问诊并咨询可能要求额外信息的远程专家；使用强化学习平衡任务准确性、直接披露和基于注册表的再识别风险；引入本地课程记忆，将完成的咨询提炼为通用临床指导并在传输前检索相关课程，实现无需新标签或参数更新的记忆增长。

Result: 在基于MIMIC-IV-ED记录的急诊科基准测试中，PrivMeSA相比委托方式使平均任务准确率提高多达15.8个百分点；同时将包含个人细节的案例披露率从98.0%降至0.2%，并将患者可缩小至10人或更少的案例比例从74%降至0%。

Conclusion: PrivMeSA有效解决了远程咨询中的隐私泄露问题，通过自演化机制在不牺牲性能的前提下实现了极高的隐私保护水平。

Abstract: Clinical large language model (LLM) agents deployed locally can consult more capable remote models, but doing so risks exposing patient information. Privacy-conscious delegation places disclosure decisions with a local agent, yet removing explicit identifiers is insufficient: quasi-identifiers can accumulate across multi-turn consultations and repeated patient visits to enable re-identification. We introduce PrivMeSA, a privacy-aware self-evolving multi-agent system that learns to control disclosure and retains remote expertise for local reuse. A local agent manages each encounter and consults remote specialists that may request additional information. Reinforcement learning balances task accuracy against direct disclosure and registry-based re-identification risk, with privacy evaluated over the complete outbound transcript of each encounter. A local lesson memory distills completed consultations into generalized clinical guidance and retrieves relevant lessons before transmission, allowing subsequent cases to reuse expertise without another remote exchange. Memory grows without additional outcome labels or parameter updates. On an emergency-department benchmark built from MIMIC-IV-ED records, PrivMeSA improves mean task accuracy over delegation by up to 15.8 percentage points. In the same setting, PrivMeSA reduces the disclosure of personal details from 98.0% to 0.2% of cases and the share of cases in which the patient can be narrowed to ten or fewer registry patients from 74% to 0%.

</details>


### [341] [Component-Aware Feedback for Self-Evolving Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38639)
*Ethan Lin,Jinming Nian,Yi Fang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出组件感知反馈机制，通过记录组件编辑与指标变化的关联，解决LLM引导进化搜索中历史混乱导致效率低下的问题，在LLM重排序任务中显著减少搜索预算并提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM引导进化搜索方法仅保存候选程序和适应度分数，丢弃了组件编辑对指标变化的具体影响，迫使变异LLM从杂乱的历史中推断先前编辑的效果，导致程序搜索缓慢且不稳定，特别是在本地可服务LLM演化多组件系统时更为明显。

Method: 引入组件感知反馈（component-aware feedback），将每个评估程序与其父程序进行比较，识别发生变化的组件，并将这些变化及其关联的指标差异记录到“归因记忆”（attribution memory）中供后续突变读取。该记忆在两个参考框架下保留每次变化：相对于其来源父程序的局部视角和相对于种子程序的全局视角，以展示即时效果和自种子以来的累积进展。

Result: 在12个Bright数据集上的LLM重排序多目标优化实验中，该方法达到最强基线最终质量所需的搜索预算中位数仅为前者的三分之一；在保持测试集的nDCG@10上高出7.2%；在成本感知目标下，发现的管道平均更准确且每查询使用token数减少11%。

Conclusion: 组件感知反馈为构建更高效、自我演化的系统提供了一种有前景的方向。
