### [447] [Agent Error Dataset: Scaling 50,000 Error--Diagnosis Pairs for Failure Analysis and Error-Aware Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40111)
*Kunlun Zhu,Xuyan Ye,Yibo Li,Cheng Qian,Beibin Li,Heng Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Agent Error Dataset (AED)和Agentic Error-to-Training (AET)流程，利用LLM智能体失败轨迹中的诊断与修正信息提升模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 失败的LLM智能体执行轨迹包含丰富信息（观察、动作、环境反馈），但目前缺乏有效机制来重用这些经验以改进学习过程。

Method: 构建包含50,228个错误诊断对的AED数据集；设计五阶段AET流水线收集自然故障、生成诊断与修正建议并验证；对比重放结果；分别构建诊断训练视图和执行器恢复训练视图。

Result: 1. 首次提出的修正方案使验证器通过率从18.4%提升至51.1%（+32.7%）；2. Qwen3-8B在完整诊断微调后，精确步骤一致性从47.2%提升至63.6%，优于最强提示参考的54.7%；3. 仅动作修复训练比成功导向训练在WebShop-lite上高出6.67个百分点。

Conclusion: 基于失败轨迹的诊断与修正数据能显著提升LLM智能体的推理准确性和执行成功率，证明了重用错误经验的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: An unsuccessful LLM agent rollout contains more information than its final reward: the observations available to the agent, the actions it chose, and the environment's responses. Reusing this experience for learning requires identifying a decision to revise and testing a concrete alternative. We introduce the Agent Error Dataset (AED), comprising 50,228 error-diagnosis pairs from 9,961 source tasks across 33 environments, 19 harness families, and 23 policy models in text-based agent systems. We retain source traces and execution metadata to support cross-setting failure analysis and re-diagnosis without repeating the original rollout. Our five-stage Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) pipeline collects natural failures, generates diagnoses and proposed corrections, and checks them against recorded evidence. Where replay is supported, we compare corrections with original-action retries from the same checkpoint under matched execution settings. We then construct separate training views for diagnosis and actor recovery. Across 3,062 matched replay pairs, first-proposal corrections raise verifier pass rates from 18.4% to 51.1%, a gain of 32.7 percentage points. Using a separately frozen diagnosis release, full-diagnosis fine-tuning on 1,656 source tasks raises Qwen3-8B's exact-step agreement with internal teacher labels from 47.2% to 63.6%, averaged over three seeds on a 943-case holdout. The strongest prompted reference in this comparison scores 54.7%, and mean agreement improves at each of four increasing training-set sizes. In a single-seed comparison of actor-training recipes, action-only repair training scores 6.67 percentage points higher on WebShop-lite than success-only training.

</details>


### [448] [Unlearnable, or Unmeasured? On the Reliability of Difficulty Labels in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40115)
*Chandak Chakma,Syed Nazmus Sakib,Nafiul Haque,Shifat E. Arman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了强化学习中“不可学习”现象，发现该现象确实存在（尽管速率较慢），但之前用于定义难例的标签和解释其成因的梯度相似性证据均存在测量偏差，需更严谨的评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究指出某些困难提示即使在偶尔产生正确解的情况下仍难以学习（即“不可学习”现象）。然而，现有的难度标签基于有限采样，可复现性低，且解释机制的证据可能受样本量偏差影响。本研究旨在纠正这些方法论缺陷并重新验证该现象的真实性。

Method: 1. 开发基于采样的框架，量化难度标签的不稳定性，并确定可靠复现所需的评价规模；
2. 通过控制样本数量，重新检验用于解释“不可学习”的梯度相似性证据，排除因困难提示正确 rollout 较少导致的估计偏差。

Result: 1. 受影响提示的学习速度约为可学习提示的三分之一，证实慢速学习现象依然存在；
2. 难度定义的集合具有高度不稳定性，合并不同种子会显著改变选定的提示集；
3. 匹配样本数量后，梯度差异减弱但未完全消失，表明部分分离源于样本量不足而非本质差异。

Conclusion: “慢速学习”现象在重新分析中依然成立，但此前用于界定该现象的提示集和用于解释该现象的梯度证据均存在测量缺陷，未来研究需要更严谨、大规模的评估方法以确保结论的可靠性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach for improving reasoning during post-training. Recent work suggests that some difficult prompts remain resistant to learning even when they occasionally produce correct solutions. We revisit this unlearnability phenomenon and find that the affected prompts do improve, at roughly one third of the learnable rate, while the difficulty-defined set used to study them is much less reproducible than expected. These difficulty labels are estimated from a limited number of sampled responses. Combining them across seeds can further change which prompts are selected instead of simply reducing measurement noise. We develop a sampling-based framework for quantifying this instability and determining how much evaluation is required for difficulty assignments to reproduce reliably. We also revisit the gradient-similarity evidence proposed to explain unlearnability and show that part of the observed separation arises because difficult prompts provide fewer correct rollouts from which their gradients can be estimated. Matching this sample count weakens the gradient difference but does not remove it. Overall, the slow-learning phenomenon survives our reanalysis, while both the prompts used to define it and the evidence used to explain it require more careful measurement.

</details>


### [449] [Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40169)
*Jingbo Yang,Kwei-Herng Lai,Xiaowen Wang,Yaar Harari,Evgeniy Gabrilovich,Shiyu Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ScholarEvolve框架，通过自动整合最新研究文献来指导语言模型Agent的Harness演化，解决现有方法探索受限和适应性被动的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化Harness演化方法依赖元编码Agent的既有知识和观察到的失败，限制了探索空间并使适应过程具有反应性而非前瞻性。需要一种能主动利用前沿研究成果以持续改进Agent性能的方法。

Method: 引入ScholarEvolve框架，将Harness演化方向划分为功能模块，利用主题建模识别各模块的独立改进策略，实施并评估这些策略的组合。该框架支持随时间纳入新出版物，实现基于研究的主动终身演化。

Result: 在AppWorld和Tau2-Bench基准测试中显著提升任务性能：Qwen3.5-27B在AppWorld Challenge上的目标完成率从49.6%提升至63.6%；GPT-5.4-mini在Tau2-Bench Telecom上的pass@1从72.7%提升至81.9%。

Conclusion: ScholarEvolve通过系统化整合最新学术研究，有效促进了语言模型Agent Harness的主动、持续优化，证明了利用外部知识驱动进化可显著增强复杂任务的处理能力。

Abstract: Language agents are expected to solve increasingly complex tasks, creating a growing need for continual improvement. One promising approach is to evolve the agent harness, the software that governs tool use, memory management, and task execution, while keeping the underlying language model fixed. Recent methods automate this process by using a meta coding agent to modify the harness based on execution feedback. However, relying on that agent's existing knowledge and observed failures can restrict exploration and make adaptation reactive. Inspired by how human experts learn from the research literature for new solutions, we introduce ScholarEvolve, a framework that automatically draws on state-of-the-art research to guide harness evolution. ScholarEvolve organizes the harness evolution directions into functional modules and uses topic modeling to identify distinct improvement strategies for each module. It implements these strategies and evaluates their combinations to improve task performance. Moreover, the framework is designed to incorporate new publications over time, allowing research advances to drive proactive lifelong evolution. Experiments demonstrate improvements on AppWorld and Tau2-Bench. ScholarEvolve raises Qwen3.5-27B task goal completion from 49.6% to 63.6% on AppWorld Challenge, and raises GPT-5.4-mini pass@1 from 72.7% to 81.9% on Tau2-Bench Telecom.

</details>


### [450] [Belief-Aware Multi-Agent Path Finding under Map Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40269)
*Viraj Parimi,Shao-Hung Chan,Han Zhang,Jingkai Chen,Brian Williams*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MAGIC框架，利用高斯马尔可夫随机场和信念传播推断空间相关的通行性不确定性，优化多智能体路径规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统MAPF假设静态障碍已知，但现实环境中存在空间相关的动态变化。现有方法未利用观测数据推断邻近未观测区域的通行性，导致无法预判潜在绕行成本。

Method: 构建Belief-Aware MAPF模型，提出MAGIC框架。通过高斯马尔可夫随机场（GMRF）和高斯信念传播（GBP），基于智能体观测在线更新共享通行性信念，生成考虑绕行的代价函数以指导标准MAPF规划器。

Result: 在多个规划器家族及最多800个智能体的基准测试中，MAGIC在96.3%的实例上降低了执行总成本，证明了其在大规模MAPF问题中的有效性。

Conclusion: 利用空间相关性进行信念推断能显著提升多智能体在不确定环境中的路径规划效率，MAGIC为大规模动态环境下的MAPF提供了可扩展解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) aims to find collision-free paths for multiple agents in a shared environment. Classical MAPF assumes that all static obstacles are known in advance, but real-world environments can change unexpectedly due to fallen objects, spills, or other local disturbances. When such changes are spatially correlated, an observation can inform traversability estimates beyond the observed location. Prior approaches address uncertainty in traversability through contingent plans or replanning based on direct observations, but do not leverage this spatial dependence to infer the traversability of nearby unobserved locations. As a result, they cannot use one observation to anticipate nearby unobserved obstacles that may cause costly rerouting later. We focus on Belief-Aware MAPF, where map discrepancies are fixed during execution but initially unknown, and observations can be informative beyond the observed location. We propose Multi-Agent Gaussian belief Inference for Coordination (MAGIC), a framework that updates a shared belief about traversability online based on agents' observations. MAGIC uses a Gaussian Markov Random Field and Gaussian Belief Propagation to approximately infer traversability and construct detour-aware costs for standard MAPF planners. Our experiments on MAPF benchmarks show that MAGIC reduces the executed sum of costs compared to existing approaches on 96.3% of instances, across several planner families and teams of up to 800 agents, demonstrating its applicability to large-scale MAPF problems.

</details>


### [451] [PivotOPD: Learning to Recover from Pivotal Mistakes in Multi-Turn Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40285)
*Yinghui He,Yapei Chang,Khushi Bhardwaj,Daniele Molinari,Tugrul Konuk,Jan Kautz,Ali Hatamizadeh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PivotOPD框架，通过联合训练防止关键错误和从错误中恢复，显著提升Qwen3-1.7B/8B及Nemotron-3.5模型在ALFWorld、WebShop等任务上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮交互中错误会累积，初步实验发现超过半数失败轨迹包含早期发生的“关键错误”（pivotal mistake），且该错误通常可恢复。

Method: 提出PivotOPD：在关键错误处由教师提供黄金动作（使用反向KL散度进行预防性蒸馏）及后续几步的恢复动作（使用前向KL散度进行恢复性蒸馏）。

Result: 在13个基线对比中，PivotOPD在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-based QA上取得最强平均性能（ALFWorld提升+5.5%），并在SWE-Bench Verified上提升软件工程师领域学生模型的解决率+3.2%。

Conclusion: PivotOPD有效解决了多步交互中的错误累积问题，通过预防与恢复机制显著增强了语言智能体的任务成功率。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach for training language agents, providing dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, in multi-turn interaction, an incorrect action changes the states the student encounters later, so errors compound across turns. In preliminary experiments across three Qwen3 models (8B to 235B), we find that more than half of the failed rollouts contain a pivotal mistake, an action that moves the agent farther from completing the task, and this mistake typically occurs early. These pivotal mistakes often remain recoverable: guiding the model for only a few turns after the pivotal turn can restore task success. We therefore propose PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation framework that jointly trains the student to prevent pivotal mistakes and to recover from the states they create. At each pivotal mistake, a teacher model provides a gold action and then names a recovery action at each of the next few turns. Preventive distillation uses the gold action with reverse KL to steer the student away from the pivotal mistake, while recovery distillation uses the recovery actions with forward KL to transfer recovery behaviors that the student rarely samples. Against 13 baselines on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA, PivotOPD achieves the strongest average performance for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-8B students, improving over the strongest baseline on ALFWorld by +5.5% with the 1.7B student. The gains also transfer to another model family on the software engineering domain, where PivotOPD raises the resolve rate of a Nemotron-3.5 student on SWE-Bench Verified by +3.2%. Project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/pivotopd/

</details>


### [452] [How Much of a Harness Does a Strong Agent Need for Autonomous ML Engineering?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40303)
*Kirill Brilliantov,Alejandro Hernández-Cano,Emmanuel Abbé*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究表明，在相同时间预算和前沿LLM背景下，复杂的开源多智能体编排系统相比简单的最小化编码智能体基线并无性能优势，证明模型本身才是性能的主要驱动力，而繁琐的辅助架构在当前基准测试中收益甚微。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对当前自主机器学习工程（MLE）智能体因长期进展停滞而过度依赖复杂的多智能体编排器和检索子代理等“华丽”架构的现象，探究这些复杂机械结构是否真正带来了性能提升，还是说更基础的改进型编码智能体同样有效。

Method: 通过大规模系统性消融研究，对比了使用前沿LLM骨干网络的开源SOTA复杂编排系统与具有直接执行环境访问权限（读、写、bash原语）的最小化单会话编码智能体基线，并在同等时间预算下进行性能评估。

Result: 发现复杂的手动编排系统在同等条件下并未提供优于简单基线的性能优势；实验论证了在编码智能体设置下，额外的机械层是冗余的，模型骨干网络（Backbone）才是决定性能的关键因素。

Conclusion: 围绕强模型精心设计的复杂手动手柄在当前MLE基准测试中回报率低下，应重新审视对复杂多智能体架构的投资，转而关注模型本身的优化或更高效的资源分配。

Abstract: Recent autonomous machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made significant progress on public leaderboards. Often motivated by progress stagnation over long-horizon cycles and limited Large Language Model (LLM) primitives, modern MLE agents are deployed on top of increasingly elaborate machinery: multi-agent orchestrators, dedicated retrieval subagents, and more. While such harnesses expand, the use of more primitive but improved coding agents - where LLMs have direct access to the execution environment through read, write, and bash primitives - has received little attention in the field. In this paper we find that, under an equal time budget and the same frontier LLM backbone, open-source state-of-the-art harnesses provide no advantages over a single session of a minimal-harness coding agent baseline, pointing to the backbone as the primary driver for performance. Via a series of large-scale systematic ablation studies, we argue that the machinery layers become redundant in the coding agent setting. We conclude that the effort spent elaborating hand-crafted harnesses around strong models yields poor returns for current MLE benchmarks.

</details>


### [453] [Cogentic: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Automated Proof Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40324)
*Yang Cai,Vineet Gupta,Yanchen Jiang,Christopher Liaw,Aranyak Mehta,Grigoris Velegkas,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Cogentic是一个多智能体框架，通过迭代证明-验证循环解决开放研究问题，利用协调器分配多个独立证明者，并结合对抗性验证和持久化账本机制，成功在在线学习、拍卖理论和机制设计领域解决了5个开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿语言模型单次生成能力不足以应对需要探索多个竞争猜想、克服细微技术障碍并长期保留中间进展的开放研究问题。

Method: 提出Cogentic多智能体框架，包含迭代证明-验证循环：协调器将独立证明者群体分配到不同证明方向，由专门组件进行对抗性验证，并将确认的中间结果存入持久化验证账供后续轮次使用；以Gemini为基础模型。

Result: 在在线学习、拍卖理论和机制设计领域的五个开放问题上产生新颖结果，所有结果均经领域专家独立验证，并在配套论文中完整展开。

Conclusion: 该框架具备解决数学和理论计算机科学级别研究问题的能力，其产生的经专家验证的新成果持续更新于官方项目网站。

Abstract: We present Cogentic, a multi-agent harness for automated proof discovery on open research problems. While frontier language models can generate strong mathematical ideas in a single shot, single-shot generation is often insufficient for open problems that require exploring multiple competing conjectures, overcoming subtle technical obstructions, and retaining intermediate progress over a long horizon. Cogentic addresses these challenges through an iterative prove--verify loop in which an orchestrator allocates a population of independent provers across distinct proof directions, subjects their output to adversarial verification by several specialized components, and promotes confirmed intermediate results into a persistent verified ledger that later rounds build on. The harness is designed to be able to solve research-level math and theoretical computer science problems. Using Gemini as the base model, Cogentic produced novel results on five open problems across online learning, auction theory, and mechanism design. Each result was independently verified by domain experts and is developed in full in companion papers. We list these results, and new ones as they are verified, at https://sites.google.com/view/cogentic .

</details>


### [454] [WorldAuditBench: Interactive 3D World Auditing with Multimodal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40325)
*Ziyan Jiang,Jingbo Yang,Jiabao Ji,Yujian Liu,Qiucheng Wu,Tommi Jaakkola,Yang Zhang,Shiyu Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出WorldAuditBench基准，用于评估多模态智能体在3D环境中耦合行动与视觉推理以识别异常的能力。实验显示当前前沿模型成功率（6.6%-42.3%）远低于人类（83.4%），揭示了现有模型在探索中收集及解释证据方面的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着交互式3D世界在智能行为研究中的应用增加，开发高效管道以识别模拟环境中的异常（如漂浮物体、可穿越墙壁等）变得至关重要。尽管多模态AI系统具备潜力，但3D世界审计复杂，需紧密耦合“行动”（导航搜索）与“视觉推理”（理解环境并识别异常）两种能力，而这一耦合机制的有效性尚待探索。

Method: 1. 构建WorldAuditBench基准：包含13个基于Unreal Engine 5和Three.js构建的环境，涵盖213个异常任务，分为五类异常家族。
2. 评估范式：在固定探索预算下，对比两种审计范式：(a) 基于VLA的行动探索后接基于VLM的异常识别；(b) 端到端VLM智能体，其中视觉推理直接指导动作选择。
3. 评估对象：五种前沿多模态模型，并与人类表现进行对比。

Result: 在不同模型和两种范式下，成功率为6.6%至42.3%，显著低于人类表现的83.4%。这表明当前多模态智能体在将视觉推理用于识别潜在异常并采取行动验证方面存在明显不足。

Conclusion: WorldAuditBench为研究多模态智能体如何在交互式3D环境中耦合行动与视觉推理提供了测试平台，同时凸显了当前模型在探索过程中收集和解释证据能力的局限性，指出了未来改进方向。

Abstract: As interactive 3D worlds are increasingly used to study intelligent behavior, it becomes important to develop efficient pipelines for identifying anomalies in these simulated environments, such as floating objects, traversable walls, or objects inconsistent with the surrounding scene. Multimodal AI systems, including vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs), have shown potential for automating this task. However, 3D world auditing is complex, requiring the close coupling of two distinct capabilities: action, to navigate the 3D world and search for anomalies systematically and efficiently; and visual reasoning, to understand the environment and identify anomalies from multimodal observations. It remains largely unexplored whether multimodal agents can effectively couple these two capabilities, using visual reasoning to identify potential anomalies while taking actions to validate them. In this paper, we introduce WorldAuditBench, a benchmark for 3D world auditing comprising 213 anomaly tasks across 13 environments built with Unreal Engine 5 and Three.js, spanning five anomaly families. We evaluate five frontier models under a fixed exploration budget using two auditing paradigms: VLA-based exploration followed by VLM-based anomaly identification, and an end-to-end VLM agent in which visual reasoning directly guides action selection. Across the evaluated models and two paradigms, success rates range from 6.6% to 42.3%, substantially below human performance (83.4%). Through the task of world auditing, WorldAuditBench provides a testbed for studying how multimodal agents couple action and visual reasoning in interactive 3D environments, while highlighting current limitations in their ability to gather and interpret evidence during exploration.

</details>


### [455] [Turbo Harness: Instance-Adaptive Harness Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40330)
*Tunyu Zhang,Hao Wang,Kai Xu,Dimitris N. Metaxas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Turbo Harness 是一种通过复用全局优化过程中的信息，训练“编辑模型”为每个具体任务实例生成定制化补丁，从而优化全局策略框架的方法，显著提升了智能体在各类复杂任务中的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自动搜索有效策略（harnesses）的方法通常只生成一个适用于所有任务实例的全局统一策略，但这种平均表现良好的策略未必对每个具体实例都是最优的。

Method: 提出 Turbo Harness 框架，回收已完成的全局策略优化过程中产生的工件并总结为结构化“剧本”（playbook），训练一个策略编辑器利用这些先验优化经验，根据具体实例生成针对全局策略的局部补丁，从而构建定制化的执行策略。

Result: 在涵盖交互式智能体任务、软件工程及长程终端任务的七个基准测试中，Turbo Harness 一致性地优于现有的策略优化基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过将全局优化的先验知识转化为可复用的结构化信息，并用于指导实例特定的策略调整，该方法能有效实现更精细化的策略优化，推动智能体递归自我改进的能力。

Abstract: Automating the search for effective harnesses is an important step toward enabling agents to recursively self-improve. Existing harness optimizations typically produce a single global harness that is applied uniformly across task instances. However, a harness that works well on average may not be optimal for every instance. We introduce Turbo Harness, a framework that can adapt a globally optimized harness to each instance by reusing information generated during the original optimization process. Specifically, Turbo Harness recycles artifacts produced during a completed global harness optimization run, and summarizes them into a structured playbook. We train a harness editor to leverage this prior optimization experience to generate instance-specific patches to the global harness. At inference time, the editor uses the instance and the playbook to construct a tailored harness in which the execution model operates. Through numerical experiments, we show that Turbo Harness consistently outperforms existing harness optimization baselines across seven benchmarks spanning interactive agent tasks, software engineering, and long-horizon terminal tasks.

</details>

### [456] [Automated Prefetching for Object Spatial Programming Using Temporal Trace Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38439)
*Baichuan Li,Jayanaka Dantanarayana,Savini Kashmira,Lingjia Tang,Jason Mars*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出基于Object-Spatial Programming (OSP) 的 Temporal Trace Graph (TTG) 机制，通过静态分析访问路径和显式遍历延续性，实现数据库请求级的自动预取与执行规划，显著降低依赖型数据库访问的端到端延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决依赖型数据库访问导致的应用-数据库往返在请求关键路径上串行化的问题；传统方法难以跨遍历步骤进行规划，因为缺乏对计算可能遵循的关系及发现对象如何成为后续执行上下文的明确信息。

Method: 1. 定义编程模型契约，通过可检查的访问路径和显式遍历延续暴露跨步骤信息；2. 引入 TTG（有界、请求特定的候选对象图及遍历衍生转换图）；3. TTG Builder 在 walker 启动时，基于请求起始节点，组合静态提取的访问规则和延续规则构建活跃图；4. 异步预取器在执行期间加载计划好的对象；5. 在 Jac/PostgreSQL 中实现并评估四种遍历类型（线性、多跳、递归、值依赖）。

Result: TTG 在三个应用中改善了端到端延迟，相比默认运行时最高获得 2.99x 加速；与手动分阶段预取对比揭示了自动跨步规划的收益与成本；评估显示规划开销可能超过避免的需求延迟，且值依赖控制可能导致有界的过度预取（overfetch）。

Conclusion: 自动跨步骤规划能有效优化依赖型数据库访问性能，但需权衡规划开销与潜在的资源浪费（如 overfetch），该机制为复杂对象图遍历提供了高效的自动化解决方案。

Abstract: Dependent database accesses can serialize application--database round trips on a request's critical path. Planning across traversal steps requires knowing both which relationships a computation may follow and how discovered objects become subsequent execution contexts. We identify a programming-model contract that exposes this information through inspectable access paths and explicit traversal continuation. We demonstrate this contract in Object-Spatial Programming (OSP), where walkers traverse a typed object graph and execute node-type-specific code. We introduce the Temporal Trace Graph (TTG), a bounded, request-specific graph of candidate objects and traversal-derived transitions. At walker spawn, the TTG Builder composes statically extracted access and continuation rules over the live graph from the request's starting node. An asynchronous prefetcher loads planned objects while the walker executes. We implement TTG in Jac/PostgreSQL and evaluate four applications covering linear, multi-hop, recursive, and value-dependent traversals. TTG improves end-to-end latency in three applications, achieving up to 2.99x speedup over the stock runtime. Comparisons with manually staged prefetching characterize the benefits and costs of automatic cross-step planning. The evaluation also shows that planning overhead can exceed avoided demand latency and that value-dependent control can introduce bounded overfetch.

</details>


### [457] [A 3GPP-Compliant Benchmark Dataset for RIS-Aided Beyond 5G Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39058)
*Pujitha Mamillapalli,Pankaj Singh Rathour,Abhinav Kumar*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文发布了一个符合3GPP TR 38.901标准的大规模RIS辅助毫米波网络数据集，包含通过全局最优搜索获得的黄金标准相位配置标签及丰富的多任务标注，旨在解决数据驱动RIS研究缺乏标准化高保真数据集的瓶颈，并提出了CSI到CQI映射作为基准任务以加速B5G网络研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管可重构智能表面（RIS）是B5G网络的关键技术，但数据驱动的RIS研究因缺乏标准化、高保真且开源的数据集而受到阻碍。现有公开数据集中缺失高质量的监督标签，限制了机器学习范式的发展。

Method: 构建涵盖20种受控变体的3GPP部署场景数据集，模拟不同的用户密度、衰落条件和阻塞机制。利用全局最优暴力码本搜索获取每样本的oracle RIS相位配置作为黄金标准标签。提供包括完整信道状态信息（CSI）、链路分解、最优相位矩阵和信道质量指数（CQI）在内的丰富多任务标注。提出一种新颖的CSI-to-CQI映射方法，将RIS辅助链路质量预测转化为可扩展的标量分类问题，而非直接预测相位向量。

Result: 在分布内、分布外以及真实硬件测量条件下，评估了该映射方法与最先进架构的性能。数据集被证明是一个可复现、可扩展且面向社区的基础资源，能够有效支持相位优化、信道估计和干扰管理等下游任务。

Conclusion: 该数据集为数据驱动的RIS辅助B5G网络研究提供了可复现、可扩展且面向社区的坚实基础，有助于加速相关领域的研究进展。

Abstract: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) are emerging as a key technology for programmable wireless environments in the beyond the fifth generation (B5G) networks. However, data-driven RIS research remains bottleneck by the lack of standardized, high-fidelity and open-source datasets. In this paper, we introduce a large-scale 3GPP TR 38.901-compliant dataset for RIS-aided millimeter wave (mmWave) networks, that considers severe path loss, blockage sensitivity, and spatial channel sparsity make the RIS assistance more impactful. The dataset spans various canonical 3GPP deployment scenarios across 20 controlled variants, capturing diverse user densities, fading conditions, and blockage regimes. Uniquely, every sample includes oracle RIS phase configurations obtained via a globally optimal brute-force codebook search, providing gold-standard supervision labels that are absent from any existing public dataset. Rich multi-task annotations comprising full channel state information (CSI), per-link channel decomposition, optimal phase matrices, and channel quality index (CQI) labels support a broad range of machine learning paradigms and downstream tasks, including phase optimization, channel estimation, and interference management. As the primary benchmark task, we introduce a novel CSI-to-CQI mapping that frames RIS-aided link-quality prediction as a scalable scalar classification problem, thereby avoiding the exponential output complexity of the direct phase vector prediction. We have evaluated this mapping against state-of-the-art architectures under in-distribution, out-of-distribution, and real-world hardware measurement conditions. Our dataset provides a reproducible, extensible, and community-ready foundation to accelerate data-driven research in RIS-aided B5G networks.

</details>


### [458] [O-Funnel: Lossless Structural Capture and Requirement-Driven Extraction from Drifting, Heterogeneous Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39209)
*Osama Mustafa*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: O-Funnel 是一种用于从多种格式文档中提取字段的 Python 库，通过结构化解耦和多重证据融合实现高鲁棒性提取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于手写字节模式（正则表达式）的字段提取方法在面对键名重命名、值格式变化或相似值出现时容易失效，根本原因在于单一模式需同时描述值和定位位置。

Method: 提出 O-Funnel 框架，将 XML/JSON/CSV/HTML/键值文本转录为五种构造函数的类型化树；利用预言机验证重构完整性；通过融合键、路径、值形状、同义词等多源独立证据定位节点；并具备自我改进能力以学习新别名。

Result: 在 34,989 条真实 PubMed 记录上 F1 分数达到 1.00；在 schema 重命名后保持 1.00（正则表达式降至 0.20）；在隔离正则失败模式的构建套件中 F1 从 0.43 提升至 1.00，经自改进后达 0.94；在无训练数据场景下表现优于经典匹配器。

Conclusion: O-Funnel 有效解决了结构化提取中的脆弱性问题，提供了无需依赖、可验证且具备自适应能力的字段提取解决方案。

Abstract: Pulling a fixed set of fields out of documents that arrive in many formats and under drifting schemas is usually done with hand-written byte patterns, which break whenever a key is renamed, a value is reformatted, or a lookalike value appears first. We argue the cause is structural: one pattern must both describe the value and locate it among its surroundings. O-Funnel separates the two. It transcribes any XML, JSON, CSV, HTML or key-value text document into one typed tree over five constructors, gated by an oracle that rejects any capture that does not reconstruct its source. Each needed field is declared in the tree's own terms and located by fusing independent evidence (key, path, value shape, synonym, key spelling, record neighborhood, value profile), so the best-supported node wins and a missing field is reported with a reason. Data no requirement claims becomes residue that a funnel traces back to the requirements to learn new key aliases. On 34,989 real PubMed records, O-Funnel matches a hand-written parser (F1 1.00). After a five-element schema rename, the parser's regular expressions fall to 0.20 while O-Funnel stays at 1.00, with every capture verified complete. On constructed suites that isolate regex failure modes it raises F1 from 0.43 to 1.00, and from 0.80 to 0.94 after self-improvement; on held-out schema-matching instances it is competitive with classical matchers without training. O-Funnel is a dependency-free Python library (pip install ofunnel).

</details>


### [459] [Recommendation Systems for Exploratory Data Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39412)
*Anna Fariha*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出探索性数据任务（EDT）推荐系统的愿景与研究议程，旨在解决用户在探索过程中面临的“探索瘫痪”问题，通过智能推荐引导用户高效发现数据洞察。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索性数据任务中，用户面临巨大的动作空间（如连接、转换、聚合），导致选择困难和“探索瘫痪”。次优选择会导致效率低下、遗漏见解及确认偏误，因此需要智能推荐系统来降低参与门槛并优化决策。

Method: 从单任务与多任务设置、单动作与多动作推荐两个维度构建EDT推荐系统的理论框架；提出从推荐单个动作到受限动作束/序列，再到跨互连任务的协调推荐的渐进式研究议程；识别整合上下文信息、解决效率挑战及跨任务协调的研究方向。

Result: 确立了EDT推荐作为数据系统核心能力的地位，明确了处理组合爆炸和数据依赖性带来的高昂物化成本等挑战的路径，并规划了从简单推荐到复杂多任务协同推荐的演进路线。

Conclusion: 智能推荐能有效引导用户应对探索性数据任务中的复杂性，未来研究应聚焦于结合多维上下文、提升计算效率以及实现跨任务的协同推荐，以支持更高效的探索性数据分析。

Abstract: A large class of data-centric tasks is exploratory, where users iteratively steer workflows, refining subjective goals as new insights emerge. These Exploratory Data Tasks (EDTs) are performed by millions of users with varying levels of expertise to understand unfamiliar data, discover trends, and identify evidence that informs critical decision-making. However, a key challenge in EDTs is the enormous space of possible actions that one can take at each step: users struggle to choose among thousands of joins, transformations, and aggregations, causing "exploration paralysis". Because EDT workflows are interconnected, each choice impacts subsequent exploration, and suboptimal choices can lead to inefficiency, missed insights, confirmation bias, and incomplete coverage. This calls for intelligent recommendations that efficiently guide users toward optimal EDT actions.
  We envision recommendation as a core capability of data systems, proactively guiding users toward promising actions and thereby lowering the barrier to exploratory data tasks. EDT recommendation is challenging because the action space is combinatorial and actions are data-dependent, which require costly materialization. Moreover, recommendation often involves bundles or sequences of actions across interdependent tasks, requiring coordination across tasks. In this paper, we present our vision of EDT recommendation systems along two axes: single-task vs. multi-task settings and single-action vs. multi-action recommendations. We outline a research agenda that progresses from recommending individual EDT actions to constrained bundles and sequences of actions, and ultimately to coordinated recommendations across interconnected EDTs. We identify research directions for incorporating various contexts (user, data, task, and ecosystem), addressing efficiency challenges, and coordinating across tasks.

</details>


### [460] [Scalable Approximate Algorithm for Dynamic Densest Subhypergraphs with Solution-Guided Maintenance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39778)
*Jingbang Chen,Chenhao Ma,Yingli Zhou*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出CAP算法，用于在超边动态插入和删除时，高效维护近似最密子超图。该算法通过局部搜索和边界约束实现低成本更新，实验显示其比现有动态基线快近四个数量级，且在普通图上也有显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在处理涉及实体组的超图数据时，寻找高度连接的组是基础任务。当交互（超边）动态发生插入和过期（删除）时，传统方法维持稠密子图需要频繁且昂贵的底层表示更新，缺乏可扩展的高效动态维护算法。

Method: 提出CAP算法，显式维护$(1+ε)$-近似最密子超图。核心机制包括：1) 保持一个解候选集和一个端点分配，以界定最优密度；2) 利用候选集的密度指导维护，仅当边界过大时才触发修复；3) 使用局部搜索重新分配负载或寻找更密集的候选集，从而在多轮更新中保留有用解。

Result: 理论分析表明维护工作量与搜索区域大小及所维持解损失的密度相关，并指出了局部修复保持低成本的条件下。实验结果显示，在真实世界超图上，CAP相比评估的动态基线速度提升近四个数量级，支持高频查询和高精度。在普通图上，CAP也比专用动态图方法更具竞争力，加速比最高约64倍。

Conclusion: CAP是一种可扩展的动态算法，能有效解决超图中最密子超图的动态维护问题，通过智能的更新触发机制和局部搜索策略，在保证近似精度的同时极大提升了计算效率，适用于大规模动态超图数据分析。

Abstract: Hypergraphs model interactions involving groups of entities, and finding highly connected groups is a fundamental task in analyzing these data. When interactions arrive and expire, maintaining a dense group can require frequent and expensive changes to the underlying representation. We propose CAP, a scalable algorithm that explicitly maintains a $(1+ε)$-approximate densest subhypergraph under hyperedge insertions and deletions. The algorithm keeps a solution candidate together with an endpoint allocation that bounds the optimum density. The candidate's density guides maintenance: an update triggers repair only when this bound is too large to establish the required approximation. Local searches redistribute load or find a denser candidate, allowing CAP to retain useful solutions across many updates. We give an analysis that relates maintenance work to the size of the regions searched and the density lost by the maintained solution. It identifies conditions under which local repair remains inexpensive and provides a theoretical explanation for the observed efficiency. Experiments on real-world hypergraphs show speedups of up to nearly four orders of magnitude over the evaluated dynamic baselines, while supporting frequent queries and high accuracy. CAP also remains competitive with specialized dynamic graph methods on ordinary graphs, with speedups of up to approximately $64\times$ on the tested workloads.

</details>
